#!/usr/bin/env node
/**
 * opencode-pollinations-plugin setup CLI
 * Injects the plugin into ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json (or OPENCODE_CONFIG_DIR).
 */
import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as os from 'os';
import * as path from 'path';
import { createRequire } from 'module';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'url';

const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);
const __dirname = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
const pkg = require(path.join(__dirname, '..', 'package.json'));

const PLUGIN_SPEC = 'opencode-pollinations-plugin';

function getConfigPaths() {
    const custom = process.env.OPENCODE_CONFIG_DIR;
    const base = custom
        ? path.resolve(custom)
        : path.join(os.homedir(), '.config', 'opencode');
    return {
        dir: base,
        file: path.join(base, 'opencode.json'),
    };
}

function loadJson(file) {
    if (!fs.existsSync(file)) return {};
    try {
        return JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf-8'));
    } catch (e) {
        console.error(`❌ Failed to parse ${file}: ${e.message}`);
        process.exit(1);
    }
}

function saveJson(file, data) {
    fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(file), { recursive: true });
    fs.writeFileSync(file, JSON.stringify(data, null, 2) + '\n', 'utf-8');
}

function ensurePlugin(config) {
    const plugins = Array.isArray(config.plugin)
        ? [...config.plugin]
        : Array.isArray(config.plugins)
            ? [...config.plugins]
            : [];

    const already = plugins.some((p) => {
        if (typeof p === 'string') {
            return p === PLUGIN_SPEC || p.includes('opencode-pollinations-plugin');
        }
        if (p && typeof p === 'object') {
            const id = p.id || p.name || p.package || '';
            return String(id).includes('opencode-pollinations-plugin');
        }
        return false;
    });

    if (!already) {
        plugins.push(PLUGIN_SPEC);
    }

    // Prefer singular "plugin" (OpenCode current) but keep existing key if present
    if (Array.isArray(config.plugins) && !Array.isArray(config.plugin)) {
        config.plugins = plugins;
    } else {
        config.plugin = plugins;
        if (config.plugins) delete config.plugins;
    }

    return { config, already, count: plugins.length };
}

function printHelp() {
    console.log(`
🌸 opencode-pollinations-plugin v${pkg.version}

Usage:
  npx opencode-pollinations-plugin          Inject plugin into OpenCode config
  npx opencode-pollinations-plugin --check  Check if plugin is already configured
  npx opencode-pollinations-plugin --help   Show this help

Config file:
  $OPENCODE_CONFIG_DIR/opencode.json
  or ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json

After install:
  1. Restart OpenCode
  2. Run: /poll login   (or /poll connect sk_...)
  3. Run: /poll help
`);
}

function main() {
    const args = process.argv.slice(2);
    if (args.includes('--help') || args.includes('-h')) {
        printHelp();
        return;
    }

    const { dir, file } = getConfigPaths();
    const checkOnly = args.includes('--check');

    console.log(`🌸 Pollinations OpenCode Plugin v${pkg.version}`);
    console.log(`📁 Config: ${file}`);

    const config = loadJson(file);
    const { config: next, already, count } = ensurePlugin(config);

    if (checkOnly) {
        if (already) {
            console.log(`✅ Plugin already configured (${count} plugin entr${count === 1 ? 'y' : 'ies'})`);
            process.exit(0);
        }
        console.log('❌ Plugin not found in config');
        process.exit(1);
    }

    if (already) {
        console.log('✅ Plugin already present in config — nothing to change.');
    } else {
        saveJson(file, next);
        console.log('✅ Plugin injected into OpenCode config.');
    }

    console.log(`
Next steps:
  1. Restart OpenCode
  2. /poll login          # 1-click device login
     or /poll connect sk_...
  3. /poll help           # commands & free tools
  4. /poll quests         # free Pollen waiting to claim
`);
}

main();

```

# get-proto <sup>[![Version Badge][npm-version-svg]][package-url]</sup>

[![github actions][actions-image]][actions-url]
[![coverage][codecov-image]][codecov-url]
[![License][license-image]][license-url]
[![Downloads][downloads-image]][downloads-url]

[![npm badge][npm-badge-png]][package-url]

Robustly get the [[Prototype]] of an object. Uses the best available method.

## Getting started

```sh
npm install --save get-proto
```

## Usage/Examples

```js
const assert = require('assert');
const getProto = require('get-proto');

const a = { a: 1, b: 2, [Symbol.toStringTag]: 'foo' };
const b = { c: 3, __proto__: a };

assert.equal(getProto(b), a);
assert.equal(getProto(a), Object.prototype);
assert.equal(getProto({ __proto__: null }), null);
```

## Tests

Clone the repo, `npm install`, and run `npm test`

import { ZEN_BASE_URL } from './config.js';

function relayDefinitions() {
  let sharedKey = process.env.ZEN_EGRESS_RELAY_KEY || '';
  if (process.env.ZEN_EGRESS_RELAY_KEY_B64) {
    try { sharedKey = Buffer.from(process.env.ZEN_EGRESS_RELAY_KEY_B64, 'base64').toString('utf8'); }
    catch (e) { console.error('[egress] ZEN_EGRESS_RELAY_KEY_B64 invalide:', e.message); }
  }
  const rawJson = process.env.ZEN_EGRESS_RELAYS_JSON || '';
  if (rawJson) {
    try {
      const rows = JSON.parse(rawJson);
      if (Array.isArray(rows)) {
        return rows.map((row, i) => ({
          id: String(row.id || `relay-${i + 1}`),
          type: 'relay',
          baseUrl: String(row.url || '').replace(/\/$/, ''),
          key: String(row.key || sharedKey),
          priority: Number.isFinite(Number(row.priority)) ? Number(row.priority) : i + 1,
          maxConcurrency: Math.max(1, Number(row.maxConcurrency || 1)),
        })).filter((row) => validRelay(row));
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('[egress] ZEN_EGRESS_RELAYS_JSON invalide:', e.message);
    }
  }

  return String(process.env.ZEN_EGRESS_RELAY_URLS || '').split(',').map((url) => url.trim()).filter(Boolean)
    .map((url, i) => ({ id: `relay-${i + 1}`, type: 'relay', baseUrl: url.replace(/\/$/, ''), key: sharedKey, priority: i + 1, maxConcurrency: 1 }))
    .filter((row) => validRelay(row));
}

function validRelay(row) {
  if (!row.baseUrl || !row.key) return false;
  try {
    const url = new URL(row.baseUrl);
    const privateHost = /^(127\.|10\.|192\.168\.|172\.(1[6-9]|2\d|3[01])\.)/.test(url.hostname) || url.hostname === 'localhost';
    if (url.protocol !== 'https:' && !privateHost && process.env.ZEN_ALLOW_INSECURE_PUBLIC_RELAY !== 'true') {
      console.error(`[egress] relay public HTTP refusé: ${url.hostname} (TLS ou réseau privé requis)`);
      return false;
    }
    return true;
  } catch { return false; }
}

let cached = null;

export function getEgresses() {
  if (!cached) cached = [{ id: 'direct', type: 'direct', priority: 0, maxConcurrency: Math.max(1, Number(process.env.ZEN_DIRECT_MAX_CONCURRENCY || 2)) }, ...relayDefinitions()];
  return cached.map((row) => ({ ...row }));
}

export function publicEgresses() {
  return getEgresses().map(({ key, ...row }) => row);
}

export async function fetchViaEgress(egress, path, init) {
  const targetUrl = `${ZEN_BASE_URL}${path}`;
  if (!egress || egress.type === 'direct') return fetch(targetUrl, init);

  const target = new URL(targetUrl);
  const relayUrl = `${egress.baseUrl}${target.pathname}${target.search}`;
  const headers = new Headers(init.headers || {});
  headers.set('X-EA-ProxyPass-Key', egress.key);
  headers.set('X-Target-URL', targetUrl);
  return fetch(relayUrl, { ...init, headers });
}

### 📄 `data/infra_snapshots/objects/5a/8edfac1dd225f5eb85529c84a1d332f260a1f16f378d4be9fd8df52d95c2bc`

```text
# SPEC — Logging Multi-OS

> Cible : Agents de refactoring / PR review
> Scope : `src/index.ts`, `tools/index.ts`, `server/pollinations-api.ts`, `server/toast.ts`

---

## Problème

Les fichiers de log sont écrits dans des chemins `/tmp/...` hardcodés. Sur Windows, `/tmp` n'existe pas — les `appendFileSync` échouent silencieusement (le try/catch absorbe l'erreur), résultant en une perte totale des logs de diagnostic.

---

## Inventaire des Loggers Actuels

| Module | Variable | Chemin actuel |
|--------|----------|--------------|
| `src/index.ts` | `LOG_FILE` | `/tmp/opencode_pollinations_v4.log` |
| `tools/index.ts` | `LOG_FILE` | `/tmp/opencode_pollinations_v4.log` |
| `server/pollinations-api.ts` | inline | `/tmp/pollinations-api-debug.log` |
| `server/toast.ts` | inline | `/tmp/pollinations-toasts.log` |

---

## Solution : Module de Logging Partagé

Créer `src/server/logger.ts` — unique source de vérité :

```typescript
import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as path from 'path';
import * as os from 'os';

// Centraliser tous les logs dans un seul dossier temporaire
const LOG_DIR = path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'pollinations-plugin');
const LOG_FILE = path.join(LOG_DIR, 'plugin.log');
const API_LOG_FILE = path.join(LOG_DIR, 'api-debug.log');
const TOAST_LOG_FILE = path.join(LOG_DIR, 'toasts.log');

// Initialisation unique
function ensureLogDir() {
    try {
        if (!fs.existsSync(LOG_DIR)) {
            fs.mkdirSync(LOG_DIR, { recursive: true });
        }
    } catch { /* Silent fail — logging should never crash the app */ }
}
ensureLogDir();

export function log(msg: string, file = LOG_FILE): void {
    try {
        fs.appendFileSync(file, `[${new Date().toISOString()}] ${msg}\n`);
    } catch { }
}

export function logApi(msg: string): void {
    log(msg, API_LOG_FILE);
}

export function logToast(msg: string): void {
    log(msg, TOAST_LOG_FILE);
}

export const LOG_FILES = {
    main: LOG_FILE,
    api: API_LOG_FILE,
    toast: TOAST_LOG_FILE,
};
```

---

## Migration par Fichier

### `src/index.ts`

```typescript
// ❌ AVANT
const LOG_FILE = '/tmp/opencode_pollinations_v4.log';
function log(msg: string) {
    try { fs.appendFileSync(LOG_FILE, `...`); } catch (e) { }
}

// ✅ APRÈS
import { log } from './server/logger.js';
// Utiliser log() directement
```

### `server/pollinations-api.ts`

```typescript
// ❌ AVANT
function logDebug(msg: string) {
    try { fs.appendFileSync('/tmp/pollinations-api-debug.log', `...`); } catch (e) { }
}

// ✅ APRÈS
import { logApi as logDebug } from './logger.js';
```

### `server/toast.ts`

```typescript
// ❌ AVANT
fs.appendFileSync('/tmp/pollinations-toasts.log', logLine + '\n');

// ✅ APRÈS
import { logToast } from './logger.js';
logToast(logLine);
```

---

## Bonus : Commande `/poll logs` (optionnel)

Exposer le chemin des logs dans une commande pour faciliter le debug :

```typescript
case 'logs':
    return {
        handled: true,
        response: [
            `📋 Fichiers de log:`,
            `  Plugin : ${LOG_FILES.main}`,
            `  API    : ${LOG_FILES.api}`,
            `  Toasts : ${LOG_FILES.toast}`,
        ].join('\n')
    };
```

---

## Tests de Validation

- [ ] Sur Windows : les logs se créent dans `%TEMP%\pollinations-plugin\`
- [ ] Sur Linux/macOS : les logs se créent dans `/tmp/pollinations-plugin/`
- [ ] L'absence de dossier ne crash pas le plugin au démarrage
- [ ] Les 3 fichiers de log sont distincts et lisibles

# Polyfill for `Object.setPrototypeOf`

[![NPM Version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/setprototypeof.svg)](https://npmjs.org/package/setprototypeof)
[![NPM Downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dm/setprototypeof.svg)](https://npmjs.org/package/setprototypeof)
[![js-standard-style](https://img.shields.io/badge/code%20style-standard-brightgreen.svg)](https://github.com/standard/standard)

A simple cross platform implementation to set the prototype of an instianted object.  Supports all modern browsers and at least back to IE8.

## Usage:

```
$ npm install --save setprototypeof
```

```javascript
var setPrototypeOf = require('setprototypeof')

var obj = {}
setPrototypeOf(obj, {
  foo: function () {
    return 'bar'
  }
})
obj.foo() // bar
```

TypeScript is also supported:

```typescript
import setPrototypeOf from 'setprototypeof'
```

```

```text
# Class: RetryAgent

Extends: `undici.Dispatcher`

A `undici.Dispatcher` that allows to automatically retry a request.
Wraps a `undici.RetryHandler`.

## `new RetryAgent(dispatcher, [options])`

Arguments:

* **dispatcher** `undici.Dispatcher` (required) - the dispatcher to wrap
* **options** `RetryHandlerOptions` (optional) - the options

Returns: `ProxyAgent`

### Parameter: `RetryHandlerOptions`

- **retry** `(err: Error, context: RetryContext, callback: (err?: Error | null) => void) => void` (optional) - Function to be called after every retry. It should pass error if no more retries should be performed.
- **maxRetries** `number` (optional) - Maximum number of retries. Default: `5`
- **maxTimeout** `number` (optional) - Maximum number of milliseconds to wait before retrying. Default: `30000` (30 seconds)
- **minTimeout** `number` (optional) - Minimum number of milliseconds to wait before retrying. Default: `500` (half a second)
- **timeoutFactor** `number` (optional) - Factor to multiply the timeout by for each retry attempt. Default: `2`
- **retryAfter** `boolean` (optional) - It enables automatic retry after the `Retry-After` header is received. Default: `true`
-
- **methods** `string[]` (optional) - Array of HTTP methods to retry. Default: `['GET', 'PUT', 'HEAD', 'OPTIONS', 'DELETE']`
- **statusCodes** `number[]` (optional) - Array of HTTP status codes to retry. Default: `[429, 500, 502, 503, 504]`
- **errorCodes** `string[]` (optional) - Array of Error codes to retry. Default: `['ECONNRESET', 'ECONNREFUSED', 'ENOTFOUND', 'ENETDOWN','ENETUNREACH', 'EHOSTDOWN', 'UND_ERR_SOCKET']`

**`RetryContext`**

- `state`: `RetryState` - Current retry state. It can be mutated.
- `opts`: `Dispatch.DispatchOptions & RetryOptions` - Options passed to the retry handler.

Example:

```js
import { Agent, RetryAgent } from 'undici'

const agent = new RetryAgent(new Agent())

const res = await agent.request('http://example.com')
console.log(res.statuCode)
console.log(await res.body.text())
```

```

import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { configNumber } from './config.js';

export function nativeRequest(body = {}, requestId = randomUUID()) {
  return {
    body: JSON.stringify({
      ...body,
      max_tokens: configNumber('ZEN_NATIVE_MAX_TOKENS', 32000),
      stream: true,
      stream_options: { include_usage: true },
    }),
    headers: {
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      'User-Agent': 'opencode/1.18.16 ai-sdk/provider-utils/4.0.23 runtime/node',
      'X-OpenCode-Client': 'cli',
      'X-OpenCode-Project': 'zen-proxy',
      'X-OpenCode-Request': requestId,
      'X-OpenCode-Session': requestId,
    },
  };
}

export function parseSse(text) {
  let content = '';
  let reasoning = '';
  let usage = null;
  let id = '';
  let model = '';
  let finishReason = 'stop';
  const toolCalls = [];
  for (const line of text.split(/\r?\n/)) {
    if (!line.startsWith('data: ') || line === 'data: [DONE]') continue;
    try {
      const event = JSON.parse(line.slice(6));
      id ||= event.id || '';
      model ||= event.model || '';
      const choice = event.choices?.[0];
      content += choice?.delta?.content || '';
      reasoning += choice?.delta?.reasoning_content || '';
      for (const call of choice?.delta?.tool_calls || []) {
        const index = Number(call.index || 0);
        const current = toolCalls[index] ||= { id: '', type: 'function', function: { name: '', arguments: '' } };
        current.id ||= call.id || '';
        current.type = call.type || current.type;
        current.function.name += call.function?.name || '';
        current.function.arguments += call.function?.arguments || '';
      }
      finishReason = choice?.finish_reason || finishReason;
      usage = event.usage || usage;
    } catch {}
  }
  return { id, model, content, reasoning, finishReason, usage, toolCalls: toolCalls.filter(Boolean) };
}

export function openAiResponse(parsed, fallbackModel) {
  const message = { role: 'assistant', content: parsed.content };
  if (parsed.reasoning) message.reasoning_content = parsed.reasoning;
  if (parsed.toolCalls?.length) message.tool_calls = parsed.toolCalls;
  return {
    id: parsed.id || `chatcmpl-${randomUUID()}`,
    object: 'chat.completion',
    created: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000),
    model: parsed.model || fallbackModel,
    choices: [{ index: 0, message, finish_reason: parsed.finishReason }],
    usage: parsed.usage || undefined,
  };
}

```

### 📄 `data/infra_snapshots/objects/5b/749da51dc34ac4fd0c6359e59cd72900658b671d762b1dde073fdadc664292`

```text
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import {
  ZEN_KEY, KEY_MAX_CONCURRENCY, FREE_LIMIT_RETRY_MS, FREE_LIMIT_MAX_BACKOFF_MS,
  QUOTA_CONFIRM_EGRESS_COUNT, QUOTA_RECHECK_MS, EGRESS_CIRCUIT_THRESHOLD,
  EGRESS_CIRCUIT_WINDOW_MS, EGRESS_CIRCUIT_MS,
} from './config.js';
import { load, safeSave } from './store.js';

// Santé persistée :
// - compte : auth_invalid uniquement quand l'erreur Zen est explicite ;
// - modèle/clé : quota suspecté seulement après échec via plusieurs IP ;
// - route clé×modèle×egress : cooldown transitoire ;
// - egress×modèle : circuit partagé si plusieurs clés distinctes échouent.

let pool = load('zen_keys', []);
let health = load('pool_health', { egressModels: {}, globalModels: {}, events: [] });
const inFlight = new Map();
const inFlightEgress = new Map();
let rotationMode = 'round_robin';

if (pool.length === 0 && ZEN_KEY) {
  pool.push(newKey('compte-initial', '', ZEN_KEY));
  persist();
}

for (const key of pool) migrateKey(key);

function newKey(name, email, apiKey) {
  return {
    id: randomUUID().slice(0, 8), name, email, apiKey,
    active: true, state: 'active', createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    usageEvents: [], routeHealth: {}, modelHealth: {},
    errors: 0, lastErrorKind: '', lastErrorDetail: '', lastErrorAt: 0,
  };
}

function migrateKey(k) {
  k.active = k.active !== false;
  k.state = k.state === 'auth_invalid' ? 'auth_invalid' : 'active';
  k.usageEvents = Array.isArray(k.usageEvents) ? k.usageEvents : [];
  if (k.usageEvents.length === 0 && (Number(k.tokensToday || 0) > 0 || Number(k.reqToday || 0) > 0)) {
    k.usageEvents.push({
      at: Number(k.lastUsedAt || Date.now()), tokens: Number(k.tokensToday || 0),
      requests: Number(k.reqToday || 0), model: 'legacy', egressId: 'direct', source: 'legacy-counter',
    });
  }
  k.routeHealth = k.routeHealth && typeof k.routeHealth === 'object' ? k.routeHealth : {};
  k.modelHealth = k.modelHealth && typeof k.modelHealth === 'object' ? k.modelHealth : {};
  k.errors = Number(k.errors || 0);
  // Les anciens COLD étaient ambigus. On conserve l'observation pour audit, sans la traiter comme preuve.
  if (k.lastErrorKind === 'quota' && !k.migratedLegacyColdAt) k.migratedLegacyColdAt = Date.now();
}

function persist() {
  safeSave('zen_keys', pool);
  safeSave('pool_health', health);
}

export function maskKey(k) { return k ? `${k.slice(0, 7)}…${k.slice(-4)}` : ''; }

function pruneUsage(k, now = Date.now()) {
  const cutoff = now - 24 * 3600 * 1000;
  k.usageEvents = k.usageEvents.filter((e) => Number(e.at) >= cutoff);
}

function usage24h(k, now = Date.now()) {
  pruneUsage(k, now);
  return k.usageEvents.reduce((a, e) => ({ tokens: a.tokens + Number(e.tokens || 0), requests: a.requests + Number(e.requests || 0) }), { tokens: 0, requests: 0 });
}

function cleanup(now = Date.now()) {
  health.egressModels ||= {};
  health.globalModels ||= {};
  health.events = Array.isArray(health.events) ? health.events.slice(-1000) : [];
  for (const k of pool) {
    pruneUsage(k, now);
    for (const [id, route] of Object.entries(k.routeHealth)) {
      if (route.cooldownUntil <= now && now - Number(route.lastFailureAt || 0) > 24 * 3600 * 1000) delete k.routeHealth[id];
    }
    for (const model of Object.values(k.modelHealth)) {
      model.evidence = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(model.evidence || {}).filter(([, at]) => now - Number(at) < 24 * 3600 * 1000));
      if (model.blockedUntil <= now) model.status = 'ready';
    }
  }
  for (const [id, circuit] of Object.entries(health.egressModels || {})) {
    circuit.failures = (circuit.failures || []).filter((f) => now - f.at <= EGRESS_CIRCUIT_WINDOW_MS);
    if (circuit.openUntil <= now && circuit.failures.length === 0) delete health.egressModels[id];
  }
  for (const [model, circuit] of Object.entries(health.globalModels || {})) {
    circuit.failures = (circuit.failures || []).filter((f) => now - f.at <= EGRESS_CIRCUIT_WINDOW_MS);
    if (circuit.openUntil <= now && circuit.failures.length === 0) delete health.globalModels[model];
  }
}

function publicKey(k) {
  const u = usage24h(k);
  const activeBlocks = Object.entries(k.modelHealth).filter(([, m]) => m.status !== 'ready' && m.blockedUntil > Date.now());
  let state = !k.active ? 'disabled' : k.state === 'auth_invalid' ? 'auth_invalid' : activeBlocks.length ? 'limited' : 'active';
  const next = activeBlocks.length ? Math.min(...activeBlocks.map(([, m]) => m.blockedUntil)) : 0;
  return {
    ...k, apiKey: maskKey(k.apiKey), state,
    tokensToday: u.tokens, reqToday: u.requests,
    usage24h: u, wakeAt: next, cooldownUntil: next,
    inFlight: inFlight.get(k.id) || 0,
  };
}

export function listKeys() { cleanup(); return pool.map(publicKey); }

export function addKey({ name, email, apiKey }) {
  if (typeof apiKey !== 'string' || !apiKey.startsWith('sk-')) return { ok: false, error: 'Format de clé invalide' };
  if (pool.some((k) => k.apiKey === apiKey)) return { ok: false, error: 'Clé déjà présente' };
  const key = newKey(name || `compte-${pool.length + 1}`, email || '', apiKey);
  pool.push(key); persist();
  return { ok: true, id: key.id };
}

export function removeKey(id) { pool = pool.filter((k) => k.id !== id); persist(); }

export function setKeyStatus(id, { active, state }) {
  const k = pool.find((x) => x.id === id);
  if (!k) return { ok: false, error: 'clé introuvable' };
  if (typeof active === 'boolean') k.active = active;
  if (state === 'active') {
    k.state = 'active';
    k.routeHealth = {};
    k.modelHealth = {};
    k.errors = 0;
    k.lastErrorKind = '';
    k.lastErrorDetail = '';
    k.lastErrorAt = 0;
  } else if (state === 'auth_invalid') k.state = 'auth_invalid';
  persist();
  return { ok: true };
}

export function updateKey(id, { name, email, apiKey, active } = {}) {
  const k = pool.find((x) => x.id === id);
  if (!k) return { ok: false, error: 'compte introuvable' };
  if (typeof name === 'string' && name) k.name = name;
  if (typeof email === 'string') k.email = email;
  if (typeof apiKey === 'string' && apiKey.startsWith('sk-')) { k.apiKey = apiKey; k.state = 'active'; k.routeHealth = {}; k.modelHealth = {}; }
  if (typeof active === 'boolean') k.active = active;
  persist(); return { ok: true };
}

export function setRotationMode(mode) { if (['round_robin', 'least_loaded'].includes(mode)) rotationMode = mode; }
export function getRotationMode() { return rotationMode; }

function routeId(model, egressId) { return `${model}@@${egressId}`; }
function circuitId(model, egressId) { return `${model}@@${egressId}`; }

function routeReady(k, model, egress, now) {
  const egressId = egress.id;
  if (!k.active || k.state === 'auth_invalid') return false;
  if ((inFlight.get(k.id) || 0) >= KEY_MAX_CONCURRENCY) return false;
  if ((inFlightEgress.get(egressId) || 0) >= Number(egress.maxConcurrency || 1)) return false;
  const modelState = k.modelHealth[model];
  if (modelState?.status === 'unsupported') return false;
  if (Number(modelState?.blockedUntil || 0) > now) return false;
  if (Number(k.routeHealth[routeId(model, egressId)]?.cooldownUntil || 0) > now) return false;
  if (Number(health.egressModels?.[circuitId(model, egressId)]?.openUntil || 0) > now) return false;
  return true;
}

export function acquireRoute({ model, egresses, attempted = new Set(), preferredKeyId = '', now = Date.now() }) {
  cleanup(now);
  const candidates = [];
  for (const k of pool) for (const egress of egresses) {
    const id = `${k.id}@@${model}@@${egress.id}`;
    if (!attempted.has(id) && routeReady(k, model, egress, now)) candidates.push({ key: k, egress, id, egressCount: egresses.length });
  }
  if (!candidates.length) return null;
  candidates.sort((a, b) => {
    const aPreferred = a.key.id === preferredKeyId ? 0 : 1;
    const bPreferred = b.key.id === preferredKeyId ? 0 : 1;
    if (aPreferred !== bPreferred) return aPreferred - bPreferred;
    if (rotationMode === 'least_loaded') return usage24h(a.key, now).tokens - usage24h(b.key, now).tokens;
    const routeA = a.key.routeHealth[routeId(model, a.egress.id)]?.lastUsedAt || a.key.lastUsedAt || 0;
    const routeB = b.key.routeHealth[routeId(model, b.egress.id)]?.lastUsedAt || b.key.lastUsedAt || 0;
    return routeA - routeB || a.egress.priority - b.egress.priority;
  });
  const selected = candidates[0];
  inFlight.set(selected.key.id, (inFlight.get(selected.key.id) || 0) + 1);
  inFlightEgress.set(selected.egress.id, (inFlightEgress.get(selected.egress.id) || 0) + 1);
  attempted.add(selected.id);
  return selected;
}

export function releaseRoute(route) {
  if (!route?.key?.id) return;
  inFlight.set(route.key.id, Math.max(0, (inFlight.get(route.key.id) || 1) - 1));
  inFlightEgress.set(route.egress.id, Math.max(0, (inFlightEgress.get(route.egress.id) || 1) - 1));
}

function modelState(k, model) {
  return k.modelHealth[model] ||= { status: 'ready', blockedUntil: 0, evidence: {} };
}

function routeState(k, model, egressId) {
  return k.routeHealth[routeId(model, egressId)] ||= { failures: 0, cooldownUntil: 0, lastFailureAt: 0, lastSuccessAt: 0 };
}

function freeLimitBackoff(failures, retryAfterMs) {
  if (retryAfterMs > 0) return Math.min(retryAfterMs, FREE_LIMIT_MAX_BACKOFF_MS);
  return Math.min(FREE_LIMIT_RETRY_MS * 2 ** Math.max(0, failures - 1), FREE_LIMIT_MAX_BACKOFF_MS);
}

function recordEgressFailure(k, model, egressId, now, { allowHeuristicOpen = false, reason = '' } = {}) {
  const id = circuitId(model, egressId);
  const circuit = health.egressModels[id] ||= { failures: [], openUntil: 0, lastReason: '' };
  circuit.failures = circuit.failures.filter((f) => now - f.at <= EGRESS_CIRCUIT_WINDOW_MS);
  circuit.failures.push({ keyId: k.id, at: now });
  const distinct = new Set(circuit.failures.map((f) => f.keyId)).size;
  if (allowHeuristicOpen && distinct >= EGRESS_CIRCUIT_THRESHOLD) {
    circuit.openUntil = now + EGRESS_CIRCUIT_MS;
    circuit.confidence = 'heuristic';
    circuit.lastReason = reason || `${distinct} clés limitées sur l'unique egress ${egressId}/${model}`;
    console.warn(`[circuit] OPEN egress=${egressId} model=${model} keys=${distinct} until=${new Date(circuit.openUntil).toISOString()}`);
  }
}

function rollingUsage({ keyId = '', model = '', egressId = '', sinceMs = 60_000 }, now = Date.now()) {
  let tokens = 0, requests = 0;
  for (const k of pool) {
    if (keyId && k.id !== keyId) continue;
    for (const event of k.usageEvents) {
      if (now - event.at > sinceMs) continue;
      if (model && event.model !== model) continue;
      if (egressId && event.egressId !== egressId) continue;
      tokens += Number(event.tokens || 0);
      requests += Number(event.requests || 0);
    }
  }
  return { tokens, requests };
}

function appendHealthEvent(event) {
  health.events ||= [];
  health.events.push(event);
  if (health.events.length > 1000) health.events.splice(0, health.events.length - 1000);
}

export function recordRouteFailure(route, model, classification, detail = '') {
  const { key: k, egress } = route;
  const now = Date.now();
  const rs = routeState(k, model, egress.id);
  const ms = modelState(k, model);
  rs.failures += 1;
  rs.lastFailureAt = now;
  rs.lastKind = classification.kind;
  rs.cfRay = classification.cfRay || '';
  k.errors += 1;
  k.lastErrorKind = classification.kind;
  k.lastErrorDetail = String(detail || classification.message || '').slice(0, 400);
  k.lastErrorAt = now;

  if (classification.kind === 'auth_invalid') {
    k.state = 'auth_invalid';
  } else if (classification.kind === 'model_unsupported') {
    ms.status = 'unsupported';
    ms.blockedUntil = Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER;
  } else if (classification.kind === 'free_limit') {
    rs.cooldownUntil = now + freeLimitBackoff(rs.failures, classification.retryAfterMs);
    ms.evidence[egress.id] = now;
    // Avec plusieurs IP, deux clés épuisées ne prouvent pas que l'IP est limitée.
    // Avec une seule IP, on ouvre un circuit heuristique pour stopper la rafale.
    recordEgressFailure(k, model, egress.id, now, {
      allowHeuristicOpen: Number(route.egressCount || 1) === 1,
      reason: 'plusieurs clés limitées et aucun egress de comparaison',
    });
    const recentEgresses = Object.entries(ms.evidence).filter(([, at]) => now - at <= FREE_LIMIT_MAX_BACKOFF_MS).map(([id]) => id);
    const requiredEgresses = Math.max(QUOTA_CONFIRM_EGRESS_COUNT, Number(route.egressCount || 1));
    if (new Set(recentEgresses).size >= requiredEgresses) {
      ms.status = 'quota_suspected';
      ms.blockedUntil = now + QUOTA_RECHECK_MS;
      console.warn(`[pool] key=${k.name} model=${model} quota_suspected egresses=${recentEgresses.join(',')}`);
    }
  } else if (classification.kind === 'rate_limit' || classification.kind === 'saturation') {
    rs.cooldownUntil = now + Math.max(classification.retryAfterMs || FREE_LIMIT_RETRY_MS, 10_000);
    recordEgressFailure(k, model, egress.id, now, {
      allowHeuristicOpen: classification.kind === 'saturation' || Number(route.egressCount || 1) === 1,
      reason: classification.kind === 'saturation' ? 'saturation upstream explicite' : 'plusieurs clés limitées et aucun egress de comparaison',
    });
  } else if (classification.kind === 'server' || classification.kind === 'network') {
    rs.cooldownUntil = now + Math.min(30_000 * rs.failures, 300_000);
  }
  const keyMinute = rollingUsage({ keyId: k.id, model }, now);
  const egressMinute = rollingUsage({ model, egressId: egress.id }, now);
  appendHealthEvent({
    at: now, outcome: 'failure', keyId: k.id, model, egressId: egress.id,
    kind: classification.kind, status: classification.status, upstreamType: classification.upstreamType,
    retryAfterMs: classification.retryAfterMs || 0, cfRay: classification.cfRay || '',
    keyTokens1m: keyMinute.tokens, keyRequests1m: keyMinute.requests,
    egressTokens1m: egressMinute.tokens, egressRequests1m: egressMinute.requests,
  });
  persist();
}

export function recordRouteSuccess(route, model, tokens = 0, requests = 1) {
  const { key: k, egress } = route;
  const now = Date.now();
  const rs = routeState(k, model, egress.id);
  const ms = modelState(k, model);
  const failedEgresses = Object.keys(ms.evidence || {}).filter((id) => id !== egress.id);
  rs.failures = 0; rs.cooldownUntil = 0; rs.lastSuccessAt = now; rs.lastUsedAt = now;
  // La même clé vient de réussir ailleurs : les échecs précédents sont donc liés
  // à la route/IP/modèle, pas à un quota global de cette clé.
  for (const failedEgressId of failedEgresses) {
    const id = circuitId(model, failedEgressId);
    const circuit = health.egressModels[id] ||= { failures: [], openUntil: 0, lastReason: '' };
    circuit.openUntil = Math.max(circuit.openUntil || 0, now + EGRESS_CIRCUIT_MS);
    circuit.confidence = 'proven';
    circuit.lastReason = `même clé OK via ${egress.id} après limite via ${failedEgressId}`;
    console.warn(`[circuit] OPEN proven egress=${failedEgressId} model=${model} alternate=${egress.id} until=${new Date(circuit.openUntil).toISOString()}`);
  }
  ms.status = 'ready'; ms.blockedUntil = 0; ms.evidence = {};
  k.state = 'active'; k.lastUsedAt = now; k.errors = Math.max(0, k.errors - 1);
  k.usageEvents.push({ at: now, tokens: Number(tokens || 0), requests: Number(requests || 1), model, egressId: egress.id });
  const circuit = health.egressModels[circuitId(model, egress.id)];
  if (circuit) circuit.failures = circuit.failures.filter((f) => f.keyId !== k.id);
  appendHealthEvent({ at: now, outcome: 'success', keyId: k.id, model, egressId: egress.id, tokens: Number(tokens || 0) });
  persist();
}

// Compatibilité pour la découverte /models : direct, sans réservation durable.
export function selectBestKey() {
  cleanup();
  return pool.find((k) => k.active && k.state !== 'auth_invalid') || null;
}

export function poolRetryHint(model = '') {
  cleanup();
  const now = Date.now();
  const times = [];
  for (const k of pool) {
    if (!k.active || k.state === 'auth_invalid') continue;
    if (model && k.modelHealth[model]?.blockedUntil > now) times.push(k.modelHealth[model].blockedUntil);
    for (const [id, r] of Object.entries(k.routeHealth)) if ((!model || id.startsWith(`${model}@@`)) && r.cooldownUntil > now) times.push(r.cooldownUntil);
  }
  for (const [id, circuit] of Object.entries(health.egressModels || {})) if ((!model || id.startsWith(`${model}@@`)) && circuit.openUntil > now) times.push(circuit.openUntil);
  return { allCold: false, limited: times.length > 0, nextFreeMs: times.length ? Math.max(0, Math.min(...times) - now) : null };
}

// Ancienne API : le scheduler ne pilote plus les limites ambiguës.
export function collectWakeCandidates() { return []; }
export function wakeFailed() {}
export function wakeOk(id) { return setKeyStatus(id, { state: 'active' }); }
export function recordUsage(id, tokens, reqs = 1) {
  const k = pool.find((x) => x.id === id); if (!k) return;
  k.usageEvents.push({ at: Date.now(), tokens: Number(tokens || 0), requests: Number(reqs || 1), model: 'unknown', egressId: 'direct' }); persist();
}
export function recordError(id, type, detail = '') {
  const k = pool.find((x) => x.id === id); if (!k) return;
  k.errors += 1; k.lastErrorKind = type; k.lastErrorDetail = String(detail).slice(0, 400); k.lastErrorAt = Date.now(); persist();
}

export function poolHealth() {
  cleanup();
  return { egressModels: health.egressModels, events: health.events.slice(-200), inFlight: Object.fromEntries(inFlight), inFlightEgress: Object.fromEntries(inFlightEgress) };
}

```text
# side-channel-weakmap <sup>[![Version Badge][npm-version-svg]][package-url]</sup>

[![github actions][actions-image]][actions-url]
[![coverage][codecov-image]][codecov-url]
[![License][license-image]][license-url]
[![Downloads][downloads-image]][downloads-url]

[![npm badge][npm-badge-png]][package-url]

Store information about any JS value in a side channel. Uses WeakMap if available.

Warning: this implementation will leak memory until you `delete` the `key`.
Use [`side-channel`](https://npmjs.com/side-channel) for the best available strategy.

## Getting started

```sh
npm install --save side-channel-weakmap
```

## Usage/Examples

```js
const assert = require('assert');
const getSideChannelList = require('side-channel-weakmap');

const channel = getSideChannelList();

const key = {};
assert.equal(channel.has(key), false);
assert.throws(() => channel.assert(key), TypeError);

channel.set(key, 42);

channel.assert(key); // does not throw
assert.equal(channel.has(key), true);
assert.equal(channel.get(key), 42);

channel.delete(key);
assert.equal(channel.has(key), false);
assert.throws(() => channel.assert(key), TypeError);
```

## Tests

Clone the repo, `npm install`, and run `npm test`

### 📄 `data/infra_snapshots/objects/5c/c863fd64953afa39d206b510378b73e8c767c5fd124bb8d4017db921c94855`

```text
# mime-db

[![NPM Version][npm-version-image]][npm-url]
[![NPM Downloads][npm-downloads-image]][npm-url]
[![Node.js Version][node-image]][node-url]
[![Build Status][ci-image]][ci-url]
[![Coverage Status][coveralls-image]][coveralls-url]

This is a large database of mime types and information about them.
It consists of a single, public JSON file and does not include any logic,
allowing it to remain as un-opinionated as possible with an API.
It aggregates data from the following sources:

- http://www.iana.org/assignments/media-types/media-types.xhtml
- http://svn.apache.org/repos/asf/httpd/httpd/trunk/docs/conf/mime.types
- http://hg.nginx.org/nginx/raw-file/default/conf/mime.types

## Installation

```bash
npm install mime-db
```

### Database Download

If you're crazy enough to use this in the browser, you can just grab the
JSON file using [jsDelivr](https://www.jsdelivr.com/). It is recommended to
replace `master` with [a release tag](https://github.com/jshttp/mime-db/tags)
as the JSON format may change in the future.

```
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/jshttp/mime-db@master/db.json
```

## Usage

```js
var db = require('mime-db')

// grab data on .js files
var data = db['application/javascript']
```

## Data Structure

The JSON file is a map lookup for lowercased mime types.
Each mime type has the following properties:

- `.source` - where the mime type is defined.
    If not set, it's probably a custom media type.
    - `apache` - [Apache common media types](http://svn.apache.org/repos/asf/httpd/httpd/trunk/docs/conf/mime.types)
    - `iana` - [IANA-defined media types](http://www.iana.org/assignments/media-types/media-types.xhtml)
    - `nginx` - [nginx media types](http://hg.nginx.org/nginx/raw-file/default/conf/mime.types)
- `.extensions[]` - known extensions associated with this mime type.
- `.compressible` - whether a file of this type can be gzipped.
- `.charset` - the default charset associated with this type, if any.

If unknown, every property could be `undefined`.

## Contributing

To edit the database, only make PRs against `src/custom-types.json` or
`src/custom-suffix.json`.

The `src/custom-types.json` file is a JSON object with the MIME type as the
keys and the values being an object with the following keys:

- `compressible` - leave out if you don't know, otherwise `true`/`false` to
  indicate whether the data represented by the type is typically compressible.
- `extensions` - include an array of file extensions that are associated with
  the type.
- `notes` - human-readable notes about the type, typically what the type is.
- `sources` - include an array of URLs of where the MIME type and the associated
  extensions are sourced from. This needs to be a [primary source](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Primary_source);
  links to type aggregating sites and Wikipedia are _not acceptable_.

To update the build, run `npm run build`.

### Adding Custom Media Types

The best way to get new media types included in this library is to register
them with the IANA. The community registration procedure is outlined in
[RFC 6838 section 5](http://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc6838#section-5). Types
registered with the IANA are automatically pulled into this library.

If that is not possible / feasible, they can be added directly here as a
"custom" type. To do this, it is required to have a primary source that
definitively lists the media type. If an extension is going to be listed as
associateed with this media type, the source must definitively link the
media type and extension as well.

[coveralls-url]: https://coveralls.io/r/jshttp/mime-db?branch=master

  kClients,
  kNeedDrain,
  kAddClient,
  kGetDispatcher

const Client = require('./client')
const {
  InvalidArgumentError
} = require('../core/errors')
const util = require('../core/util')
const { kUrl, kInterceptors } = require('../core/symbols')
const buildConnector = require('../core/connect')

const kOptions = Symbol('options')
const kConnections = Symbol('connections')
const kFactory = Symbol('factory')

function defaultFactory (origin, opts) {
  return new Client(origin, opts)
}

class Pool extends PoolBase {
  constructor (origin, {
    connections,
    factory = defaultFactory,
    connect,
    connectTimeout,
    tls,
    maxCachedSessions,
    socketPath,
    autoSelectFamily,
    autoSelectFamilyAttemptTimeout,
    allowH2,
    ...options
  } = {}) {
    if (connections != null && (!Number.isFinite(connections) || connections < 0)) {
      throw new InvalidArgumentError('invalid connections')
    }

    if (typeof factory !== 'function') {
      throw new InvalidArgumentError('factory must be a function.')
    }

    if (connect != null && typeof connect !== 'function' && typeof connect !== 'object') {
      throw new InvalidArgumentError('connect must be a function or an object')
    }

    if (typeof connect !== 'function') {
      connect = buildConnector({
        ...tls,
        maxCachedSessions,
        allowH2,
        socketPath,
        timeout: connectTimeout,
        ...(autoSelectFamily ? { autoSelectFamily, autoSelectFamilyAttemptTimeout } : undefined),
        ...connect
      })
    }

    super(options)

    this[kInterceptors] = options.interceptors?.Pool && Array.isArray(options.interceptors.Pool)
      ? options.interceptors.Pool
      : []
    this[kConnections] = connections || null
    this[kUrl] = util.parseOrigin(origin)
    this[kOptions] = { ...util.deepClone(options), connect, allowH2 }
    this[kOptions].interceptors = options.interceptors
      ? { ...options.interceptors }
      : undefined
    this[kFactory] = factory

    this.on('connectionError', (origin, targets, error) => {
      // If a connection error occurs, we remove the client from the pool,
      // and emit a connectionError event. They will not be re-used.
      // Fixes https://github.com/nodejs/undici/issues/3895
      for (const target of targets) {
        // Do not use kRemoveClient here, as it will close the client,
        // but the client cannot be closed in this state.
        const idx = this[kClients].indexOf(target)
        if (idx !== -1) {
          this[kClients].splice(idx, 1)
        }
      }
    })
  }

  [kGetDispatcher] () {
    for (const client of this[kClients]) {
      if (!client[kNeedDrain]) {
        return client
      }
    }

    if (!this[kConnections] || this[kClients].length < this[kConnections]) {
      const dispatcher = this[kFactory](this[kUrl], this[kOptions])
      this[kAddClient](dispatcher)
      return dispatcher
    }
  }
}

module.exports = Pool

### 📄 `data/infra_snapshots/objects/5c/e564bb53fafd87b543f144e04955d128199205cf07bff442f3b875ca90d422`

```text
# es-define-property <sup>[![Version Badge][npm-version-svg]][package-url]</sup>

[![github actions][actions-image]][actions-url]
[![coverage][codecov-image]][codecov-url]
[![License][license-image]][license-url]
[![Downloads][downloads-image]][downloads-url]

[![npm badge][npm-badge-png]][package-url]

`Object.defineProperty`, but not IE 8's broken one.

## Example

```js
const assert = require('assert');

const $defineProperty = require('es-define-property');

if ($defineProperty) {
    assert.equal($defineProperty, Object.defineProperty);
} else if (Object.defineProperty) {
    assert.equal($defineProperty, false, 'this is IE 8');
} else {
    assert.equal($defineProperty, false, 'this is an ES3 engine');
}
```

## Tests
Simply clone the repo, `npm install`, and run `npm test`

## Security

Please email [@ljharb](https://github.com/ljharb) or see https://tidelift.com/security if you have a potential security vulnerability to report.

```text
import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { classifyUpstream } from '../src/upstreamError.js';
import { parseContextOverrides, isFreeModel, isAllowed } from '../src/modelRegistry.js';

test('isFreeModel identifie les modèles -free et big-pickle', () => {
  assert.equal(isFreeModel('big-pickle'), true);
  assert.equal(isFreeModel('mimo-v2.5-free'), true);
  assert.equal(isFreeModel('nemotron-3.5-lightning-free'), true);
  assert.equal(isFreeModel('muse-spark-1.2-contributor-free'), true);
  assert.equal(isFreeModel('hy3-free'), true);
  assert.equal(isFreeModel('x-preview-f-free'), true);
  assert.equal(isFreeModel('claude-sonnet-4-5'), false);
  assert.equal(isFreeModel('gemini-3.7-flash'), false);
  assert.equal(isFreeModel('grok-4.6'), false);
});

test('classifyUpstream: nouveau format Model is unavailable HTTP 400', () => {
  const body = JSON.stringify({
    error: { type: 'server_error', message: 'Error from provider (Console): Upstream request failed: Model is unavailable.' },
  });
  const result = classifyUpstream(400, body);
  assert.equal(result.kind, 'model_unsupported');
  assert.equal(result.scope, 'model');
  assert.equal(result.retriable, false);
});

test('classifyUpstream: Free promotion has ended HTTP 401', () => {
  const body = JSON.stringify({
    type: 'error',
    error: { type: 'ModelError', message: 'Free promotion has ended for DeepSeek V4 Flash Free. You can continue using the model by subscribing to OpenCode Go' },
  });
  const result = classifyUpstream(401, body);
  assert.equal(result.kind, 'model_unsupported');
  assert.equal(result.scope, 'model');
  assert.equal(result.retriable, false);
});

test('classifyUpstream: Model not supported HTTP 401', () => {
  const body = JSON.stringify({
    error: { type: 'ModelError', message: 'Model ling-3.0-flash-free is not supported' },
  });
  const result = classifyUpstream(401, body);
  assert.equal(result.kind, 'model_unsupported');
  assert.equal(result.scope, 'model');
  assert.equal(result.retriable, false);
});

test('parseContextOverrides: parse string et JSON', () => {
  // Test format vide
  assert.deepEqual(parseContextOverrides(), {});

  // Test format regex/virgule
  process.env.MODEL_CONTEXT_OVERRIDES = 'big-pickle:340000,mimo-v2.5-free:250000:64000';
  const parsed = parseContextOverrides();
  assert.equal(parsed['big-pickle'].context, 340000);
  assert.equal(parsed['mimo-v2.5-free'].context, 250000);
  assert.equal(parsed['mimo-v2.5-free'].output, 64000);
  delete process.env.MODEL_CONTEXT_OVERRIDES;
});

```

```text
import { PollinationsConfigV5 } from './config.js';
import { t } from '../locales/index.js';
import { getQuotaStatus } from './quota.js';

export async function buildConnectResponse(config: PollinationsConfigV5): Promise<string> {
    const hasKey = !!config.apiKey;
    const mode = config.mode;

    let name = "Developer";
    let tier = "anonymous";
    let tierEmoji = '👤';

    if (hasKey) {
        try {
            // Use getQuotaStatus which deduces allowance from usage (tier no longer in /account/profile)
            const quota = await getQuotaStatus(true);
            tier = quota.tier || 'anonymous';
            tierEmoji = quota.tierEmoji || '👤';
        } catch (e) {
            // Ignorer l'erreur réseau et garder les valeurs par défaut
        }

        try {
            const res = await fetch('https://gen.pollinations.ai/account/profile', {
                headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${config.apiKey}` }
            });
            if (res.ok) {
                const data: any = await res.json();
                if (data.githubUsername) name = data.githubUsername;
            }
        } catch (e) {
            // Ignorer
        }
    }

    if (hasKey) {
        return `${t('connect_response.title_key', { name, mode })}

> **Your Tier:** ${tierEmoji} ${tier.toUpperCase()}

---

${t('connect_response.tools_intro')}

---

${t('connect_response.terminal_cmds')}
---

${t('connect_response.resources')}`;
    }

    let freeModelsText = `Modèles gratuits disponibles : \`openai-fast\`, \`gemini-fast\`, \`mistral\`, \`qwen-coder\`, \`nova-fast\``;
    try {
        const freeRes = await fetch('https://text.pollinations.ai/models', { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(4000) });
        if (freeRes.ok) {
            const freeData = await freeRes.json();
            const modelsList = freeData.slice(0, 15).map((m: any) => `\`${m.name}\``).join(', ');
            freeModelsText = t('connect_response.free_models_success', { models: modelsList });
        } else {
            freeModelsText = t('connect_response.free_models_error');
        }
    } catch (e) {
        freeModelsText = t('connect_response.free_models_error');
    }

    return t('connect_response.onboarding', { freeText: freeModelsText });
}

```

var inspect = require('../');
var test = require('tape');

test('element', function (t) {
    t.plan(3);
    var elem = {
        nodeName: 'div',
        attributes: [{ name: 'class', value: 'row' }],
        getAttribute: function (key) { return key; },
        childNodes: []
    };
    var obj = [1, elem, 3];
    t.deepEqual(inspect(obj), '[ 1, <div class="row"></div>, 3 ]');
    t.deepEqual(inspect(obj, { quoteStyle: 'single' }), "[ 1, <div class='row'></div>, 3 ]");
    t.deepEqual(inspect(obj, { quoteStyle: 'double' }), '[ 1, <div class="row"></div>, 3 ]');
});

test('element no attr', function (t) {
    t.plan(1);
    var elem = {
        nodeName: 'div',
        getAttribute: function (key) { return key; },
        childNodes: []
    };
    var obj = [1, elem, 3];
    t.deepEqual(inspect(obj), '[ 1, <div></div>, 3 ]');
});

test('element with contents', function (t) {
    t.plan(1);
    var elem = {
        nodeName: 'div',
        getAttribute: function (key) { return key; },
        childNodes: [{ nodeName: 'b' }]
    };
    var obj = [1, elem, 3];
    t.deepEqual(inspect(obj), '[ 1, <div>...</div>, 3 ]');
});

test('element instance', function (t) {
    t.plan(1);
    var h = global.HTMLElement;
    global.HTMLElement = function (name, attr) {
        this.nodeName = name;
        this.attributes = attr;
    };
    global.HTMLElement.prototype.getAttribute = function () {};

    var elem = new global.HTMLElement('div', []);
    var obj = [1, elem, 3];
    t.deepEqual(inspect(obj), '[ 1, <div></div>, 3 ]');
    global.HTMLElement = h;
});

for (const lang of LANG_FILES) {
    const langKey = lang.replace('.json', '');
    const filePath = path.join(localesDir, lang);
    const data = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(filePath, 'utf-8'));

    const langUpdates = updates[langKey];
    if (!langUpdates) continue;

    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(langUpdates)) {
        const parts = key.split('.');
        let obj = data;
        for (let i = 0; i < parts.length - 1; i++) {
            obj = obj[parts[i]];
        }
        obj[parts[parts.length - 1]] = value;
    }

    // Also update connect_response.resources link
    if (data.connect_response?.resources) {
        data.connect_response.resources = data.connect_response.resources
            .replace('https://pollinations.ai/topup', 'https://enter.pollinations.ai')
            .replace('Top-Up Balance', 'Dashboard')
            .replace('Recharger le Wallet', 'Dashboard')
            .replace('Recargar saldo', 'Dashboard')
            .replace('Recharge Balance', 'Dashboard')
            .replace('Top-Up Wallet', 'Dashboard')
            .replace('充值钱包', 'Dashboard')
            .replace('充值余额', 'Dashboard');
    }

    // Remove beta_note if it exists
    if (data.commands?.infos?.beta_note) {
        delete data.commands.infos.beta_note;
    }

    fs.writeFileSync(filePath, JSON.stringify(data, null, 2) + '\n', 'utf-8');
    console.log(`✅ ${lang} — infos updated`);
}

'use strict';

var test = require('tape');

var getSideChannelList = require('../');

test('getSideChannelList', function (t) {
	t.test('export', function (st) {
		st.equal(typeof getSideChannelList, 'function', 'is a function');

		st.equal(getSideChannelList.length, 0, 'takes no arguments');

		var channel = getSideChannelList();
		st.ok(channel, 'is truthy');
		st.equal(typeof channel, 'object', 'is an object');
		st.end();
	});

	t.test('assert', function (st) {
		var channel = getSideChannelList();
		st['throws'](
			function () { channel.assert({}); },
			TypeError,
			'nonexistent value throws'
		);

		var o = {};
		channel.set(o, 'data');
		st.doesNotThrow(function () { channel.assert(o); }, 'existent value noops');

		st.end();
	});

	t.test('has', function (st) {
		var channel = getSideChannelList();
		/** @type {unknown[]} */ var o = [];

		st.equal(channel.has(o), false, 'nonexistent value yields false');

		channel.set(o, 'foo');
		st.equal(channel.has(o), true, 'existent value yields true');

		st.equal(channel.has('abc'), false, 'non object value non existent yields false');

		channel.set('abc', 'foo');
		st.equal(channel.has('abc'), true, 'non object value that exists yields true');

		st.end();
	});

	t.test('get', function (st) {
		var channel = getSideChannelList();
		var o = {};
		st.equal(channel.get(o), undefined, 'nonexistent value yields undefined');

		var data = {};
		channel.set(o, data);
		st.equal(channel.get(o), data, '"get" yields data set by "set"');

		st.end();
	});

	t.test('set', function (st) {
		var channel = getSideChannelList();
		var o = function () {};
		st.equal(channel.get(o), undefined, 'value not set');

		channel.set(o, 42);
		st.equal(channel.get(o), 42, 'value was set');

		channel.set(o, Infinity);
		st.equal(channel.get(o), Infinity, 'value was set again');

		var o2 = {};
		channel.set(o2, 17);
		st.equal(channel.get(o), Infinity, 'o is not modified');
		st.equal(channel.get(o2), 17, 'o2 is set');

		channel.set(o, 14);
		st.equal(channel.get(o), 14, 'o is modified');
		st.equal(channel.get(o2), 17, 'o2 is not modified');

		st.end();
	});

	t.test('delete', function (st) {
		var channel = getSideChannelList();
		var o = {};
		st.equal(channel['delete']({}), false, 'nonexistent value yields false');

		channel.set(o, 42);
		st.equal(channel.has(o), true, 'value is set');

		st.equal(channel['delete']({}), false, 'nonexistent value still yields false');

		st.equal(channel['delete'](o), true, 'deleted value yields true');

		st.equal(channel.has(o), false, 'value is no longer set');

		st.end();
	});

	t.test('delete: first node in a multi-node list', function (st) {
		var channel = getSideChannelList();

		channel.set('a', 1);
		channel.set('b', 2);

		st.equal(channel['delete']('b'), true, 'deleting first data node yields true');

		st.equal(channel.has('a'), true, 'second node is still present after deleting first');
		st.equal(channel.get('a'), 1, 'second node value is intact after deleting first');
		st.equal(channel.has('b'), false, 'deleted node is gone');

		st.end();
	});

	t.test('delete: last remaining node empties the list', function (st) {
		var channel = getSideChannelList();

		channel.set('a', 1);
		channel.set('b', 2);

		st.equal(channel['delete']('b'), true, 'delete first node');
		st.equal(channel['delete']('a'), true, 'delete second (last) node');

		st.equal(channel.has('a'), false, 'a is gone');
		st.equal(channel.has('b'), false, 'b is gone');
		st.equal(channel.get('a'), undefined, 'get a yields undefined');

		channel.set('c', 3);
		st.equal(channel.get('c'), 3, 'can set new values after emptying');

		st.end();
	});

	t.test('delete: middle node in a multi-node list', function (st) {
		var channel = getSideChannelList();

		channel.set('a', 1);
		channel.set('b', 2);
		channel.set('c', 3);

		st.equal(channel['delete']('b'), true, 'deleting middle node yields true');

		st.equal(channel.get('a'), 1, 'first node still intact');
		st.equal(channel.has('b'), false, 'middle node is gone');
		st.equal(channel.get('c'), 3, 'last node still intact');

		st.end();
	});

	t.end();
});

 * Set an object of headers on a response.
 *
 * @param {object} res
 * @param {object} headers
 * @private
 */

function setHeaders (res, headers) {
  var keys = Object.keys(headers)

  for (var i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
    var key = keys[i]
    res.setHeader(key, headers[key])
  }
}

import express from 'express';
import { createServer } from 'node:http';
import { WebSocketServer } from 'ws';
import morgan from 'morgan';
import { join, dirname } from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import { PORT, HOST, ADMIN_TOKEN, ADMIN_USERNAME, ADMIN_PASSWORD, COOKIE_SECRET, FOCUS_MODEL, FALLBACK_MODELS, ZEN_BASE_URL,
  getRuntimeConfig, setRuntimeConfig, resetRuntimeConfig } from './config.js';
import { relay } from './relay.js';
import { listKeys, addKey, removeKey, updateKey, setKeyStatus, getRotationMode, setRotationMode } from './keyPool.js';
import { filteredModels, allowedModels, applyLimits } from './modelRegistry.js';
import { listClientKeys, addClientKey, removeClientKey, updateClientKey, verifyClientKey } from './auth.js';
import { ipLimiter } from './rateLimiter.js';
import { startWakeScheduler } from './wake.js';
import { createHash, randomBytes, timingSafeEqual } from 'node:crypto';

const __dirname = dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));

const app = express();
app.use(morgan('combined'));
app.set('view engine', 'ejs');
app.set('views', join(__dirname, '../views'));
// ─── Auth middleware (clés d'appel master) ─────────────────────
function requireClient(req, res, next) {
  const auth = req.headers['authorization'] || '';
  const proxyKey = req.headers['x-proxy-key'] || '';
  const token = auth.startsWith('Bearer ') ? auth.slice(7) : (proxyKey || '');
  const ok = verifyClientKey(token);
  if (!ok) {
    return res.status(401).json({ error: { message: 'Clé API invalide ou manquante', type: 'auth_error', code: 401 } });
  }
  req.clientKeyId = ok;
  next();
}

function requireAdmin(req, res, next) {
  // Bearer ADMIN_TOKEN (API) OU session login (dashboard UI)
  const auth = req.headers['authorization'] || '';
  const token = auth.startsWith('Bearer ') ? auth.slice(7) : '';
  if (token && timingSafeEqualStrings(token, ADMIN_TOKEN)) return next();
  if (isSessionValid(req)) return next();
  return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Admin token requis' });
}

function timingSafeEqualStrings(a, b) {
  const ha = createHash('sha256').update(a).digest();
  const hb = createHash('sha256').update(b).digest();
  return timingSafeEqual(ha, hb);
}

// ─── Session login (dashboard) ───────────────────────────────────
function signSession() {
  const payload = Buffer.from(JSON.stringify({ u: ADMIN_USERNAME, exp: Date.now() + 12 * 3600 * 1000 })).toString('base64url');
  const sig = createHash('sha256').update(payload + COOKIE_SECRET).digest('hex');
  return `${payload}.${sig}`;
}
function verifySession(token) {
  try {
    const [payload, sig] = token.split('.');
    const expect = createHash('sha256').update(payload + COOKIE_SECRET).digest('hex');
    if (sig !== expect) return false;
    const data = JSON.parse(Buffer.from(payload, 'base64url').toString());
    return data.u === ADMIN_USERNAME && data.exp > Date.now();
  } catch { return false; }
}
function isSessionValid(req) {
  const c = (req.headers.cookie || '').match(/zen_session=([^;]+)/);
  return c ? verifySession(c[1]) : false;
}
function clearSession(res) {
  res.setHeader('Set-Cookie', 'zen_session=; Path=/; HttpOnly; Max-Age=0');
}

// ─── Santé publique ────────────────────────────────────────────────
app.get('/health', (_req, res) => {
  res.json({ ok: true, service: 'zen-proxy', version: '1.0.0', focus: FOCUS_MODEL });
});

// ─── Modèles (liste filtrée free) ─────────────────────────────────
app.get('/v1/models', requireClient, ipLimiter, async (req, res) => {
  const out = await filteredModels(req.query);
  res.json(out);
});

// ─── Chat completions (relay + whitelist) ─────────────────────────
app.post('/v1/chat/completions', requireClient, ipLimiter, async (req, res) => {
  const bodyText = await rawBody(req);
  let parsed;
  try { parsed = JSON.parse(bodyText); } catch { parsed = {}; }
  const model = parsed.model;
  if (!model) return res.status(400).json({ error: { message: 'model requis', type: 'invalid_request', code: 400 } });

  const allowed = (await allowedModels()).map((m) => m.id);
  const permit = [...new Set([...allowed, FOCUS_MODEL, ...FALLBACK_MODELS])];
  if (!permit.includes(model)) {
    return res.status(403).json({
      error: {
        message: `zen-proxy: modèle '${model}' non autorisé (whitelist free uniquement).`,
        type: 'forbidden_model',
        code: 403,
      },
    });
  }
  await relay(req, res, '/chat/completions', bodyText);
});

// ─── Catch-all autres routes /v1/* (responses, etc.) ─────────────
app.all('/v1/*', requireClient, ipLimiter, async (req, res) => {
  const bodyText = (req.method === 'POST' || req.method === 'PUT') ? await rawBody(req) : undefined;
  await relay(req, res, req.path.slice(4), bodyText);
});

// ─── Status / usage (master key) ──────────────────────────────────
app.get('/_status', requireClient, (_req, res) => {
  res.json({ keys: listKeys() });
});
app.get('/_usage', requireClient, (_req, res) => {
  const keys = listKeys();
  res.json({
    today: {
      tokens: keys.reduce((a, k) => a + k.tokensToday, 0),
      requests: keys.reduce((a, k) => a + k.reqToday, 0),
    },
    keys,
  });
});

// ─── Écran racine : connexion obligatoire avant le dashboard ────
app.get('/', (req, res) => {
  if (isSessionValid(req)) return res.redirect('/admin/dashboard');
  return res.redirect('/login');
});

app.get('/login', (req, res) => {
  if (isSessionValid(req)) return res.redirect('/admin/dashboard');
  res.render('login', { error: null });
});

app.post('/login', express.urlencoded({ extended: false }), (req, res) => {
  const { username, password } = req.body || {};
  const okU = timingSafeEqualStrings(username || '', ADMIN_USERNAME);
  const okP = timingSafeEqualStrings(password || '', ADMIN_PASSWORD);
  if (okU && okP) {
    res.setHeader('Set-Cookie', `zen_session=${signSession()}; Path=/; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax`);
    return res.redirect('/admin/dashboard');
  }
  res.status(200).render('login', { error: 'Identifiants incorrects' });
});

app.post('/logout', (req, res) => { clearSession(res); res.redirect('/login'); });

// ─── Dashboard admin (UI) ──────────────────────────────────────────
app.get('/admin', (req, res) => {
  if (!isSessionValid(req)) return res.redirect('/login');
  return res.redirect('/admin/dashboard');
});
app.get('/admin/dashboard', (req, res) => {
  if (!isSessionValid(req)) return res.redirect('/login');
  res.render('dashboard', { focus: FOCUS_MODEL });
});
app.get('/admin/modeles', (req, res) => {
  if (!isSessionValid(req)) return res.redirect('/login');
  res.render('modeles', { focus: FOCUS_MODEL });
});
app.get('/admin/config', (req, res) => {
  if (!isSessionValid(req)) return res.redirect('/login');
  res.render('config', { focus: FOCUS_MODEL });
});

app.get('/admin/api/dashboard', async (req, res) => {
  if (!isSessionValid(req)) return res.status(401).json({ error: 'session requise' });
  const [keys, clients, models] = await Promise.all([
    Promise.resolve(listKeys()),
    Promise.resolve(listClientKeys()),
    allowedModels(),
  ]);
  res.json({
    focus: FOCUS_MODEL,
    totalTokens: keys.reduce((a, k) => a + k.tokensToday, 0),
    totalReq: keys.reduce((a, k) => a + k.reqToday, 0),
    nbKeysActive: keys.filter((k) => k.active).length,
    keys,
    clients,
    nbModels: models.length,
  });
});

// Liste des modèles free pour l'UI admin (session requise, pas de clé client)
// Limites : dynamiques depuis models.dev (via applyLimits), fallback local.
app.get('/admin/api/modeles', async (req, res) => {
  if (!isSessionValid(req)) return res.status(401).json({ error: 'session requise' });
  const all = await allowedModels();
  const withLimits = await applyLimits(all);
  res.json({ focus: FOCUS_MODEL, data: withLimits });
});

// ─── Admin API (Bearer ADMIN_TOKEN) ───────────────────────────────
app.use('/admin/api', requireAdmin, express.json());

app.post('/admin/api/zen-keys', async (req, res) => {
  const { name, email, api_key } = req.body || {};
  const r = addKey({ name, email, apiKey: api_key });
  if (!r.ok) return res.json(r);

  // Probe de validation immédiate : confirme que la clé marche et renvoie le message réel
  const probe = await probeZenKey(api_key);
  res.json({ ...r, probe });
});

// Vérifie une clé Zen avec une mini-requête (10 tokens) — sans toucher au pool
async function probeZenKey(apiKey) {
  try {
    const ctrl = new AbortController();
    const t = setTimeout(() => ctrl.abort(), 20000);
    const resp = await fetch(`${ZEN_BASE_URL}/chat/completions`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${apiKey}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ model: 'deepseek-v4-flash-free', messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'ping' }], max_tokens: 10 }),
      signal: ctrl.signal,
    });
    clearTimeout(t);
    const text = await resp.text();
    let msg = '';
    try { const j = JSON.parse(text); msg = j?.error?.message || j?.error?.type || ''; } catch { msg = text.slice(0, 200); }
    if (resp.ok) return { probe: { ok: true, status: resp.status, message: 'clé validée' } };
    return { probe: { ok: false, status: resp.status, message: msg.slice(0, 300) } };
  } catch (e) {
    return { probe: { ok: false, status: 0, message: `timeout/réseau: ${e.message.slice(0, 120)}` } };
  }
}
app.delete('/admin/api/zen-keys/:id', (req, res) => {
  removeKey(req.params.id);
  res.json({ ok: true });
});
app.patch('/admin/api/zen-keys/:id', (req, res) => {
  // route complète : active + state (réveil manuel des clés COLD)
  if (req.body?.state) {
    const r = setKeyStatus(req.params.id, { active: req.body?.active, state: req.body?.state });
    return res.json(r);
  }
  const r = updateKey(req.params.id, {
    name: req.body?.name,
    email: req.body?.email,
    apiKey: req.body?.api_key,
    active: req.body?.active,
  });
  res.json(r);
});
app.delete('/admin/api/zen-keys/:id', (req, res) => {
  removeKey(req.params.id);
  res.json({ ok: true });
});

app.post('/admin/api/client-keys', (req, res) => {
  const r = addClientKey(req.body?.label);
  res.json(r);
});
app.patch('/admin/api/client-keys/:id', (req, res) => {
  const r = updateClientKey(req.params.id, { label: req.body?.label, active: req.body?.active });
  res.json(r);
});
app.delete('/admin/api/client-keys/:id', (req, res) => {
  removeClientKey(req.params.id);
  res.json({ ok: true });
});

// ─── Config runtime (lecture/écriture à chaud) ────────────────────
// Protégé par le middleware requireAdmin (Bearer ADMIN_TOKEN ou session)
app.get('/admin/api/config', (req, res) => {
  res.json({
    runtime: getRuntimeConfig(),
    rotationMode: getRotationMode(),
    defaults: {
      ZEN_BASE_URL: process.env.ZEN_BASE_URL || undefined,
      FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS: 15000,
      RETRY_BACKOFF_MS: 2000,
      RETRY_TOTAL_BUDGET_MS: 120000,
      COOLDOWN_SECONDS: 60,
      QUOTA_PAUSE_MS: 600000,
      QUOTA_COLD_THRESHOLD: 5,
      COLD_WAKE_BACKOFF_HOURS: 1,
      COLD_WAKE_MAX_BACKOFF_HOURS: 12,
      MODEL_CACHE_TTL: 3600,
      FREE_ONLY: true,
      FOCUS_MODEL: 'deepseek-v4-flash-free',
      IP_RPM: 60, IP_RPD: 2000, MAX_CONCURRENT_PER_IP: 4,
    },
  });
});

app.patch('/admin/api/config', (req, res) => {
  const body = req.body || {};
  if (body.rotationMode) setRotationMode(body.rotationMode);
  const r = setRuntimeConfig(body.runtime || {});
  res.json({ ok: r.ok, updated: r.updated, rotationMode: getRotationMode() });
});

app.post('/admin/api/config/reset', (req, res) => {
  resetRuntimeConfig(req.body?.keys || null);
  res.json({ ok: true });
});

// ─── WebSocket live ────────────────────────────────────────────────
const httpServer = createServer(app);
const wss = new WebSocketServer({ server: httpServer, path: '/ws' });
wss.on('connection', (ws) => ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'connected', ts: Date.now() })));

// ─── Démarrage ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
httpServer.listen(PORT, HOST, () => {
  console.log(`zen-proxy écoute sur http://${HOST}:${PORT}`);
  startWakeScheduler();
});

function rawBody(req) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const chunks = [];
    req.on('data', (c) => chunks.push(c));
    req.on('end', () => resolve(Buffer.concat(chunks).toString('utf8')));
    req.on('error', reject);
  });
}

<p>Connecter les agents à vos applications (CRM, ERP, messagerie) sans tout donner.</p>
<div class="stack mt-1">

<ul><li>Identifier les bonnes interfaces métier</li><li>Exposer des actions contrôlées</li><li>Gérer identités et validation</li></ul>
<h2>Compétences visées</h2>
<ul><li>Intégration métier</li><li>Actions contrôlées</li><li>Identités</li></ul>
<h2>Programme détaillé</h2>
<ol><li>APIs métier : ce qu'on peut confier</li><li>Actions contrôlées et scopes</li><li>Identités et comptes de service</li><li>Validation des actions sensibles</li><li>TP : agent connecté à une appli</li></ol>
<h2>Cas pratiques</h2>
<ul><li>Cadrer la connexion d'un agent à un CRM</li></ul>
<h2>Modalités pédagogiques</h2>
<p>TP intensifs, analyse d'erreurs, production, transfert</p>
<h2>Exercices</h2>
<p>TP de connexion d'outils et de serveurs MCP.</p>
<h2>Outils utilisés</h2>
<p>API de démonstration</p>
<h2>Évaluation</h2>
<p>TP noté.</p>
<h2>Supports</h2>
<p>Supports de cours et ressources distribués aux participants.</p>

'use strict'

const assert = require('node:assert')
const { URLSerializer } = require('../fetch/data-url')
const { isValidHeaderName } = require('../fetch/util')

/**
 * @see https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-equals
 * @param {URL} A
 * @param {URL} B
 * @param {boolean | undefined} excludeFragment
 * @returns {boolean}
 */
function urlEquals (A, B, excludeFragment = false) {
  const serializedA = URLSerializer(A, excludeFragment)

  const serializedB = URLSerializer(B, excludeFragment)

  return serializedA === serializedB
}

/**
 * @see https://github.com/chromium/chromium/blob/694d20d134cb553d8d89e5500b9148012b1ba299/content/browser/cache_storage/cache_storage_cache.cc#L260-L262
 * @param {string} header
 */
function getFieldValues (header) {
  assert(header !== null)

  const values = []

  for (let value of header.split(',')) {
    value = value.trim()

    if (isValidHeaderName(value)) {
      values.push(value)
    }
  }

  return values
}

module.exports = {
  urlEquals,
  getFieldValues
}
