## 4. Endpoint Image & Vidéo

### 🎯 Endpoint Unique

```
GET /image/{prompt}
Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY
```

### Paramètres Query - Image

| Paramètre | Type | Défaut | Min | Max | Modèles Concernés |
|-----------|------|--------|-----|-----|-------------------|
| `model` | string | `flux` | - | - | Tous |
| `width` | integer | `1024` | 64 | 2048 | Image uniquement |
| `height` | integer | `1024` | 64 | 2048 | Image uniquement |
| `seed` | integer | `0` | -1 | 2147483647 | Tous |
| `enhance` | boolean | `false` | - | - | Tous |
| `negative_prompt` | string | `"worst quality, blurry"` | - | - | Image |
| `safe` | boolean | `false` | - | - | Tous |
| `image` | string | `null` | - | - | Img2Img, Vid2Vid |
| `quality` | string | `medium` | - | - | `gptimage` uniquement |
| `transparent` | boolean | `false` | - | - | `gptimage` uniquement |

### Paramètres Query - Vidéo

| Paramètre | Type | Défaut | Min | Max | Modèles Concernés |
|-----------|------|--------|-----|-----|-------------------|
| `model` | string | `veo` | - | - | `veo`, `seedance` |
| `duration` | integer | `5` | Voir ci-dessous | Voir ci-dessous | Vidéo uniquement |
| `aspectRatio` | string | `16:9` | - | - | `16:9`, `9:16` |
| `audio` | boolean | `false` | - | - | `veo` uniquement |
| `image` | string | `null` | 1-2 URLs | - | Interpolation |

### ⚠️ Spécifications Vidéo Précises

#### Modèle VEO

| Paramètre | Valeurs Acceptées | Détails |
|-----------|-------------------|---------|
| `duration` | `4`, `6`, `8` | Secondes exactes uniquement |
| `aspectRatio` | `16:9`, `9:16` | Paysage ou Portrait |
| `audio` | `true`, `false` | Génération audio synchronisée |
| `image` (interpolation) | 1 ou 2 URLs | `image[0]` = frame début, `image[1]` = frame fin |
| `image` (single) | 1 URL | Image-to-Video (première frame) |

**Exemple Interpolation VEO:**
```bash
GET /image/a%20smooth%20transition?model=veo&duration=6&aspectRatio=16:9&image=https://start.jpg|https://end.jpg&audio=true
```

#### Modèle SEEDANCE

| Paramètre | Valeurs Acceptées | Détails |
|-----------|-------------------|---------|
| `duration` | `2` à `10` | Secondes (incrément 1) |
| `aspectRatio` | `16:9`, `9:16` | Paysage ou Portrait |
| `image` | 1 ou 2 URLs | Text-to-Video ou Image-to-Video |
| `audio` | Non supporté | - |

**Exemple Seedance:**
```bash
GET /image/dancing%20character?model=seedance&duration=5&aspectRatio=9:16&image=https://reference.jpg
```

### Modèles Image Disponibles

| Modèle | Type | Résolution Max | Transparent | Quality Param | Temps Moyen |
|--------|------|----------------|-------------|---------------|-------------|
| `flux` | Image | 2048x2048 | ❌ | ❌ | 5-10s |
| `flux-turbo` | Image | 1024x1024 | ❌ | ❌ | 2-5s |
| `gptimage` | Image | 2048x2048 | ✅ | ✅ | 10-15s |
| `kontext` | Image | 1024x1024 | ❌ | ❌ | 5-10s |
| `seedream` | Image | 2048x2048 | ❌ | ❌ | 8-12s |
| `seedream-pro` | Image | 4096x4096 | ❌ | ✅ | 15-20s |
| `nanobanana` | Image | 1024x1024 | ❌ | ❌ | 3-7s |
| `nanobanana-pro` | Image | 2048x2048 | ❌ | ❌ | 8-12s |
| `veo` | Vidéo | 1080p | ❌ | ❌ | 30-60s |
| `seedance` | Vidéo | 1080p | ❌ | ❌ | 20-45s |

## 5. Endpoint Audio (TTS & Musique)

### 🎯 Endpoints Disponibles

## 6. Endpoint Transcription

### 🎯 Endpoint

```
POST /v1/audio/transcriptions
Content-Type: multipart/form-data
Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY
```

### Paramètres

| Paramètre | Type | Défaut | Description |
|-----------|------|--------|-------------|
| `file` | binary | - | Fichier audio (requis) |
| `model` | string | `whisper-large-v3` | `whisper-large-v3`, `whisper-1`, `scribe` |
| `language` | string | `auto` | Code ISO-639-1 (`fr`, `en`, `es`...) |
| `response_format` | string | `json` | `json`, `text`, `srt`, `vtt`, `verbose_json` |
| `prompt` | string | `null` | Guide de style/terminologie |
| `temperature` | number | `0` | 0 à 1 (déterministe à créatif) |

### Formats Audio Supportés

```
mp3, mp4, mpeg, mpga, m4a, wav, webm
```

### Exemple Request

```bash
curl -X POST https://gen.pollinations.ai/v1/audio/transcriptions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY" \
  -F "file=@recording.mp3" \
  -F "model=whisper-large-v3" \
  -F "language=fr" \
  -F "response_format=json"
```

## 7. Matrice des Modèles & Spécifications

### Résumé par Type de Génération

| Type | Endpoint | Modèles Principaux | Auth Requise | Streaming |
|------|----------|-------------------|--------------|-----------|
| Texte Simple | `GET /text/{prompt}` | `openai`, `mistral`, `qwen-coder` | ✅ | ✅ |
| Chat | `POST /v1/chat/completions` | `openai`, `gemini`, `mistral` | ✅ | ✅ |
| Image | `GET /image/{prompt}` | `flux`, `gptimage`, `seedream` | ✅ | ❌ |
| Vidéo | `GET /image/{prompt}` | `veo`, `seedance` | ✅ | ❌ |
| Audio TTS | `POST /v1/audio/speech` | `elevenlabs`, `tts-1` | ✅ | ❌ |
| Audio Musique | `POST /v1/audio/speech` | `elevenmusic` | ✅ | ❌ |
| Transcription | `POST /v1/audio/transcriptions` | `whisper-large-v3`, `scribe` | ✅ | ❌ |

### Coûts & Limites (Pollen)

| Type | Unité | Coût Estimé | Limite/Requête |
|------|-------|-------------|----------------|
| Texte | 1000 tokens | ~1 pollen | 128K tokens |
| Image | 1 génération | ~5-20 pollen | 2048x2048 max |
| Vidéo | 1 seconde | ~10-50 pollen | 10s max |
| Audio TTS | 1000 caractères | ~2-5 pollen | 4096 chars |
| Audio Musique | 1 seconde | ~5-15 pollen | 300s max |
| Transcription | 1 minute audio | ~3-10 pollen | 25MB max |

## 8. Patterns de Flow Recommandés

### Flow 1: Chat avec Réponse Audio

```
┌─────────────┐     ┌──────────────────┐     ┌─────────────┐
│   Utilisateur│ ──► │ /v1/chat/completions│ ──► │   Texte     │
│   (Texte)    │     │ modalities: audio │     │   + Audio   │
└─────────────┘     └──────────────────┘     └─────────────┘
                           │
                           ▼
                    audio.data (base64)
                           │
                           ▼
                    Player Audio UI
```

**Request:**
```json
{
  "model": "openai",
  "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Explique ce concept"}],
  "modalities": ["text", "audio"],
  "audio": {"voice": "alloy", "format": "mp3"}
}
```

### Flow 2: Interpolation Vidéo (VEO)

```
┌─────────────┐     ┌─────────────┐     ┌──────────────────┐     ┌─────────────┐
│  Image A    │ ──► │  Image B    │ ──► │ /image/{prompt}  │ ──► │   Vidéo     │
│  (Start)    │     │  (End)      │     │ model=veo        │     │  4-8s       │
└─────────────┘     └─────────────┘     │ image=A|B        │     └─────────────┘
                                        │ duration=6       │
                                        │ aspectRatio=16:9 │
                                        │ audio=true       │
                                        └──────────────────┘
```

**Request:**
```bash
GET /image/smooth%20morphing%20transition?model=veo&duration=6&aspectRatio=16:9&image=https://start.jpg|https://end.jpg&audio=true
```

### Flow 3: Génération Multi-Modale Complète

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                         Flow Complet                                │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  1. /v1/chat/completions  →  Script & Prompt Image                 │
│  2. /image/{prompt}       →  Génération Image (flux)               │
│  3. /image/{prompt}       →  Génération Vidéo (veo, interpolation) │
│  4. /v1/audio/speech      →  Narration Audio (elevenlabs)          │
│  5. /v1/audio/speech      →  Musique Fond (elevenmusic)            │
│  6. Assemblage externe    →  Vidéo finale avec audio               │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### Flow 4: Transcription + Résumé Chat

```
┌─────────────┐     ┌──────────────────────┐     ┌──────────────────┐
│  Fichier    │ ──► │ /v1/audio/           │ ──► │  Texte           │
│  Audio      │     │ transcriptions       │     │  Transcrit       │
└─────────────┘     └──────────────────────┘     └────────┬─────────┘
                                                          │
                                                          ▼
                                                 ┌──────────────────┐
                                                 │ /v1/chat/        │
                                                 │ completions      │
                                                 │ (résumé)         │
                                                 └──────────────────┘
```

---

## 9. Gestion d'Erreurs & Retry

### Codes HTTP & Actions

| Code | Signification | Action Recommandée |
|------|---------------|-------------------|
| 200 | Succès | Traiter la réponse |
| 400 | Bad Request | Vérifier paramètres, retry avec correction |
| 401 | Unauthorized | Vérifier clé API |
| 402 | Payment Required | Vérifier solde pollen |
| 403 | Forbidden | Vérifier permissions modèle |
| 429 | Rate Limited | Attendre + exponential backoff |
| 500 | Server Error | Retry avec backoff (3x max) |

### Pattern Retry Recommandé

```javascript
async function retryWithBackoff(fn, maxRetries = 3) {
  for (let i = 0; i < maxRetries; i++) {
    try {
      return await fn();
    } catch (error) {
      if (error.status >= 500 && i < maxRetries - 1) {
        await sleep(Math.pow(2, i) * 1000); // Exponential backoff
        continue;
      }
      throw error;
    }
  }
}
```

---

## 10. Checklist Pré-Production

- [ ] Clé API `sk_` générée et sécurisée (variables d'environnement)
- [ ] Endpoint `/account/key` testé pour validation
- [ ] Endpoint `/account/balance` monitoré avant gros flows
- [ ] Timeouts configurés (vidéo: 120s, image: 30s, texte: 60s)
- [ ] Gestion erreurs 402 (solde insuffisant) implémentée
- [ ] Retry logic pour erreurs 5xx
- [ ] Logging des requêtes pour `/account/usage`
- [ ] Validation des URLs images avant interpolation vidéo
- [ ] Tests de durée vidéo selon modèle (veo: 4/6/8s, seedance: 2-10s)

// brace sets, then grow large enough to exhaust memory and crash the process
// (CVE-2026-14257). `EXPANSION_MAX_LENGTH` bounds the total number of
// characters the accumulator may hold at any point, so memory stays flat no
// matter how many brace groups are chained. The limit sits well above any
// realistic expansion (100k results hitting `EXPANSION_MAX` measure ~1M
// characters) so legitimate input is unaffected.
var EXPANSION_MAX_LENGTH = 4000000

function numeric(str) {
  return parseInt(str, 10) == str
    ? parseInt(str, 10)
    : str.charCodeAt(0);
}

function escapeBraces(str) {
  return str.split('\\\\').join(escSlash)
            .split('\\{').join(escOpen)
            .split('\\}').join(escClose)
            .split('\\,').join(escComma)
            .split('\\.').join(escPeriod);
}

function unescapeBraces(str) {
  return str.split(escSlash).join('\\')
            .split(escOpen).join('{')
            .split(escClose).join('}')
            .split(escComma).join(',')
            .split(escPeriod).join('.');
}


// Basically just str.split(","), but handling cases
// where we have nested braced sections, which should be
// treated as individual members, like {a,{b,c},d}
function parseCommaParts(str) {
  if (!str)
    return [''];

  var parts = [];
  var m = balanced('{', '}', str);

  if (!m)
    return str.split(',');

  var pre = m.pre;
  var body = m.body;
  var post = m.post;
  var p = pre.split(',');

  p[p.length-1] += '{' + body + '}';
  var postParts = parseCommaParts(post);
  if (post.length) {
    p[p.length-1] += postParts.shift();
    p.push.apply(p, postParts);
  }

  parts.push.apply(parts, p);

  return parts;
}

function expandTop(str, options) {
  if (!str)
    return [];

  options = options || {};
  var max = options.max == null ? EXPANSION_MAX : options.max;
  var maxLength = options.maxLength == null ? EXPANSION_MAX_LENGTH : options.maxLength;

  // I don't know why Bash 4.3 does this, but it does.
  // Anything starting with {} will have the first two bytes preserved
  // but *only* at the top level, so {},a}b will not expand to anything,
  // but a{},b}c will be expanded to [a}c,abc].
  // One could argue that this is a bug in Bash, but since the goal of
  // this module is to match Bash's rules, we escape a leading {}
  if (str.substr(0, 2) === '{}') {
    str = '\\{\\}' + str.substr(2);
  }

  return expand(escapeBraces(str), max, maxLength, true).map(unescapeBraces);
}

function embrace(str) {
  return '{' + str + '}';
}
function isPadded(el) {
  return /^-?0\d/.test(el);
}

function lte(i, y) {
  return i <= y;
}
function gte(i, y) {
  return i >= y;
}

// Build `{ acc[a] + pre + values[v] }` for every combination, capping the
// number of results at `max` and the total number of characters at `maxLength`.
// This is the one place output grows, so bounding it here keeps the single
// accumulator - and therefore memory - flat regardless of how many brace groups
// are combined (CVE-2026-14257).
function combine(
  acc,
  pre,
  values,
  max,
  maxLength,
  dropEmpties
) {
  var out = []
  var length = 0
  for (var a = 0; a < acc.length; a++) {
    for (var v = 0; v < values.length; v++) {
      if (out.length >= max) return out
      var expansion = acc[a] + pre + values[v]
      // Bash drops empty results at the top level. Skip them before they count
      // against `max`, so `max` bounds the number of *kept* results.
      if (dropEmpties && !expansion) continue
      if (length + expansion.length > maxLength) return out
      out.push(expansion)
      length += expansion.length
    }
  }
  return out
}

// The expansion values of a single numeric (`1..5`) or alphabetic (`a..e..2`)
// sequence body.
function expandSequence(
  body,
  isAlphaSequence,
  max,
  maxLength
) {
  var n = body.split(/\.\./)
  var N = []
  // A sequence body always splits into two or three parts, but the compiler
  // can't know that.
  /* c8 ignore start */
  if (n[0] === undefined || n[1] === undefined) {
    return N
  }
  /* c8 ignore stop */
  var x = numeric(n[0])
  var y = numeric(n[1])
  var width = Math.max(n[0].length, n[1].length)
  var incr =
    n.length === 3 && n[2] !== undefined ?
      Math.max(Math.abs(numeric(n[2])), 1)
    : 1
  var test = lte
  var reverse = y < x
  if (reverse) {
    incr *= -1
    test = gte
  }
  var pad = n.some(isPadded)

  var length = 0
  for (var i = x; test(i, y) && N.length < max; i += incr) {
    var c
    if (isAlphaSequence) {
      c = String.fromCharCode(i)
      if (c === '\\') {
        c = ''
      }
    } else {
      c = String(i)
      if (pad) {
        var need = width - c.length
        if (need > 0) {
          var z = new Array(need + 1).join('0')
          if (i < 0) {
            c = '-' + z + c.slice(1)
          } else {
            c = z + c
          }
        }
      }
    }
    if (length + c.length > maxLength) break
    N.push(c)
    length += c.length
  }
  return N
}

function expand(
  str,
  max,
  maxLength,
  isTop
) {
  // Consume the string's top-level brace groups left to right, threading a
  // running set of combined prefixes (`acc`). Expanding the tail iteratively -
  // rather than recursing on `m.post` once per group - keeps the native stack
  // depth constant, so deeply chained input (`'{a,b}'.repeat(3000)`) can no
  // longer overflow the stack, and leaves a single accumulator whose size
  // `maxLength` bounds directly (CVE-2026-14257).
  var acc = ['']

  // Bash drops empty results, but only when the *first* top-level group is a
  // comma set - a sequence like `{a..\}` may legitimately yield ''. The drop
  // is on the final strings, so it is applied to whichever `combine` produces
  // them (the one with no brace set left in the tail).
  var dropEmpties = false
  var firstGroup = true

  for (;;) {
    const m = balanced('{', '}', str)

    // No brace set left: the rest of the string is literal.
    if (!m) {
      return combine(acc, str, [''], max, maxLength, dropEmpties)
    }

    // no need to expand pre, since it is guaranteed to be free of brace-sets
    const pre = m.pre

    if (/\$$/.test(pre)) {
      acc = combine(
        acc,
        pre + '{' + m.body + '}',
        [''],
        max,
        maxLength,
        dropEmpties && !m.post.length
      )
      firstGroup = false
      if (!m.post.length) break
      str = m.post
      continue
    }

    var isNumericSequence = /^-?\d+\.\.-?\d+(?:\.\.-?\d+)?$/.test(m.body);
    var isAlphaSequence = /^[a-zA-Z]\.\.[a-zA-Z](?:\.\.-?\d+)?$/.test(m.body);
    var isSequence = isNumericSequence || isAlphaSequence;
    var isOptions = m.body.indexOf(',') >= 0;
    if (!isSequence && !isOptions) {
      // {a},b}
      if (m.post.match(/,(?!,).*\}/)) {
        str = m.pre + '{' + m.body + escClose + m.post;
        isTop = true;
        continue;
      }
      // Nothing here expands, so the whole remaining string is literal.
      return combine(
        acc,
        pre + '{' + m.body + '}' + m.post,
        [''],
        max,
        maxLength,
        dropEmpties
      )
    }

    if (firstGroup) {
      dropEmpties = isTop && !isSequence
      firstGroup = false
    }

    var values;
    if (isSequence) {
      values = expandSequence(m.body, isAlphaSequence, max, maxLength);
    } else {
      var n = parseCommaParts(m.body);
      if (n.length === 1 && n[0] !== undefined) {
        // x{{a,b}}y ==> x{a}y x{b}y
        n = expand(n[0], max, maxLength, false).map(embrace);
        //XXX is this necessary? Can't seem to hit it in tests.
        /* c8 ignore start */
        if (n.length === 1) {
          acc = combine(
            acc,
            pre + n[0],
            [''],
            max,
            maxLength,
            dropEmpties && !m.post.length
          )
          if (!m.post.length) break
          str = m.post
          continue
        }
        /* c8 ignore stop */
      }

      // Values that `combine` is going to drop as empty produce no result, so
      // they must not count against `max` - otherwise `{a,,b}` with `max: 2`
      // would stop at `['a', '']` and yield one result instead of two. Skipping
      // them outright keeps `values` bounded while leaving `max` a bound on
      // *kept* results.
      var dropsEmpties = dropEmpties && !m.post.length && !pre
      for (var d = 0; dropsEmpties && d < acc.length; d++) {
        if (acc[d]) {
          dropsEmpties = false
        }
      }

      values = []
      var valuesLength = 0
      outer: for (var j = 0; j < n.length; j++) {
        var expanded = expand(n[j], max, maxLength, false)
        for (var k = 0; k < expanded.length; k++) {
          var v = expanded[k]
          if (dropsEmpties && !v) continue
          if (values.length >= max || valuesLength + v.length > maxLength) {
            break outer
          }
          values.push(v)
          valuesLength += v.length
        }
      }
    }

    acc = combine(acc, pre, values, max, maxLength, dropEmpties && !m.post.length)
    if (!m.post.length) break
    str = m.post
  }

  return acc
}

/**

 *
 * Single-file stdio MCP server (JSON-RPC 2.0 over stdin/stdout), zero npm
 * dependency, Node >= 18 (global fetch / FormData / Blob / AbortController).
 *
 * Exposed tools (namespace `media.*`, surfaced as `mcp__media__*` in Reasonix):
 *   GEN     — Pruna: image_gen, image_gen_ideogram, image_edit, image_upscale,
 *             image_try_on, video_gen, video_avatar, video_animate,
 *             video_replace, pruna_status
 *   GEN     — Navy: navy_models, navy_image_gen
 *   GEN     — ImgTools: image_bg_remove, image_object_remove,
 *             image_upscale_imgs, image_enhance
 *   GEN     — TTS: tts, avatar_lipsync
 *   STT     — stt (Navy)
 *   EXTRACT — client_extract_audio, client_extract_frames, video_info (ffmpeg/ffprobe)
 *   UTIL    — upload_file (litterbox -> file.io -> tmpfile.link)
 *   STUDIO  — video_trim, video_concat, video_transitions, video_transcode,
 *             video_aspect, video_split, video_speed, video_reverse, video_fade,
 *             video_crop, video_rotate, video_stabilize, video_chromakey,
 *             video_colorgrade, video_zoompan, video_title, video_watermark,
 *             video_pip, audio_mix, audio_normalize, audio_denoise,
 *             audio_remove_silence, audio_convert, audio_tempo, audio_pitch,
 *             video_mux_audio, subtitle_generate, subtitle_burn,
 *             video_contact_sheet, video_scene_detect, video_audio_report,
 *             video_gif, video_waveform, video_ocr (34 outils FFmpeg/FFprobe)
 *
 * Protocol rules (AGENTS.md):
 *   - exactly one JSON-RPC response per line on stdout (newline separated);
 *   - ALL logs go to stderr, never stdout;
 *   - the server never exits on a malformed request / failing tool;
 *   - secrets come from .env in this folder, never hardcoded.

'use strict';

    txt = fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname, '.env'), 'utf8');
  } catch (_) {
    return; // no .env file: keys stay empty and tools report a readable error
  }
  for (const raw of txt.split(/\r?\n/)) {
    const m = raw.match(/^\s*([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\s*=\s*(.*?)\s*$/);
    if (!m || m[2] === '') continue;
    if (m[1] in process.env) continue; // real environment wins
    let v = m[2].trim();
    if ((v.startsWith('"') && v.endsWith('"')) || (v.startsWith("'") && v.endsWith("'"))) {
      v = v.slice(1, -1);
    }

  }
}
loadEnv();

const CFG = {
  PRUNA_BASE: 'https://pruna.esprit-artificiel.com',
  PRUNA_KEY: process.env.PRUNA_KEY || '',
  NAVY_BASE: (process.env.NAVY_BASE_URL || 'https://navy.fopacademy.fr/v1').replace(/\/+$/, ''),
  NAVY_KEY: process.env.NAVY_KEY || '',
  IMGTOOLS_BASE: (process.env.IMGTOOLS_API_URL || 'https://imgtools.esprit-artificiel.com').replace(/\/+$/, ''),
  IMGTOOLS_KEY: process.env.IMGTOOLS_KEY || '',

  TTS_KEY: process.env.TTS_API_KEY || '',

/* ================================================================== *
 *  HTTP helper — fetch with AbortController timeout

async function api(url, opts = {}) {
  const { method = 'GET', headers = {}, body, formData, timeout = 30000 } = opts;
  const ctrl = new AbortController();
  const timer = setTimeout(() => ctrl.abort(), timeout);
  const fetchOpts = { method, headers, signal: ctrl.signal };
  if (formData) {

  } else if (body !== undefined) {

    if (!headers['Content-Type'] && !headers['content-type']) {

    res = await fetch(url, fetchOpts);
  } catch (e) {
    if (e && e.name === 'AbortError') throw new Error(`timeout after ${timeout / 1000}s: ${url}`);

  const buf = Buffer.from(await res.arrayBuffer());
  let data;
  if (!/json/i.test(ct)) {
    const text = buf.toString('utf8');
    if (/^\s*[\[{]/.test(text)) {
      try {
        data = JSON.parse(text);
      } catch (_) {
        data = buf;
      }
    } else {
      data = buf;
    }
  } else {
    const text = buf.toString('utf8');
    try {
      data = JSON.parse(text);
    } catch (_) {

/**

 *   { name, value }                    -> text field
 *   { name, file }                     -> local path (Blob), http(s) URL or
 *                                         data: URI passed through as-is
 *   { name, file: Buffer, filename }   -> raw buffer
 */
function buildForm(entries) {
  const fd = new FormData();
  for (const e of entries) {
    if (e.file !== undefined) {
      const f = e.file;
      if (Buffer.isBuffer(f)) {
        fd.append(e.name, new Blob([f]), e.filename || 'file');
      } else if (typeof f === 'string' && /^https?:\/\//i.test(f)) {
        fd.append(e.name, f); // remote URL accepted directly by backends
      } else if (typeof f === 'string' && f.startsWith('data:')) {
        fd.append(e.name, f); // data: URI passed through as-is
      } else if (typeof f === 'string') {

        fd.append(e.name, new Blob([buf]), e.filename || path.basename(f));
      } else {
        fd.append(e.name, f, e.filename || 'file');
      }
    } else {

  if (input.startsWith('data:')) return input;

  'image/gif': '.gif',
  'image/bmp': '.bmp',

}

  const name = opts.name || `media_${Date.now()}${ext}`;
  const p = path.join(dir, name);
  await fs.promises.writeFile(p, buf);
  return p;
}

/** Download a remote media file into `dir` and return the local absolute path. */
async function saveFromUrl(url, dir, hint = '') {
  const res = await api(url, { timeout: 180000 });
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`download failed: HTTP ${res.status} (${url})`);
  if (res.buf.length > MAX_DOWNLOAD_BYTES) {
    throw new Error(`download too large: ${res.buf.length} bytes > ${MAX_DOWNLOAD_BYTES} (${url})`);

/* ================================================================== *
 *  Response extraction helpers (backend JSON shapes vary)
 * ================================================================== */
const URL_KEYS = [
  'imageUrl', 'image_url', 'output', 'output_url', 'videoUrl', 'video_url',
  'result_url', 'fileUrl', 'file_url', 'url', 'link', 'location',
  'audio_url', 'audioUrl', 'download_url',

function deepFind(obj, keys, depth = 0) {
  if (!obj || typeof obj !== 'object' || depth > 6) return undefined;
  if (Array.isArray(obj)) {
    for (const it of obj) {
      const v = deepFind(it, keys, depth + 1);
      if (v) return v;
    }
    return undefined;
  }
  for (const k of keys) {
    if (typeof obj[k] === 'string' && /^https?:\/\//i.test(obj[k])) return obj[k];

  for (const k of Object.keys(obj)) {
    const v = deepFind(obj[k], keys, depth + 1);
    if (v) return v;
  }
  return undefined;

const findUrl = (obj) => deepFind(obj, URL_KEYS);

function findJobId(obj) {

  for (const k of ['job_id', 'jobId', 'task_id', 'id']) {
    const v = obj[k];
    if (typeof v === 'string' && v.length > 0 && v.length < 200) return v;
    if (typeof v === 'number' && v > 0) return String(v);
  }
  if (obj.data) return findJobId(obj.data);
  return undefined;
}

function getStatus(obj) {
  if (!obj || typeof obj !== 'object') return '';
  return String(obj.status || obj.state || obj.job_status || '').toLowerCase();
}

function parseJsonRes(res) {
  if (res.data && typeof res.data === 'object' && !Buffer.isBuffer(res.data)) return res.data;
  try {
    return JSON.parse(String(res.data));
  } catch (_) {

  if (typeof j === 'string') return j.slice(0, 300);

/* ================================================================== *
 *  Async job polling
 * ================================================================== */
async function pollStatus(statusUrl, jobId, { intervalMs = 2000, timeoutS = 240 } = {}) {
  const deadline = Date.now() + timeoutS * 1000;
  while (Date.now() < deadline) {
    await sleep(intervalMs);

      throw new ToolError(`job ${jobId} failed: ${JSON.stringify(j).slice(0, 400)}`);
    }
    if (!st && findUrl(j)) return j; // some backends only return the output URL
  }
  throw new TimeoutError(`timeout, job encore en cours : ${jobId}`, jobId);
}

/* ================================================================== *
 *  Upload chain: litterbox.catbox.moe -> file.io -> tmpfile.link
 * ================================================================== */
async function uploadChain(filePath, expiry = '24h') {
  const st = await fs.promises.stat(filePath);
  if (st.size > MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES) {
    throw new ToolError(`upload refusé : ${st.size} octets > ${MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES} (100 Mo)`);
  }
  const buf = await fs.promises.readFile(filePath);
  const name = path.basename(filePath);

  // 1) litterbox.catbox.moe — plain-text answer = URL
  try {
    const fd = new FormData();
    fd.append('reqtype', 'fileupload');
    fd.append('time', expiry);
    fd.append('fileToUpload', new Blob([buf]), name);
    const res = await api('https://litterbox.catbox.moe/resources/internals/api.php', {
      method: 'POST',
      formData: fd,
      timeout: 120000,
    });
    const txt = res.buf.toString('utf8').trim();
    if (res.status === 200 && /^https?:\/\/\S+$/.test(txt)) {
      return { url: txt, service: 'litterbox', expiry };
    }
    log('litterbox: ' + txt.slice(0, 200));
  } catch (e) {
    log('litterbox failed: ' + errMsg(e));
  }

  // 2) file.io — JSON { success, link }
  try {
    const fd = new FormData();
    fd.append('file', new Blob([buf]), name);
    const res = await api('https://file.io/', { method: 'POST', formData: fd, timeout: 120000 });
    if (res.ok && res.data && res.data.success && res.data.link) {
      return { url: res.data.link, service: 'file.io', expiry: null };
    }
  } catch (e) {
    log('file.io failed: ' + errMsg(e));
  }

  // 3) tmpfile.link — JSON { url, ... }
  try {
    const fd = new FormData();
    fd.append('file', new Blob([buf]), name);
    const res = await api('https://tmpfile.link/', { method: 'POST', formData: fd, timeout: 120000 });
    if (res.ok && res.data && (res.data.url || res.data.link)) {
      return { url: res.data.url || res.data.link, service: 'tmpfile', expiry: null };
    }
  } catch (e) {
    log('tmpfile.link failed: ' + errMsg(e));
  }

  throw new Error('upload: all providers failed for ' + filePath);
}

/* ================================================================== *
 *  Sub-process helpers (ffmpeg / ffprobe)
 * ================================================================== */
function runCmd(cmd, args, timeoutMs = 300000) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const cp = spawn(cmd, args);
    let out = '';
    let err = '';
    cp.stdout.on('data', (d) => (out += d));
    cp.stderr.on('data', (d) => (err += d));
    const t = setTimeout(() => {
      cp.kill('SIGKILL');
      reject(new Error(`${cmd} timeout after ${timeoutMs / 1000}s`));
    }, timeoutMs);
    cp.on('error', (e) => {
      clearTimeout(t);
      reject(e);
    });
    cp.on('close', (code) => {
      clearTimeout(t);
      if (code === 0) resolve({ out, err });
      else reject(new Error(`${cmd} exited ${code}: ${err.slice(-600)}`));
    });
  });
}

/** Resolve a media source: local path (must exist) or http(s) URL (downloaded to a temp dir). */
async function resolveSource(source) {
  if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(source)) {
    const tmp = await fs.promises.mkdtemp(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'mcm-media-'));
    const p = await saveFromUrl(source, tmp);
    return { path: p, cleanup: () => fs.promises.rm(tmp, { recursive: true, force: true }) };
  }
  const p = path.resolve(source);
  if (!fs.existsSync(p)) throw new ToolError(`source not found: ${source}`);
  return { path: p, cleanup: () => {} };
}

function parseFps(rate) {
  if (!rate) return null;
  const parts = String(rate).split('/');
  const num = parseFloat(parts[0]);
  const den = parseFloat(parts[1]);
  if (!num) return null;
  return den ? Math.round((num / den) * 100) / 100 : num;
}

/** ffprobe one file -> normalized metadata object. */
async function probe(source) {
  const { out } = await runCmd('ffprobe', ['-v', 'error', '-print_format', 'json', '-show_format', '-show_streams', source]);
  const info = JSON.parse(out);
  const v = (info.streams || []).find((s) => s.codec_type === 'video');
  const a = (info.streams || []).find((s) => s.codec_type === 'audio');
  const fmt = info.format || {};
  return {
    format: fmt.format_name || null,
    size_bytes: Number(fmt.size || 0),
    duration_s: Number(v && v.duration ? v.duration : fmt.duration || 0),
    width: v ? v.width : null,
    height: v ? v.height : null,
    fps: v ? parseFps(v.r_frame_rate || v.avg_frame_rate) : null,
    video_codec: v ? v.codec_name : null,
    audio_codec: a ? a.codec_name : null,
    has_audio: !!a,
    streams: (info.streams || []).map((s) => ({
      index: s.index,
      codec_type: s.codec_type,
      codec_name: s.codec_name,
      width: s.width,
      height: s.height,
      r_frame_rate: s.r_frame_rate,
      duration: s.duration,
    })),
  };
}

/* ================================================================== *
 *  Tool output contract
 * ================================================================== */
const EXT_MIME = {
  '.png': 'image/png', '.jpg': 'image/jpeg', '.jpeg': 'image/jpeg', '.webp': 'image/webp',
  '.gif': 'image/gif', '.bmp': 'image/bmp', '.mp4': 'video/mp4', '.webm': 'video/webm',
  '.mkv': 'video/x-matroska', '.avi': 'video/x-msvideo', '.mov': 'video/quicktime',
  '.mp3': 'audio/mpeg', '.wav': 'audio/wav', '.aac': 'audio/aac', '.flac': 'audio/flac',
  '.ogg': 'audio/ogg', '.m4a': 'audio/mp4', '.srt': 'application/x-subrip', '.vtt': 'text/vtt',
  '.txt': 'text/plain', '.json': 'application/json',
};
const ARTIFACT_INDEX = path.join(CFG.DEFAULT_DIR, '.mcm-artifacts.json');

function readArtifactIndex() {
  try {
    const arr = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(ARTIFACT_INDEX, 'utf8'));
    return Array.isArray(arr) ? arr : [];
  } catch (_) {
    return [];
  }
}

function writeArtifactIndex(idx) {
  try {
    fs.mkdirSync(CFG.DEFAULT_DIR, { recursive: true });
    const tmp = ARTIFACT_INDEX + '.tmp';
    fs.writeFileSync(tmp, JSON.stringify(idx.slice(-500), null, 1));
    fs.renameSync(tmp, ARTIFACT_INDEX);
  } catch (e) {
    log('artifact index write failed: ' + errMsg(e));
  }
}

function artifactFromPath(p) {
  try {
    const st = fs.statSync(p);
    if (!st.isFile()) return null;
    const mime = EXT_MIME[path.extname(p).toLowerCase()] || 'application/octet-stream';
    let sha = null;
    if (st.size <= 64 * 1024 * 1024) {
      sha = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(fs.readFileSync(p)).digest('hex');
    }
    const id = 'art_' + Date.now().toString(36) + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8);
    return {
      artifact_id: id,
      uri: 'media://artifact/' + id,
      local_path: p,
      mime_type: mime,
      bytes: st.size,
      sha256: sha,
      created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      expires_at: null,
    };
  } catch (_) {
    return null;
  }
}

function recordArtifact(a, tool) {
  const idx = readArtifactIndex();
  idx.push({ artifact_id: a.artifact_id, tool, local_path: a.local_path, bytes: a.bytes, sha256: a.sha256, created_at: a.created_at });
  writeArtifactIndex(idx);
}

function makeResult(tool, { local_path = null, url = null, meta = {} } = {}) {
  const artifacts = [];
  if (local_path) {
    const a = artifactFromPath(local_path);
    if (a) {
      artifacts.push(a);
      recordArtifact(a, tool);
    }
  }
  return {
    ok: true,
    status: 'completed',
    tool,
    request_id: 'req_' + Date.now().toString(36) + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8),
    local_path,
    url,
    artifacts,
    meta,
    provenance: { input_artifact_ids: [], operations: [tool] },
  };
}

function ctxOf(args) {
  return {
    saveDir: args.save_dir ? path.resolve(String(args.save_dir)) : CFG.DEFAULT_DIR,
    upload: !!args.upload,
    timeoutS: Math.min(Math.max(Number(args.async_timeout_s) || 240, 1), 600),
  };
}

function resolveOut(p, dir) {
  return path.isAbsolute(p) ? p : path.join(dir, p);
}

/** JSON Schema fragment helper. */
const T = (type, description, extra = {}) => ({ type, description, ...extra });
const BASE_ARGS = {
  save_dir: T('string', 'Dossier de sortie (défaut ~/Downloads/mcm-media/)'),
  upload: T('boolean', 'Uploader le résultat sur une URL publique (défaut false)'),
};

 *  Auth headers per service

}

}

  if (!CFG.TTS_KEY) throw new ToolError('TTS_API_KEY manquante dans .env');

}

async function image_gen(args, ctx) {
  const body = pick(args, ['prompt', 'aspect_ratio', 'seed', 'prompt_upsampling', 'width', 'height', 'model']);
  if (!body.prompt) throw new ToolError('prompt requis');
  const res = await api(`${CFG.PRUNA_BASE}/generate`, { method: 'POST', headers: prunaHeaders(), body, timeout: 120000 });
  const j = parseJsonRes(res);
  const url = findUrl(j);
  if (!res.ok || !url) throw new ToolError(`pruna /generate failed: ${describe(res, j)}`);
  const local = await saveFromUrl(url, ctx.saveDir);
  const out = makeResult('media.image_gen', {
    local_path: local,
    meta: { api: 'pruna', model: args.model || 'p-image', ...pick(j, ['generationCount', 'maxGenerations']), width: args.width, height: args.height },
  });
  if (ctx.upload) out.url = (await uploadChain(local, '24h')).url;
  return out;
}

async function image_try_on(args, ctx) {
  if (!args.person_image) throw new ToolError('person_image requis');
  if (!Array.isArray(args.garment_images) || !args.garment_images.length) throw new ToolError('garment_images requis (au moins une)');
  const entries = [{ name: 'person_image', file: args.person_image }];
  for (const g of args.garment_images) entries.push({ name: 'garment_images', file: g });
  for (const k of ['category', 'seed', 'prompt', 'turbo', 'output_format', 'output_quality', 'reference_pose', 'preserve_input_size']) {
    if (args[k] !== undefined) entries.push({ name: k, value: args[k] });
  }
  const res = await api(`${CFG.PRUNA_BASE}/try-on`, { method: 'POST', headers: prunaHeaders(), formData: buildForm(entries), timeout: 120000 });
  const j = parseJsonRes(res);
  const jobId = findJobId(j);
  if (!res.ok || !jobId) throw new ToolError(`pruna /try-on failed: ${describe(res, j)}`);
  const done = await pollStatus(`${CFG.PRUNA_BASE}/try-on/status/${jobId}`, jobId, { timeoutS: ctx.timeoutS });
  const url = findUrl(done);
  if (!url) throw new ToolError(`try-on job ${jobId}: no output url in ${JSON.stringify(done).slice(0, 300)}`);
  const local = await saveFromUrl(url, ctx.saveDir);
  const out = makeResult('media.image_try_on', {
    local_path: local,
    meta: { api: 'pruna', model: 'p-image-try-on', job_id: jobId, preserve_input_size: args.preserve_input_size ?? true, output_quality: args.output_quality || 95 },
  });
  if (ctx.upload) out.url = (await uploadChain(local, '24h')).url;
  return out;
}

async function video_gen(args, ctx) {
  if (!args.prompt) throw new ToolError('prompt requis');
  const hasFile = !!(args.image || args.audio);
  let res;
  if (hasFile) {
    const entries = [];
    for (const k of ['prompt', 'duration', 'aspect_ratio', 'resolution', 'fps', 'draft', 'prompt_upsampling', 'save_audio']) {
      if (args[k] !== undefined) entries.push({ name: k, value: args[k] });
    }
    if (args.image) entries.push({ name: 'image', file: args.image });
    if (args.audio) entries.push({ name: 'audio', file: args.audio });
    res = await api(`${CFG.PRUNA_BASE}/video/generate`, { method: 'POST', headers: prunaHeaders(), formData: buildForm(entries), timeout: 120000 });
  } else {
    const body = pick(args, ['prompt', 'duration', 'aspect_ratio', 'resolution', 'fps', 'draft', 'prompt_upsampling', 'save_audio']);
    res = await api(`${CFG.PRUNA_BASE}/video/generate`, { method: 'POST', headers: prunaHeaders(), body, timeout: 120000 });
  }
  const j = parseJsonRes(res);
  const jobId = findJobId(j);
  if (!res.ok || !jobId) throw new ToolError(`pruna /video/generate failed: ${describe(res, j)}`);
  const done = await pollStatus(`${CFG.PRUNA_BASE}/video/status/${jobId}`, jobId, { timeoutS: ctx.timeoutS });
  const url = findUrl(done);
  if (!url) throw new ToolError(`video job ${jobId}: no output url in ${JSON.stringify(done).slice(0, 300)}`);
  const local = await saveFromUrl(url, ctx.saveDir);
  const out = makeResult('media.video_gen', {
    local_path: local,
    meta: { api: 'pruna', model: 'p-video', job_id: jobId, resolution: args.resolution, fps: args.fps, duration: args.duration },
  });
  if (ctx.upload) out.url = (await uploadChain(local, '24h')).url;
  return out;
}

/** Shared driver for the 3 pruna video post-processors (multipart + status poll). */
async function prunaVideoJob(tool, endpoint, statusPath, args, ctx) {
  const entries = [];
  for (const [field, fileArg] of [
    ['sourceImage', 'source_image'],
    ['sourceVideo', 'source_video'],
  ]) {
    if (args[fileArg]) entries.push({ name: field, file: args[fileArg] });
  }
  for (const k of ['description', 'voice', 'language', 'resolution', 'video_prompt', 'voice_prompt', 'negative_prompt', 'prompt', 'turbo', 'target_fps', 'instruction_prompt']) {
    if (args[k] !== undefined) entries.push({ name: k, value: args[k] });
  }
  const res = await api(`${CFG.PRUNA_BASE}${endpoint}`, { method: 'POST', headers: prunaHeaders(), formData: buildForm(entries), timeout: 120000 });
  const j = parseJsonRes(res);
  const jobId = findJobId(j);
  if (!res.ok || !jobId) throw new ToolError(`${endpoint} failed: ${describe(res, j)}`);
  const done = await pollStatus(`${CFG.PRUNA_BASE}${statusPath}/${jobId}`, jobId, { timeoutS: ctx.timeoutS });
  const url = findUrl(done);
  if (!url) throw new ToolError(`${endpoint} job ${jobId}: no output url in ${JSON.stringify(done).slice(0, 300)}`);
  const local = await saveFromUrl(url, ctx.saveDir);
  const out = makeResult(tool, { local_path: local, meta: { api: 'pruna', job_id: jobId, resolution: args.resolution } });
  if (ctx.upload) out.url = (await uploadChain(local, '24h')).url;
  return out;
}

/* ================================================================== *
 *  GEN — ImgTools (multipart, ?wait=true&download=true)
 * ================================================================== */
async function imgtoolsCall(tool, endpoint, args, ctx) {
  const entries = [{ name: 'file', file: args.image }];
  for (const k of ['prompt', 'ratio', 'target_longest_side']) {
    if (args[k] !== undefined) entries.push({ name: k, value: args[k] });
  }
  const res = await api(`${CFG.IMGTOOLS_BASE}${endpoint}?wait=true&download=true`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: imgtoolsHeaders(),
    formData: buildForm(entries),
    timeout: 180000,
  });
  if (!res.ok) throw new ToolError(`${endpoint} failed: ${describe(res, res.data)}`);
  let local;
  if (Buffer.isBuffer(res.data)) {
    local = await saveBuffer(res.data, ctx.saveDir, { ct: res.ct });
  } else {
    const j = parseJsonRes(res);
    const url = findUrl(j);
    if (!url) throw new ToolError(`${endpoint}: no output url in ${describe(res, j)}`);
    local = await saveFromUrl(url, ctx.saveDir);
  }
  const out = makeResult(tool, { local_path: local, meta: { api: 'imgtools', endpoint } });
  if (ctx.upload) out.url = (await uploadChain(local, '24h')).url;
  return out;
}

  try {
    const res = await api(`${CFG.TTS_BASE}/v1/agent/quickstart`, { headers: ttsHeaders(), timeout: 30000 });
    if (res.ok) {
      const j = parseJsonRes(res);
      if (typeof j === 'object') {
        quickstartCache = j;
        log('TTS quickstart loaded: ' + JSON.stringify(j).slice(0, 500));
      }
    }
  } catch (e) {
    log('TTS quickstart failed: ' + errMsg(e));

  return quickstartCache || {};
}

  fish: 'fish-s2.1-pro-free',
  edge: 'edge-tts',
  gemini: 'gemini-live-native-audio',
  openai: 'tts-1',
};

async function tts(args, ctx) {
  if (!args.input) throw new ToolError('input requis');
  await ttsQuickstart();
  const engine = args.engine || 'auto';
  let model = args.model;
  let voice = args.voice;

  if (!model) {
    if (engine === 'edge') model = 'edge-tts';
    else if (engine === 'gemini') model = 'gemini-live-native-audio';
    else if (engine === 'openai') model = 'tts-1';
    else model = 'fish-s2.1-pro-free'; // fish / auto
  }
  if (!voice && !args.voice) {
    // Never invent a voice id: pull the curated list for the engine+language.
    try {
      const q = new URLSearchParams({
        engine: engine === 'edge' ? 'edge' : engine === 'gemini' ? 'gemini' : 'fish',
        language: args.language || 'fr',
        curated_only: 'true',
      });
      const res = await api(`${CFG.TTS_BASE}/v1/voices?${q}`, { headers: ttsHeaders(), timeout: 30000 });
      const j = parseJsonRes(res);
      const list = Array.isArray(j) ? j : j.voices || [];
      if (list.length) voice = list[0].voice_id || list[0].id || list[0].name;
    } catch (e) {
      log('TTS voices fetch failed: ' + errMsg(e));
    }
  }
  if (!voice) throw new ToolError('TTS: voice requis — aucun voice_id curaté trouvé, passez voice explicitement');

  const body = { model, voice, input: args.input };
  for (const k of ['persona', 'response_format', 'speed', 'rate', 'pitch']) {
    if (args[k] !== undefined) body[k] = args[k];
  }
  const res = await api(`${CFG.TTS_BASE}/v1/audio/speech`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { ...ttsHeaders(), 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body,
    timeout: 180000,
  });
  if (!res.ok) throw new ToolError(`TTS failed: ${describe(res, res.data)}`);

  let local;
  if (Buffer.isBuffer(res.data)) {
    local = await saveBuffer(res.data, ctx.saveDir, { ct: res.ct });
  } else {
    const j = parseJsonRes(res);
    const jobId = findJobId(j);
    if (jobId) {
      await pollStatus(`${CFG.TTS_BASE}/v1/jobs/${jobId}`, jobId, { timeoutS: ctx.timeoutS });
      const audioRes = await api(`${CFG.TTS_BASE}/v1/jobs/${jobId}/audio`, { timeout: 120000 });
      if (audioRes.ok && Buffer.isBuffer(audioRes.data)) {
        local = await saveBuffer(audioRes.data, ctx.saveDir, { ct: audioRes.ct });
      } else {
        const url = findUrl(parseJsonRes(audioRes));
        if (!url) throw new ToolError(`TTS job ${jobId}: no audio output`);
        local = await saveFromUrl(url, ctx.saveDir);
      }
    } else {
      const url = findUrl(j);
      if (!url) throw new ToolError(`TTS: no audio in ${describe(res, j)}`);
      local = await saveFromUrl(url, ctx.saveDir);
    }
  }
  const out = makeResult('media.tts', { local_path: local, meta: { api: 'tts', engine, model, voice } });
  if (ctx.upload) out.url = (await uploadChain(local, '24h')).url;
  return out;
}

async function avatar_lipsync(args, ctx) {
  if (!args.image) throw new ToolError('image requis');
  if (!args.audio) throw new ToolError('audio requis');
  const entries = [
    { name: 'image', file: args.image },
    { name: 'audio', file: args.audio },
  ];
  if (args.description) entries.push({ name: 'description', value: args.description });
  const res = await api(`${CFG.TTS_BASE}/v1/video/avatar`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: ttsHeaders(),
    formData: buildForm(entries),
    timeout: 120000,
  });
  const j = parseJsonRes(res);
  const jobId = findJobId(j);
  if (!res.ok || !jobId) throw new ToolError(`TTS avatar failed: ${describe(res, j)}`);
  const done = await pollStatus(`${CFG.TTS_BASE}/v1/jobs/${jobId}`, jobId, { timeoutS: ctx.timeoutS });
  const url = findUrl(done);
  if (!url) throw new ToolError(`avatar job ${jobId}: no output url in ${JSON.stringify(done).slice(0, 300)}`);
  const local = await saveFromUrl(url, ctx.saveDir);
  const out = makeResult('media.avatar_lipsync', { local_path: local, meta: { api: 'tts', job_id: jobId } });
  if (ctx.upload) out.url = (await uploadChain(local, '24h')).url;
  return out;
}

/* ================================================================== *
 *  STT — Navy /audio/transcriptions
 * ================================================================== */
async function stt(args, ctx) {
  if (!args.file) throw new ToolError('file requis');
  let model = args.model;
  if (!model) {
    // Dynamic model catalogue: always ask /v1/models before picking.
    const res = await api(`${CFG.NAVY_BASE}/models`, { headers: navyHeaders(), timeout: 30000 });
    const j = parseJsonRes(res);
    const models = Array.isArray(j) ? j : j.data || j.models || [];
    const sttModels = models.filter((m) => /(transcri|whisper|stt|speech-to-text)/i.test(String(m.id || m.name || '')));
    if (!sttModels.length) throw new ToolError('STT: aucun modèle STT trouvé dans /v1/models — passez model explicitement');
    model = sttModels[0].id || sttModels[0].name;
  }
  const entries = [
    { name: 'file', file: args.file },
    { name: 'model', value: model },
  ];
  if (args.language) entries.push({ name: 'language', value: args.language });
  const res = await api(`${CFG.NAVY_BASE}/audio/transcriptions`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: navyHeaders(),
    formData: buildForm(entries),
    timeout: 180000,
  });
  if (!res.ok) throw new ToolError(`STT failed: ${describe(res, res.data)}`);
  const j = parseJsonRes(res);
  const text = j.text || (typeof res.data === 'string' ? res.data : '');
  if (!text) throw new ToolError('STT: transcription vide');
  return makeResult('media.stt', { meta: { api: 'navy', model, text } });
}

/* ================================================================== *
 *  EXTRACT — ffmpeg / ffprobe (local)
 * ================================================================== */
async function extract_audio(args, ctx) {
  const fmt = args.format || 'mp3';
  const codec = { mp3: 'libmp3lame', wav: 'pcm_s16le', aac: 'aac', flac: 'flac' }[fmt];
  if (!codec) throw new ToolError(`format non supporté: ${fmt}`);
  const src = await resolveSource(args.source);
  try {
    const outName = args.output
      ? path.basename(args.output)
      : `audio_${Date.now()}.${fmt}`;
    const outPath = args.output ? resolveOut(args.output, ctx.saveDir) : path.join(ctx.saveDir, outName);
    await ensureDir(path.dirname(outPath));
    const ffArgs = ['-y', '-i', src.path];
    if (args.start) ffArgs.push('-ss', String(args.start));
    if (args.end) ffArgs.push('-to', String(args.end));
    ffArgs.push('-vn', '-acodec', codec, outPath);
    await runCmd('ffmpeg', ffArgs);
    const out = makeResult('media.extract_audio', {
      local_path: outPath,
      meta: { api: 'local', format: fmt, codec, source: args.source },
    });
    if (ctx.upload) out.url = (await uploadChain(outPath, '24h')).url;
    return out;
  } finally {
    await src.cleanup();
  }
}

async function extract_frames(args, ctx) {
  const src = await resolveSource(args.source);
  try {
    if (args.metadata_only) {
      const info = await probe(src.path);
      return makeResult('media.extract_frames', { meta: { api: 'local', mode: 'metadata', source: args.source, ...info } });
    }
    await ensureDir(ctx.saveDir);
    if (args.at_time !== undefined) {
      const outPath = args.output ? resolveOut(args.output, ctx.saveDir) : path.join(ctx.saveDir, `frame_${Date.now()}.png`);
      await runCmd('ffmpeg', ['-y', '-ss', String(args.at_time), '-i', src.path, '-frames:v', '1', outPath]);
      const out = makeResult('media.extract_frames', {
        local_path: outPath,
        meta: { api: 'local', mode: 'single', at_time: args.at_time, source: args.source },
      });
      if (ctx.upload) out.url = (await uploadChain(outPath, '24h')).url;
      return out;
    }
    let fps = args.fps !== undefined ? Number(args.fps) : NaN;
    if (args.count && args.start !== undefined && args.end !== undefined) {
      const dur = Math.max(parseFloat(args.end) - parseFloat(args.start), 0.001);
      fps = Math.max(1, Math.round(Number(args.count) / dur));
    }
    if (!Number.isFinite(fps) || fps <= 0) {
      throw new ToolError(
        args.fps !== undefined
          ? `extract_frames: fps invalide (« ${args.fps} ») — nombre positif attendu`
          : 'extract_frames: fournir at_time, ou fps (avec start/end optionnels), ou count avec start et end'
      );
    }
    const outBase = args.output
      ? path.join(path.dirname(resolveOut(args.output, ctx.saveDir)), path.basename(args.output, path.extname(args.output)))
      : path.join(ctx.saveDir, 'frame');
    const outPat = `${outBase}_%03d.png`;
    const ffArgs = ['-y'];
    if (args.start !== undefined) ffArgs.push('-ss', String(args.start));
    if (args.end !== undefined) ffArgs.push('-to', String(args.end));
    ffArgs.push('-i', src.path, '-vf', `fps=${fps}`, outPat);
    await runCmd('ffmpeg', ffArgs);
    const dir = path.dirname(outPat);
    const stem = path.basename(outBase).replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&');
    const files = (await fs.promises.readdir(dir))
      .filter((f) => new RegExp(`^${stem}_\\d+\\.png$`).test(f))
      .sort()
      .map((f) => path.join(dir, f));
    if (!files.length) throw new ToolError('extract_frames: aucune frame produite');
    const out = makeResult('media.extract_frames', {
      local_path: files[0],
      meta: { api: 'local', mode: 'series', fps, count: files.length, files, source: args.source },
    });
    if (ctx.upload) out.url = (await uploadChain(files[0], '24h')).url;
    return out;
  } finally {
    await src.cleanup();
  }
}

async function video_info(args, ctx) {
  if (!args.source) throw new ToolError('source requis');
  const src = await resolveSource(args.source);
  try {
    const info = await probe(src.path);
    return makeResult('media.video_info', { meta: { api: 'local', source: args.source, ...info } });
  } finally {
    await src.cleanup();
  }
}

/* ================================================================== *
 *  UTIL — upload_file
 * ================================================================== */
async function upload_file(args, ctx) {
  if (!args.file) throw new ToolError('file requis');
  let filePath;
  let tmp = null;
  if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(args.file)) {
    tmp = await fs.promises.mkdtemp(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'mcm-media-'));
    filePath = await saveFromUrl(args.file, tmp);
  } else {
    filePath = path.resolve(args.file);
    if (!fs.existsSync(filePath)) throw new ToolError(`file not found: ${args.file}`);
  }
  try {
    const u = await uploadChain(filePath, args.expiry || '24h');
    return makeResult('media.upload_file', {
      local_path: filePath,
      url: u.url,
      meta: { service: u.service, expiry: u.expiry || null },
    });
  } finally {
    if (tmp) await fs.promises.rm(tmp, { recursive: true, force: true }).catch(() => {});
  }
}

/* ================================================================== *
 *  STUDIO — montage vidéo / audio (ffmpeg, ffprobe)
 *  Tous les tools renvoient {ok, tool, local_path, url?, meta{...facts JSON}}
 *  ================================================================== */

const FONT_CANDIDATES = [
  '/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf',
  '/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSerif.ttf',
  '/System/Library/Fonts/Helvetica.ttc',
  'C:\\Windows\\Fonts\\arial.ttf',
];
function findFont() {
  return FONT_CANDIDATES.find((f) => fs.existsSync(f)) || null;
}
function clampNum(v, dflt, min, max) {
  const x = Number(v);
  return Number.isFinite(x) ? Math.min(Math.max(x, min), max) : dflt;
}
function fmtTS(sec) {
  if (typeof sec === 'string' && /^\d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2}(\.\d+)?$/.test(sec)) return sec;
  const s = Number(sec);
  if (!Number.isFinite(s)) return '0';
  return String(s);
}
async function studioOut(ctx, tool, outPath, meta) {
  const out = makeResult(tool, { local_path: outPath, meta });
  if (ctx.upload) out.url = (await uploadChain(outPath, '48h')).url;
  return out;
}
async function studioPath(ctx, seed, ext, output) {
  const p = output ? resolveOut(output, ctx.saveDir) : path.join(ctx.saveDir, `${seed}_${Date.now()}.${ext}`);
  await ensureDir(path.dirname(p));
  return p;
}
async function ff(srcs, ffArgs) {
  return runCmd('ffmpeg', ffArgs);
}

/* --- video_trim --------------------------------------------------- */
async function video_trim(args, ctx) {
  const src = await resolveSource(args.source);
  try {
    const outPath = await studioPath(ctx, 'trim', 'mp4', args.output);
    const ffArgs = ['-y'];
    const reencode = !!args.reencode;
    if (args.start && !reencode) ffArgs.push('-ss', fmtTS(args.start));
    ffArgs.push('-i', src.path);
    if (args.start && reencode) ffArgs.push('-ss', fmtTS(args.start));
    if (args.end) ffArgs.push('-to', fmtTS(args.end));
    if (reencode) {
      ffArgs.push('-c:v', 'libx264', '-preset', 'medium', '-crf', String(clampNum(args.crf, 18, 0, 51)), '-c:a', 'aac', '-movflags', '+faststart');
    } else {
      ffArgs.push('-c', 'copy');
    }
    ffArgs.push(outPath);
    await ff(src, ffArgs);
    return studioOut(ctx, 'media.video_trim', outPath, { api: 'local', start: args.start || null, end: args.end || null, reencode });
  } finally { await src.cleanup(); }
}

/* --- video_concat -------------------------------------------------- */
async function video_concat(args, ctx) {
  const list = Array.isArray(args.sources) && args.sources.length ? args.sources : [];
  if (list.length < 2) throw new ToolError('concat: au moins 2 sources (sources[])');
  const cleaned = [];
  try {
    for (const s of list) cleaned.push(await resolveSource(s));
    const outPath = await studioPath(ctx, 'concat', 'mp4', args.output);
    const ffArgs = ['-y'];
    for (const r of cleaned) ffArgs.push('-i', r.path);
    ffArgs.push('-filter_complex', `concat=n=${cleaned.length}:v=1:a=1`);
    ffArgs.push('-c:v', 'libx264', '-preset', 'medium', '-crf', '20', '-c:a', 'aac', '-movflags', '+faststart', outPath);
    await ff(null, ffArgs);
    return studioOut(ctx, 'media.video_concat', outPath, { api: 'local', clips: cleaned.length });
  } finally { for (const r of cleaned) await r.cleanup().catch(() => {}); }
}

/* --- video_transitions (xfade + acrossfade) ------------------------- */
const XFADE_TYPES = ['fade', 'fadeblack', 'dissolve', 'wipeleft', 'wiperight', 'slideleft', 'slideright', 'smoothleft', 'smoothright', 'circleopen', 'circleclose'];
async function video_transitions(args, ctx) {
  const list = Array.isArray(args.sources) && args.sources.length ? args.sources : [];
  if (list.length < 2) throw new ToolError('transitions: au moins 2 sources (sources[])');
  const trans = XFADE_TYPES.includes(args.transition) ? args.transition : 'fade';
  const dur = clampNum(args.duration, 0.5, 0.05, 5);
  const cleaned = [];
  try {
    const durations = [];
    const clipAudio = [];
    for (const s of list) {
      const r = await resolveSource(s);
      cleaned.push(r);
      const p = await probe(r.path);
      if (!p.duration_s) throw new ToolError('transitions: durée introuvable (ffprobe) sur une source');
      durations.push(p.duration_s);
      clipAudio.push(p.has_audio);
    }
    const hasAudioAll = clipAudio.every(Boolean);
    const outPath = await studioPath(ctx, 'transitions', 'mp4', args.output);
    let vChain = null; let aChain = null;
    const parts = [];
    let off = durations[0] - dur;
    parts.push(`[0:v][1:v]xfade=transition=${trans}:duration=${dur}:offset=${off.toFixed(3)}[xv1]`);
    for (let i = 2; i < cleaned.length; i++) {
      off = off + durations[i - 1] - dur;
      parts.push(`[xv${i - 1}][${i}:v]xfade=transition=${trans}:duration=${dur}:offset=${off.toFixed(3)}[xv${i}]`);
    }
    vChain = `[xv${cleaned.length - 1}]`;
    const fc = [...parts];
    if (hasAudioAll) {
      fc.push(`[0:a][1:a]acrossfade=d=${dur}[xa1]`);
      for (let i = 2; i < cleaned.length; i++) fc.push(`[xa${i - 1}][${i}:a]acrossfade=d=${dur}[xa${i}]`);
      aChain = `[xa${cleaned.length - 1}]`;
    }
    const ffArgs = ['-y'];
    for (const r of cleaned) ffArgs.push('-i', r.path);
    ffArgs.push('-filter_complex', fc.join(';'));
    ffArgs.push('-map', `[xv${cleaned.length - 1}]`);
    if (hasAudioAll) ffArgs.push('-map', `[xa${cleaned.length - 1}]`);
    ffArgs.push('-c:v', 'libx264', '-preset', 'medium', '-crf', '20', '-c:a', 'aac', '-movflags', '+faststart', outPath);
    await ff(null, ffArgs);
    return studioOut(ctx, 'media.video_transitions', outPath, { api: 'local', transition: trans, duration: dur, clips: cleaned.length });
  } finally { for (const r of cleaned) await r.cleanup().catch(() => {}); }
}

/* --- video_transcode ------------------------------------------------ */
async function video_transcode(args, ctx) {
  const src = await resolveSource(args.source);
  try {
    const fmt = String(args.format || 'mp4');
    const vcodec = { mp4: 'libx264', webm: 'libvpx-vp9', mkv: 'libx264', avi: 'libx264', mov: 'libx264' }[fmt] || 'libx264';
    const acodec = { mp4: 'aac', webm: 'libopus', mkv: 'aac', avi: 'mp3', mov: 'aac' }[fmt] || 'aac';
    const ext = fmt === 'webm' ? 'webm' : fmt;
    const outPath = await studioPath(ctx, 'transcode', ext, args.output);
    const filters = [];
    if (args.width || args.height) {
      const w = args.width ? `w=${clampNum(args.width, 1280, 16, 7680)}` : '-2';
      const h = args.height ? `h=${clampNum(args.height, 720, 16, 4320)}` : '-2';
      filters.push(`scale=${w}:${h}:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease`);
    }
    if (args.fps) filters.push(`fps=${clampNum(args.fps, 30, 1, 120)}`);
    const ffArgs = ['-y', '-i', src.path];
    if (filters.length) ffArgs.push('-vf', filters.join(','));
    ffArgs.push('-c:v', vcodec, '-crf', String(clampNum(args.crf, 23, 0, 51)), '-preset', args.preset || 'medium');
    ffArgs.push('-c:a', acodec);
    if (fmt === 'mp4') ffArgs.push('-movflags', '+faststart');
    ffArgs.push(outPath);
    await ff(src, ffArgs);
    const info = await probe(outPath);
    return studioOut(ctx, 'media.video_transcode', outPath, { api: 'local', format: fmt, codec: vcodec, width: info.width, height: info.height, fps: info.fps, size_bytes: info.size_bytes });
  } finally { await src.cleanup(); }
}

/* --- video_aspect (recadrage social) -------------------------------- */
async function video_aspect(args, ctx) {
  const src = await resolveSource(args.source);
  try {
    const ratio = String(args.ratio || '9:16');
    const [rw, rh] = ratio.split(':').map((x) => clampNum(x, 9, 1, 100));
    const mode = ['crop', 'blur', 'pad'].includes(args.mode) ? args.mode : 'crop';
    const p = await probe(src.path);
    const W = Math.round((p.width / p.height) * 1080);
    const H = 1080;
    let baseW = W; let baseH = H;
    if (rw / rh >= W / H) { baseW = W; baseH = Math.round((W * rh) / rw); } else { baseH = H; baseW = Math.round((H * rw) / rh); }
    let vf;
    if (mode === 'crop') {
      vf = `scale=${baseW}:${baseH}:force_original_aspect_ratio=increase,crop=${baseW}:${baseH}`;
    } else if (mode === 'pad') {
      vf = `scale=${baseW}:${baseH}:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease,pad=${baseW}:${baseH}:(ow-iw)/2:(oh-ih)/2:black`;
    } else {
      vf = `split[a][b];[a]scale=${baseW}:${baseH}:force_original_aspect_ratio=increase,boxblur=luma_radius=min(h\\,w)/40:luma_power=1[bgb];[b]scale=${baseW}:${baseH}:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease[fg];[bgb][fg]overlay=(W-w)/2:(H-h)/2`;
    }
    const outPath = await studioPath(ctx, 'aspect', 'mp4', args.output);
    const ffArgs = ['-y', '-i', src.path, '-vf', vf, '-c:v', 'libx264', '-preset', 'medium', '-crf', '20', '-c:a', 'aac', outPath];
    await ff(src, ffArgs);
    return studioOut(ctx, 'media.video_aspect', outPath, { api: 'local', ratio, mode, width: baseW, height: baseH });
  } finally { await src.cleanup(); }
}

/* --- video_split (segments) ----------------------------------------- */
async function video_split(args, ctx) {
  const src = await resolveSource(args.source);
  try {
    const chunk = clampNum(args.chunk_s, 10, 1, 3600);
    const dir = await fs.promises.mkdtemp(path.join(ctx.saveDir, '.split-'));
    const outPat = path.join(dir, 'part_%03d.mp4');
    const ffArgs = ['-y', '-i', src.path, '-c', 'copy', '-map', '0', '-f', 'segment', '-segment_time', String(chunk), '-reset_timestamps', '1', outPat];
    await ff(src, ffArgs);
    const files = (await fs.promises.readdir(dir)).filter((f) => f.endsWith('.mp4')).sort().map((f) => path.join(dir, f));
    if (!files.length) throw new ToolError('split: aucun segment produit');
    return makeResult('media.video_split', {
      local_path: files[0],
      meta: { api: 'local', chunk_s: chunk, parts: files.length, files },
    });
  } finally { await src.cleanup(); }
}

/* --- video_speed ----------------------------------------------------- */
async function video_speed(args, ctx) {
  const src = await resolveSource(args.source);
  try {
    const factor = Math.max(0.05, Number(args.factor) || 1);
    const outPath = await studioPath(ctx, 'speed', 'mp4', args.output);
    const vf = `setpts=PTS/${factor}`;
    const af = [];
    let f = factor;
    while (f > 2) { af.push('atempo=2'); f /= 2; }
    while (f < 0.5) { af.push('atempo=0.5'); f /= 0.5; }
    af.push(`atempo=${f.toFixed(6)}`);
    const ffArgs = ['-y', '-i', src.path, '-vf', vf, '-af', af.join(','), '-c:v', 'libx264', '-preset', 'medium', '-crf', '20', '-c:a', 'aac', outPath];
    await ff(src, ffArgs);
    return studioOut(ctx, 'media.video_speed', outPath, { api: 'local', factor });
  } finally { await src.cleanup(); }
}

/* --- video_reverse --------------------------------------------------- */
async function video_reverse(args, ctx) {
  const src = await resolveSource(args.source);
  try {
    const outPath = await studioPath(ctx, 'reverse', 'mp4', args.output);
    const ffArgs = ['-y', '-i', src.path, '-vf', 'reverse', '-af', 'areverse', '-c:v', 'libx264', '-preset', 'medium', '-crf', '20', '-c:a', 'aac', outPath];
    await ff(src, ffArgs);
    return studioOut(ctx, 'media.video_reverse', outPath, { api: 'local' });
  } finally { await src.cleanup(); }
}

/* --- video_fade ------------------------------------------------------- */
async function video_fade(args, ctx) {
  const src = await resolveSource(args.source);
  try {
    const fin = clampNum(args.fade_in, 0, 0, 60);
    const fout = clampNum(args.fade_out, 0, 0, 60);
    if (!fin && !fout) throw new ToolError('fade: fournir fade_in et/ou fade_out (secondes)');
    const color = String(args.color || 'black');
    const p = await probe(src.path);
    const filters = [];
    if (fin) filters.push(`fade=in:st=0:d=${fin}:color=${color}`);
    if (fout) filters.push(`fade=out:st=${Math.max(0, p.duration_s - fout).toFixed(3)}:d=${fout}:color=${color}`);
    const outPath = await studioPath(ctx, 'fade', 'mp4', args.output);
    const ffArgs = ['-y', '-i', src.path, '-vf', filters.join(','), '-c:v', 'libx264', '-preset', 'medium', '-crf', '20', '-c:a', 'aac', outPath];
    await ff(src, ffArgs);
    return studioOut(ctx, 'media.video_fade', outPath, { api: 'local', fade_in: fin, fade_out: fout, color });
  } finally { await src.cleanup(); }
}

/* --- video_crop -------------------------------------------------------- */
async function video_crop(args, ctx) {
  const src = await resolveSource(args.source);
  try {
    const w = clampNum(args.width, 640, 16, 7680);
    const h = clampNum(args.height, 360, 16, 4320);
    const x = args.x !== undefined ? clampNum(args.x, 0, 0, 100000) : '(in_w-out_w)/2';
    const y = args.y !== undefined ? clampNum(args.y, 0, 0, 100000) : '(in_h-out_h)/2';
    const outPath = await studioPath(ctx, 'crop', 'mp4', args.output);
    const ffArgs = ['-y', '-i', src.path, '-vf', `crop=${w}:${h}:${x}:${y}`, '-c:v', 'libx264', '-preset', 'medium', '-crf', '20', '-c:a', 'aac', outPath];
    await ff(src, ffArgs);
    return studioOut(ctx, 'media.video_crop', outPath, { api: 'local', width: w, height: h });
  } finally { await src.cleanup(); }
}

/* --- video_rotate ------------------------------------------------------ */
async function video_rotate(args, ctx) {
  const src = await resolveSource(args.source);
  try {
    const deg = Number(args.degrees);
    const flip = String(args.flip || 'none');
    let vf;
    if (flip === 'h') vf = 'hflip';
    else if (flip === 'v') vf = 'vflip';
    else if (deg === 90) vf = 'transpose=1';
    else if (deg === 270) vf = 'transpose=2';
    else if (deg === 180) vf = 'transpose=1,transpose=1';
    else throw new ToolError('rotate: degrees 90|180|270 ou flip h|v');
    const outPath = await studioPath(ctx, 'rotate', 'mp4', args.output);
    const ffArgs = ['-y', '-i', src.path, '-vf', vf, '-c:v', 'libx264', '-preset', 'medium', '-crf', '20', '-c:a', 'aac', outPath];
    await ff(src, ffArgs);
    return studioOut(ctx, 'media.video_rotate', outPath, { api: 'local', degrees: deg, flip });
  } finally { await src.cleanup(); }
}

/* --- video_stabilize ---------------------------------------------------- */
async function video_stabilize(args, ctx) {
  const src = await resolveSource(args.source);
  const tmp = await fs.promises.mkdtemp(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'mcm-vidstab-'));
  try {
    const trf = path.join(tmp, 'transforms.trf');
    await runCmd('ffmpeg', ['-y', '-i', src.path, '-vf', 'vidstabdetect=stepsize=6:shakiness=8:accuracy=9:result=' + trf, '-f', 'null', '-']);
    const outPath = await studioPath(ctx, 'stab', 'mp4', args.output);
    await runCmd('ffmpeg', ['-y', '-i', src.path, '-vf', 'vidstabtransform=input=' + trf + ':zoom=1:smoothing=10', '-c:v', 'libx264', '-preset', 'medium', '-crf', '20', '-c:a', 'aac', outPath]);
    return studioOut(ctx, 'media.video_stabilize', outPath, { api: 'local' });
  } finally { await src.cleanup(); await fs.promises.rm(tmp, { recursive: true, force: true }).catch(() => {}); }
}

/* --- video_chromakey ------------------------------------------------------ */
async function video_chromakey(args, ctx) {
  const src = await resolveSource(args.source);
  try {
    const color = String(args.color || '0x00FF00');
    const sim = clampNum(args.similarity, 0.12, 0, 1);
    const blend = clampNum(args.blend, 0.08, 0, 1);
    const ext = args.output ? path.extname(args.output).replace('.', '') || 'webm' : 'webm';
    const outFinal = args.output ? resolveOut(args.output, ctx.saveDir) : path.join(ctx.saveDir, `key_${Date.now()}.${ext}`);
    const ffArgs = ['-y', '-i', src.path, '-vf', `chromakey=${color}:similarity=${sim}:blend=${blend}`, '-c:v', 'libvpx-vp9', '-crf', '28', '-b:v', '0', '-c:a', 'libopus', outFinal];
    await ff(src, ffArgs);
    return studioOut(ctx, 'media.video_chromakey', outFinal, { api: 'local', color, similarity: sim });
  } finally { await src.cleanup(); }
}

/* --- video_colorgrade ------------------------------------------------------ */
async function video_colorgrade(args, ctx) {
  const src = await resolveSource(args.source);
  try {
    const parts = [];
    if (args.brightness !== undefined) parts.push(`brightness=${clampNum(args.brightness, 0, -1, 1)}`);
    if (args.contrast !== undefined) parts.push(`contrast=${clampNum(args.contrast, 1, 0, 3)}`);
    if (args.saturation !== undefined) parts.push(`saturation=${clampNum(args.saturation, 1, 0, 3)}`);
    if (args.gamma !== undefined) parts.push(`gamma=${clampNum(args.gamma, 1, 0.1, 5)}`);
    if (!parts.length && args.temperature === undefined) throw new ToolError('colorgrade: au moins un param (brightness|contrast|saturation|gamma|temperature)');
    const filters = [];
    if (parts.length) filters.push(`eq=${parts.join(':')}`);
    if (args.temperature !== undefined) {
      const t = clampNum(args.temperature, 0, -1000, 1000);
      filters.push(t > 0 ? `colortemperature=temperature=${Math.round(6500 + t * 5)}` : `colortemperature=temperature=${Math.round(6500 + t * 5)}`);
    }
    const outPath = await studioPath(ctx, 'grade', 'mp4', args.output);
    const ffArgs = ['-y', '-i', src.path, '-vf', filters.join(','), '-c:v', 'libx264', '-preset', 'medium', '-crf', '20', '-c:a', 'aac', outPath];
    await ff(src, ffArgs);
    return studioOut(ctx, 'media.video_colorgrade', outPath, { api: 'local', filters: filters.join(',') });
  } finally { await src.cleanup(); }
}

/* --- video_zoompan (Ken Burns) --------------------------------------------- */
async function video_zoompan(args, ctx) {
  const src = await resolveSource(args.source);
  try {
    const zoom = clampNum(args.zoom, 1.5, 1.01, 4);
    const p = await probe(src.path);
    const fps = p.fps || 30;
    const dur = clampNum(args.duration, Math.min(p.duration_s || 3, 5), 0.5, 60);
    const frames = Math.max(Math.round(fps * dur), 2);
    const outPath = await studioPath(ctx, 'zoom', 'mp4', args.output);
    const vf = `zoompan=z='min(zoom+0.0015,${zoom})':d=${frames}:s=${p.width}x${p.height}:fps=${fps}`;
    const ffArgs = ['-y', '-i', src.path, '-vf', vf, '-c:v', 'libx264', '-preset', 'medium', '-crf', '20', outPath];
    await ff(src, ffArgs);
    return studioOut(ctx, 'media.video_zoompan', outPath, { api: 'local', zoom, duration: dur });
  } finally { await src.cleanup(); }
}

/* --- video_title / watermark (drawtext + logo overlay) ---------------------- */
async function textFilter(args, force_style) {
  const font = findFont();
  const parts = [];
  if (font) parts.push(`fontfile=${font.replace(/\\/g, '\\\\').replace(/:/g, '\\:')}`);
  parts.push(`text='${String(args.text).replace(/'/g, '\\\'').replace(/\\/g, '\\\\').replace(/:/g, '\\:')}'`);
  if (args.font_size) parts.push(`fontsize=${clampNum(args.font_size, 48, 8, 400)}`);
  if (args.color) parts.push(`fontcolor=${args.color}`);
  if (args.box !== false) parts.push(`box=1:boxcolor=${args.boxcolor || 'black@0.55'}:boxborderw=${args.padding || 14}`);
  if (args.position === 'top') parts.push('x=(w-text_w)/2:y=48');
  else if (args.position === 'bottom') parts.push('x=(w-text_w)/2:y=h-text_h-48');
  else if (args.position === 'center') parts.push('x=(w-text_w)/2:y=(h-text_h)/2');
  else { parts.push(`x=${args.x !== undefined ? clampNum(args.x, 0, 0, 100000) : '(w-text_w)/2'}`); parts.push(`y=${args.y !== undefined ? clampNum(args.y, 0, 0, 100000) : 48}`); }
  if (args.start !== undefined || args.end !== undefined) {
    const en = [];
    if (args.start !== undefined) en.push(`gte(t\\,${fmtTS(args.start)})`);
    if (args.end !== undefined) en.push(`lte(t\\,${fmtTS(args.end)})`);
    parts.push(`enable='${en.join('+')}'`);
  }
  return 'drawtext=' + parts.join(':');
}
async function video_title(args, ctx) {
  const src = await resolveSource(args.source);
  try {
    const dt = await textFilter(args);
    const outPath = await studioPath(ctx, 'title', 'mp4', args.output);
    const ffArgs = ['-y', '-i', src.path, '-vf', dt, '-c:v', 'libx264', '-preset', 'medium', '-crf', '20', '-c:a', 'aac', outPath];
    await ff(src, ffArgs);
    return studioOut(ctx, 'media.video_title', outPath, { api: 'local', text: args.text });
  } finally { await src.cleanup(); }
}
async function video_watermark(args, ctx) {
  const src = await resolveSource(args.source);
  const logo = await resolveSource(args.logo);
  try {
    const scale = args.scale ? clampNum(args.scale, 0.2, 0.01, 1) : null;
    const opacity = clampNum(args.opacity, 1, 0, 1);
    const pos = String(args.position || 'tr');
    const filter = [
      `[1:v]${scale ? `scale=iw*${scale}:-2,` : ''}format=rgba,colorchannelmixer=aa=${opacity}[lgo]`,
      `[0:v][lgo]overlay=${pos === 'tl' ? '10:10' : pos === 'bl' ? '10:H-h-10' : pos === 'br' ? 'W-w-10:H-h-10' : 'W-w-10:10'}[v]`,
    ];
    const outPath = await studioPath(ctx, 'wm', 'mp4', args.output);
    const ffArgs = ['-y', '-i', src.path, '-i', logo.path, '-filter_complex', filter.join(';'), '-map', '[v]', '-map', '0:a?', '-c:v', 'libx264', '-preset', 'medium', '-crf', '20', '-c:a', 'aac', outPath];
    await ff(null, ffArgs);
    return studioOut(ctx, 'media.video_watermark', outPath, { api: 'local', position: pos, opacity });
  } finally { await src.cleanup(); await logo.cleanup(); }
}

/* --- video_pip (picture-in-picture) ------------------------------------------ */
async function video_pip(args, ctx) {
  const base = await resolveSource(args.source);
  const inset = await resolveSource(args.inset);
  try {
    const scale = clampNum(args.scale, 0.25, 0.05, 1);
    const pos = String(args.position || 'br');
    const muted = !!args.muted;
    const overlay = pos === 'tl' ? '10:10' : pos === 'bl' ? '10:H-h-10' : pos === 'tr' ? 'W-w-10:10' : 'W-w-10:H-h-10';
    const fc = [`[1:v]scale=iw*${scale}:-2[ins]`, `[0:v][ins]overlay=${overlay}[v]`];
    const outPath = await studioPath(ctx, 'pip', 'mp4', args.output);
    const ffArgs = ['-y', '-i', base.path, '-i', inset.path, '-filter_complex', fc.join(';'), '-map', '[v]'];
    if (muted) ffArgs.push('-map', '0:a?');
    else ffArgs.push('-map', '0:a?', '-map', '1:a?');
    ffArgs.push('-c:v', 'libx264', '-preset', 'medium', '-crf', '20', '-c:a', 'aac', '-shortest', outPath);
    await ff(null, ffArgs);
    return studioOut(ctx, 'media.video_pip', outPath, { api: 'local', position: pos, scale, muted });
  } finally { await base.cleanup(); await inset.cleanup(); }
}

/* --- audio_mix ----------------------------------------------------------------- */
async function audio_mix(args, ctx) {
  const list = Array.isArray(args.inputs) && args.inputs.length ? args.inputs : [];
  if (list.length < 2) throw new ToolError('mix: au moins 2 pistes (inputs[])');
  const cleaned = [];
  try {
    for (const s of list) cleaned.push(await resolveSource(s));
    const gains = Array.isArray(args.gains) && args.gains.length ? args.gains.map((g) => clampNum(g, 1, 0, 8)) : cleaned.map(() => 1);
    const filters = cleaned.map((_, i) => `[${i}:a]volume=${gains[i]}${i > 0 ? `,adelay=${clampNum(args.delay_ms, 0, 0, 60000)}|${clampNum(args.delay_ms, 0, 0, 60000)}` : ''}[a${i}]`);
    filters.push(`[a0]${cleaned.slice(1).map((_, i) => `[a${i + 1}]`).join('')}amix=inputs=${cleaned.length}:normalize=0[aout]`);
    const outPath = await studioPath(ctx, 'mix', 'wav', args.output || null);
    const ext = args.output ? path.extname(args.output).replace('.', '') || 'wav' : 'wav';
    const outFinal = args.output ? resolveOut(args.output, ctx.saveDir) : path.join(ctx.saveDir, `mix_${Date.now()}.${ext}`);
    const ffArgs = ['-y'];
    for (const r of cleaned) ffArgs.push('-i', r.path);
    ffArgs.push('-filter_complex', filters.join(';'), '-map', '[aout]', outFinal);
    await ff(null, ffArgs);
    return studioOut(ctx, 'media.audio_mix', outFinal, { api: 'local', tracks: cleaned.length, gains });
  } finally { for (const r of cleaned) await r.cleanup().catch(() => {}); }
}

/* --- audio_normalize ------------------------------------------------------------- */
async function audio_normalize(args, ctx) {
  const src = await resolveSource(args.source);
  try {
    const lufs = clampNum(args.target_lufs, -14, -70, 0);
    const tp = clampNum(args.target_tp, -1.5, -30, 0);
    const lra = clampNum(args.lra, 11, 1, 50);
    const outPath = await studioPath(ctx, 'norm', 'wav', args.output || null);
    const ext = args.output ? path.extname(args.output).replace('.', '') || 'wav' : 'wav';
    const outFinal = args.output ? resolveOut(args.output, ctx.saveDir) : path.join(ctx.saveDir, `norm_${Date.now()}.${ext}`);
    const ffArgs = ['-y', '-i', src.path, '-af', `loudnorm=I=${lufs}:TP=${tp}:LRA=${lra}`, outFinal];
    await ff(src, ffArgs);
    return studioOut(ctx, 'media.audio_normalize', outFinal, { api: 'local', target_lufs: lufs });
  } finally { await src.cleanup(); }
}
