/* --- audio_remove_silence ------------------------------------------------------------- */
async function audio_remove_silence(args, ctx) {
  const src = await resolveSource(args.source);
  try {
    const dur = clampNum(args.silence_duration, 0.4, 0.05, 5);
    const thr = clampNum(args.threshold_db, -35, -90, -1);
    const outPath = await studioPath(ctx, 'nosil', 'wav', args.output || null);
    const ext = args.output ? path.extname(args.output).replace('.', '') || 'wav' : 'wav';
    const outFinal = args.output ? resolveOut(args.output, ctx.saveDir) : path.join(ctx.saveDir, `nosil_${Date.now()}.${ext}`);
    const ffArgs = ['-y', '-i', src.path, '-af', `silenceremove=stop_periods=-1:stop_duration=${dur}:stop_threshold=-${Math.abs(thr)}dB`, outFinal];
    await ff(src, ffArgs);
    return studioOut(ctx, 'media.audio_remove_silence', outFinal, { api: 'local', silence_duration: dur });
  } finally { await src.cleanup(); }
}

/* --- audio_convert ------------------------------------------------------------------------ */
async function audio_convert(args, ctx) {
  const src = await resolveSource(args.source);
  try {
    const fmt = String(args.format || 'mp3');
    const codec = { mp3: 'libmp3lame', wav: 'pcm_s16le', aac: 'aac', flac: 'flac', m4a: 'aac', ogg: 'libvorbis', opus: 'libopus' }[fmt];
    if (!codec) throw new ToolError(`format non supporté: ${fmt}`);
    const outPath = await studioPath(ctx, 'aconv', fmt, args.output || null);
    const outFinal = args.output ? resolveOut(args.output, ctx.saveDir) : path.join(ctx.saveDir, `aconv_${Date.now()}.${fmt}`);
    const ffArgs = ['-y', '-i', src.path];
    if (args.bitrate) ffArgs.push('-b:a', String(args.bitrate));
    if (args.sample_rate) ffArgs.push('-ar', String(args.sample_rate));
    if (args.channels) ffArgs.push('-ac', String(args.channels));
    ffArgs.push('-acodec', codec, outFinal);
    await ff(src, ffArgs);
    return studioOut(ctx, 'media.audio_convert', outFinal, { api: 'local', format: fmt, codec });
  } finally { await src.cleanup(); }
}

/* --- audio_tempo / audio_pitch -------------------------------------------------------------- */
async function audio_tempo(args, ctx) {
  const src = await resolveSource(args.source);
  try {
    const factor = Math.max(0.05, Number(args.factor) || 1);
    const af = [];
    let f = factor;
    while (f > 2) { af.push('atempo=2'); f /= 2; }
    while (f < 0.5) { af.push('atempo=0.5'); f /= 0.5; }
    af.push(`atempo=${f.toFixed(6)}`);
    const outPath = await studioPath(ctx, 'tempo', 'wav', args.output || null);
    const ext = args.output ? path.extname(args.output).replace('.', '') || 'wav' : 'wav';
    const outFinal = args.output ? resolveOut(args.output, ctx.saveDir) : path.join(ctx.saveDir, `tempo_${Date.now()}.${ext}`);
    const ffArgs = ['-y', '-i', src.path, '-af', af.join(','), outFinal];
    await ff(src, ffArgs);
    return studioOut(ctx, 'media.audio_tempo', outFinal, { api: 'local', factor });
  } finally { await src.cleanup(); }
}
async function audio_pitch(args, ctx) {
  const src = await resolveSource(args.source);
  try {
    const semitones = clampNum(args.semitones, 0, -24, 24);
    const ratio = Math.pow(2, semitones / 12);
    const outPath = await studioPath(ctx, 'pitch', 'wav', args.output || null);
    const tempoFilters = [];
    let t = 1 / ratio;
    while (t < 0.5) { tempoFilters.push('atempo=0.5'); t /= 0.5; }
    while (t > 2.0) { tempoFilters.push('atempo=2.0'); t /= 2.0; }
    tempoFilters.push(`atempo=${t.toFixed(6)}`);
    const ffArgs = ['-y', '-i', src.path, '-af', `asetrate=44100*${ratio.toFixed(6)},aresample=44100,${tempoFilters.join(',')}`, outPath];
    await ff(src, ffArgs);
    return studioOut(ctx, 'media.audio_pitch', outPath, { api: 'local', semitones });
  } finally { await src.cleanup(); }
}

/* --- video_mux_audio ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
async function video_mux_audio(args, ctx) {
  const vid = await resolveSource(args.video);
  const aud = await resolveSource(args.audio);
  try {
    const outPath = await studioPath(ctx, 'mux', 'mp4', args.output);
    const hasOffset = !!args.offset;
    const ffArgs = ['-y', '-i', vid.path, '-i', aud.path];
    if (hasOffset) ffArgs.push('-af', `adelay=${clampNum(args.offset, 0, 0, 60000)}|${clampNum(args.offset, 0, 0, 60000)}`);
    ffArgs.push('-map', '0:v', '-map', '1:a');
    if (args.reencode || hasOffset) ffArgs.push('-c:v', 'libx264', '-preset', 'medium', '-crf', '20', '-c:a', 'aac');
    else ffArgs.push('-c', 'copy');
    ffArgs.push('-shortest', outPath);
    await ff(null, ffArgs);
    return studioOut(ctx, 'media.video_mux_audio', outPath, { api: 'local', offset: args.offset || 0 });
  } finally { await vid.cleanup(); await aud.cleanup(); }
}

/* --- subtitle_generate (STT navy -> SRT) ----------------------------------------------------- */
async function subtitle_generate(args, ctx) {
  const src = await resolveSource(args.source);
  const tmp = await fs.promises.mkdtemp(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'mcm-sub-'));
  try {
    const wav = path.join(tmp, 'audio.wav');
    await runCmd('ffmpeg', ['-y', '-i', src.path, '-vn', '-acodec', 'pcm_s16le', '-ar', '16000', '-ac', '1', wav]);
    let srt = null;
    let plain = null;
    try {
      const model = args.model || null;
      const entries = [{ name: 'file', file: wav }, { name: 'model', value: model || 'whisper-1' }];
      if (args.language) entries.push({ name: 'language', value: args.language });
      entries.push({ name: 'response_format', value: 'srt' });
      const res = await api(`${CFG.NAVY_BASE}/audio/transcriptions`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: navyHeaders(),
        formData: buildForm(entries),
        timeout: 180000,
      });
      if (res.ok) {
        const body = typeof res.data === 'string' ? res.data : JSON.stringify(res.data || '');
        if (/\d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2}[,.]\d{3}/.test(body)) srt = body;
        else plain = (parseJsonRes(res) && parseJsonRes(res).text) || body;
      } else {
        plain = `STT échec ${res.status}`;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      plain = errMsg(e);
    }
    if (!srt && args.text) {
      srt = `1\n00:00:00,000 --> 99:00:00,000\n${String(args.text).replace(/\n/g, ' ')}\n`;
      plain = args.text;
    }
    if (!srt && plain) {
      srt = `1\n00:00:00,000 --> 99:00:00,000\n${plain}\n`;
    }
    if (!srt) throw new ToolError('subtitle_generate: aucun texte produit');
    const outPath = await studioPath(ctx, 'subs', 'srt', args.output);
    await fs.promises.writeFile(outPath, srt, 'utf8');
    return makeResult('media.subtitle_generate', { local_path: outPath, meta: { api: 'navy', mode: plain ? 'fallback' : 'srt', text: plain || null } });
  } finally { await src.cleanup(); await fs.promises.rm(tmp, { recursive: true, force: true }).catch(() => {}); }
}

/* --- subtitle_burn ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ */
async function subtitle_burn(args, ctx) {
  const src = await resolveSource(args.source);
  try {
    const srt = String(args.srt);
    const srtPath = fs.existsSync(srt) ? srt : (await resolveSource(srt)).path;
    const style = args.style || 'FontSize=18,PrimaryColour=&H00FFFFFF,OutlineColour=&H00000000,BorderStyle=3,Outline=1.2';
    const esc = srtPath.replace(/\\/g, '\\\\').replace(/:/g, '\\:').replace(/'/g, '\\\'');
    const outPath = await studioPath(ctx, 'subs', 'mp4', args.output);
    const ffArgs = ['-y', '-i', src.path, '-vf', `subtitles=${esc}:force_style='${style}'`, '-c:v', 'libx264', '-preset', 'medium', '-crf', '20', '-c:a', 'aac', outPath];
    await ff(src, ffArgs);
    return studioOut(ctx, 'media.subtitle_burn', outPath, { api: 'local', srt: srtPath });
  } finally { await src.cleanup(); }
}

/* --- video_contact_sheet -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
async function video_contact_sheet(args, ctx) {
  const src = await resolveSource(args.source);
  try {
    const cols = clampNum(args.cols, 4, 1, 8);
    const rows = clampNum(args.rows, 3, 1, 8);
    const total = cols * rows;
    const cellW = clampNum(args.cell_width, 320, 64, 1280);
    const p = await probe(src.path);
    const dur = Math.max(p.duration_s, 0.001);
    const fps = Math.max(1, total / dur);
    const outPath = await studioPath(ctx, 'sheet', 'jpg', args.output || null);
    const outFinal = args.output ? resolveOut(args.output, ctx.saveDir) : path.join(ctx.saveDir, `sheet_${Date.now()}.jpg`);
    const ffArgs = ['-y', '-i', src.path, '-vf', `fps=${fps.toFixed(4)},scale=${cellW}:-2,tile=${cols}x${rows}`, '-frames:v', '1', '-q:v', '4', outFinal];
    await ff(src, ffArgs);
    return studioOut(ctx, 'media.video_contact_sheet', outFinal, { api: 'local', cols, rows, frames: total });
  } finally { await src.cleanup(); }
}

/* --- video_scene_detect ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
async function video_scene_detect(args, ctx) {
  const src = await resolveSource(args.source);
  try {
    const thr = clampNum(args.threshold, 0.4, 0.1, 0.9);
    const { out, err } = await runCmd('ffmpeg', ['-i', src.path, '-vf', `select='gt(scene,${thr})',showinfo`, '-f', 'null', '-']);
    const times = [];
    const re = /pts_time:([0-9.]+)/g;
    let m;
    while ((m = re.exec(out + err)) !== null) times.push(parseFloat(m[1]));
    const p = await probe(src.path);
    const scenes = [];
    if (times.length === 0) {
      scenes.push({ start: 0, end: Math.round(p.duration_s * 1000) / 1000, index: 1 });
    } else {
      for (let i = 0; i < times.length; i++) {
        scenes.push({ start: times[i], end: i + 1 < times.length ? times[i + 1] : Math.round(p.duration_s * 1000) / 1000, index: i + 1 });
      }
    }
    return makeResult('media.video_scene_detect', { local_path: null, meta: { api: 'local', threshold: thr, scenes: scenes.slice(0, 200) } });
  } finally { await src.cleanup(); }
}

/* --- video_audio_report ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ */
async function video_audio_report(args, ctx) {
  const src = await resolveSource(args.source);
  try {
    const { out, err } = await runCmd('ffmpeg', ['-i', src.path, '-af', 'volumedetect,silencedetect=n=-35dB:d=0.8', '-f', 'null', '-']);
    const text = out + err;
    const g = (re) => { const m = re.exec(text); return m ? parseFloat(m[1]) : null; };
    const silences = [];
    const re = /silence_(start|end):\s*([0-9.]+)/g;
    let m;
    while ((m = re.exec(text)) !== null) silences.push({ type: m[1], t: parseFloat(m[2]) });
    const info = await probe(src.path);
    return makeResult('media.video_audio_report', {
      local_path: null,
      meta: {
        api: 'local',
        mean_volume_db: g(/mean_volume:\s*(-?[0-9.]+)/),
        max_volume_db: g(/max_volume:\s*(-?[0-9.]+)/),
        peak_db: g(/max_peak:\s*(-?[0-9.]+)/),
        silences,
        has_audio: info.has_audio,
        duration_s: info.duration_s,
      },
    });
  } finally { await src.cleanup(); }
}

/* --- video_gif --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
async function video_gif(args, ctx) {
  const src = await resolveSource(args.source);
  const tmp = await fs.promises.mkdtemp(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'mcm-gif-'));
  try {
    const pal = path.join(tmp, 'pal.png');
    const fps = clampNum(args.fps, 12, 1, 30);
    const pre = ['-y', '-i', src.path];
    if (args.start !== undefined) pre.push('-ss', fmtTS(args.start));
    if (args.duration !== undefined) pre.push('-t', fmtTS(args.duration));
    pre.push('-vf', `fps=${fps},scale=${clampNum(args.width, 480, 64, 1920)}:-1:flags=lanczos,palettegen`, pal);
    await runCmd('ffmpeg', pre);
    const outPath = await studioPath(ctx, 'gif', 'gif', args.output);
    const post = ['-y', '-i', src.path, '-i', pal];
    if (args.start !== undefined) post.push('-ss', fmtTS(args.start));
    if (args.duration !== undefined) post.push('-t', fmtTS(args.duration));
    post.push('-vf', `fps=${fps},scale=${clampNum(args.width, 480, 64, 1920)}:-1:flags=lanczos[x];[x][1:v]paletteuse=dither=bayer`, outPath);
    await runCmd('ffmpeg', post);
    return studioOut(ctx, 'media.video_gif', outPath, { api: 'local', fps, width: clampNum(args.width, 480, 64, 1920) });
  } finally { await src.cleanup(); await fs.promises.rm(tmp, { recursive: true, force: true }).catch(() => {}); }
}

/* --- video_waveform ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ */
async function video_waveform(args, ctx) {
  const src = await resolveSource(args.source);
  try {
    const w = clampNum(args.width, 1200, 100, 4096);
    const h = clampNum(args.height, 300, 40, 1200);
    const color = String(args.color || '0xE8C877');
    const outPath = await studioPath(ctx, 'wave', 'png', args.output);
    const ffArgs = ['-y', '-i', src.path, '-filter_complex', `showwavespic=s=${w}x${h}:colors=${color}`, '-frames:v', '1', outPath];
    await ff(src, ffArgs);
    return studioOut(ctx, 'media.video_waveform', outPath, { api: 'local', width: w, height: h });
  } finally { await src.cleanup(); }
}

/* --- video_ocr (tesseract, si dispo) --------------------------------------------------------------------- */
async function video_ocr(args, ctx) {
  const src = await resolveSource(args.source);
  const tmp = await fs.promises.mkdtemp(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'mcm-ocr-'));
  try {
    const ts = fmtTS(args.at_time !== undefined ? args.at_time : 0);
    const frame = path.join(tmp, 'f.png');
    await runCmd('ffmpeg', ['-y', '-ss', ts, '-i', src.path, '-frames:v', '1', frame]);
    let res;
    try {
      res = await runCmd('tesseract', [frame, 'stdout', '-l', args.lang || 'fra+eng']);
    } catch (e) {
      throw new ToolError('video_ocr: tesseract absent ou échec (' + errMsg(e) + ')');
    }
    const outPath = await studioPath(ctx, 'ocr', 'png', args.output || null);
    await fs.promises.copyFile(frame, outPath);
    return makeResult('media.video_ocr', { local_path: outPath, meta: { api: 'local', at_time: args.at_time || 0, text: res.out.trim() } });
  } finally { await src.cleanup(); await fs.promises.rm(tmp, { recursive: true, force: true }).catch(() => {}); }
}

/* ================================================================== *
 *  P2.1 — Provider state, circuit breaker, generative routing
 * ================================================================== */
const PROVIDER_STATE_FILE = path.join(__dirname, '.mcm-provider-state.json');
const CB = { max_errors: 3, window_ms: 300000, cooldown_ms: 120000 };

function readProviderState() {
  try {
    const j = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(PROVIDER_STATE_FILE, 'utf8'));
    return j && typeof j === 'object' ? j : {};
  } catch (_) { return {}; }
}
function writeProviderState(st) {
  try {
    const tmp = PROVIDER_STATE_FILE + '.tmp';
    fs.writeFileSync(tmp, JSON.stringify(st, null, 1));
    fs.renameSync(tmp, PROVIDER_STATE_FILE);
  } catch (e) { log('provider state write failed: ' + errMsg(e)); }
}
function recordProvider(name, ok, detail) {
  const st = readProviderState();
  const e = st[name] || { errors: 0, successes: 0, state: 'closed' };
  if (ok) {
    e.errors = 0; e.state = 'closed'; e.successes = (e.successes || 0) + 1;
    e.last_success_ts = Date.now(); e.last_detail = detail || null;
  } else {
    const now = Date.now();
    if (now - (e.first_error_ts || 0) > CB.window_ms) { e.errors = 0; e.first_error_ts = now; }
    e.errors += 1; e.last_error_ts = now; e.last_detail = detail || null;
    if (e.errors >= CB.max_errors) { e.state = 'open'; e.open_ts = now; }
  }
  st[name] = e;
  writeProviderState(st);
}
function providerCircuitOpen(name) {
  const e = readProviderState()[name];
  if (!e || e.state !== 'open') return false;
  return Date.now() - (e.open_ts || 0) <= CB.cooldown_ms;
}

const GEN_ROUTES = { image: ['pruna', 'navy'], video: ['pruna'], tts: ['tts'] };
const PROVIDER_KEYS = { pruna: 'PRUNA_KEY', navy: 'NAVY_KEY', imgtools: 'IMGTOOLS_KEY', tts: 'TTS_KEY' };
const providerConfigured = (name) => !!CFG[PROVIDER_KEYS[name]];

let navyModelCache = null;
async function pickNavyImageModel() {
  if (!navyModelCache) {
    const res = await api(`${CFG.NAVY_BASE}/models`, { headers: navyHeaders(), timeout: 30000 });
    if (!res.ok) throw new ToolError(`navy /models failed: ${describe(res, res.data)}`);
    const j = parseJsonRes(res);
    navyModelCache = Array.isArray(j) ? j : (j && (j.data || j.models)) || [];
  }
  const re = /image|flux|sdxl|dall|imagen|stable/i;
  const m = navyModelCache.find((x) => re.test(String(x.id || x.name || ''))) || navyModelCache[0];
  return m ? String(m.id || m.name) : null;
}

async function routeGen(toolName, kind, args, ctx) {
  if (!args.prompt && !args.input) throw new ToolError('prompt (ou input pour tts) requis');
  const forced = args.provider || null;
  const fallbackPolicy = args.fallback_policy || 'equivalent_only';
  if (forced && !GEN_ROUTES[kind].includes(forced)) {
    throw new ToolError(`provider ${forced} ne gère pas ${kind} (routes: ${GEN_ROUTES[kind].join(', ')})`);
  }
  const order = forced ? [forced] : GEN_ROUTES[kind].filter(providerConfigured);
  if (!order.length) throw new ToolError(`aucun provider configuré pour ${kind} (clés .env manquantes)`);
  const tried = [];
  for (const name of order) {
    if (!forced && fallbackPolicy !== 'none' && providerCircuitOpen(name)) {
      tried.push({ provider: name, skipped: 'circuit_open' });
      continue;
    }
    try {
      let out;
      if (kind === 'image') {
        if (name === 'pruna') out = await image_gen(args, ctx);
        else {
          const model = args.model || (await pickNavyImageModel());
          if (!model) throw new ToolError('navy: aucun modèle trouvé via /v1/models');
          out = await navy_image_gen({ prompt: args.prompt, model, aspect_ratio: args.aspect_ratio, seed: args.seed, image_url: args.image }, ctx);
        }
      } else if (kind === 'video') {
        out = await video_gen(args, ctx);
      } else {
        out = await tts(args, ctx);
      }
      recordProvider(name, true);
      out.tool = toolName;
      out.meta = Object.assign({}, out.meta || {}, {
        routed: { provider: name, forced: !!forced, fallback_policy: fallbackPolicy, alternatives: order.filter((x) => x !== name), tried },
      });
      return out;
    } catch (e) {
      recordProvider(name, false, errMsg(e));
      tried.push({ provider: name, error: errMsg(e) });
      if (forced || fallbackPolicy === 'none') break;
    }
  }
  throw new ToolError(`${toolName}: échec provider(s): ${tried.map((t) => t.provider + ': ' + (t.error || t.skipped)).join(' | ')}`, { tried });
}

const image_best = (args, ctx) => routeGen('media.image_best', 'image', args, ctx);
const video_best = (args, ctx) => routeGen('media.video_best', 'video', args, ctx);
const tts_best = (args, ctx) => routeGen('media.tts_best', 'tts', args, ctx);

async function provider_status() {
  return makeResult('media.provider_status', {
    meta: {
      states: readProviderState(),
      circuit_breaker: CB,
      routes: GEN_ROUTES,
      configured: Object.fromEntries(Object.keys(PROVIDER_KEYS).map((k) => [k, providerConfigured(k)])),
    },
  });
}

/* ================================================================== *
 *  P2.4 — Vision adapter (OpenAI-compatible chat/completions)
 *  Providers + prompts are agent-configurable, stored in external JSON.
 * ================================================================== */
const VISION_CONFIG_FILE = path.join(__dirname, 'vision-config.json');
const VISION_PROMPTS_FILE = path.join(__dirname, 'vision-prompts.json');

function visionConfig() {
  try {
    const j = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(VISION_CONFIG_FILE, 'utf8'));
    if (j && Array.isArray(j.providers)) return j;
  } catch (_) {}
  return { default: null, providers: [] };
}
function writeVisionConfig(cfg) {
  const tmp = VISION_CONFIG_FILE + '.tmp';
  fs.writeFileSync(tmp, JSON.stringify(cfg, null, 2));
  fs.renameSync(tmp, VISION_CONFIG_FILE);
}

const DEFAULT_VISION_PROMPTS = {
  media_qa: {
    system: 'You are a precise media analysis assistant. Answer strictly and factually.',
    user: 'Analyze the attached media and answer this question: {question}',
  },
  quality_check: {
    system: 'You are a strict post-production QA reviewer.',
    user: 'List technical and visual defects in this media (artifacts, bad framing, cut-off or unreadable text, distortion, black frames). Reply ONLY with JSON: {"acceptable": true|false, "defects": ["..."], "score": 0-10}.',
  },
  prompt_compliance: {
    system: 'You are a strict reviewer comparing a generated media against its prompt.',
    user: 'Original prompt: "{prompt}". Does the media match it? Reply ONLY with JSON: {"acceptable": true|false, "missing": ["..."], "score": 0-10}.',
  },
  ocr: {
    system: 'You are an OCR engine.',
    user: 'Transcribe ALL visible text in this media exactly as written.',
  },
  scene_description: {
    system: 'You are a concise media describer.',
    user: 'Describe this media in detail: scene, subjects, actions, camera, visible text.',
  },
};
function visionPrompts() {
  try {
    const j = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(VISION_PROMPTS_FILE, 'utf8'));
    if (j && j.prompts) return j;
  } catch (_) {}
  return { default_task: 'media_qa', prompts: DEFAULT_VISION_PROMPTS };
}
function writeVisionPrompts(p) {
  const tmp = VISION_PROMPTS_FILE + '.tmp';
  fs.writeFileSync(tmp, JSON.stringify(p, null, 2));
  fs.renameSync(tmp, VISION_PROMPTS_FILE);
}
function fillTemplate(tpl, vars) {
  return String(tpl || '').replace(/\{(\w+)\}/g, (m, k) => (vars[k] !== undefined ? String(vars[k]) : m));
}
const maskKey = (k) => (k && k.length > 8 ? k.slice(0, 4) + '…' + k.slice(-4) : '***');

async function vision_provider_add(args) {
  for (const k of ['name', 'base_url', 'api_key', 'model']) {
    if (!args[k]) throw new ToolError(`${k} requis`);
  }
  const caps = Array.isArray(args.capabilities) && args.capabilities.length ? args.capabilities : ['image'];
  const cfg = visionConfig();
  const entry = {
    name: String(args.name),
    base_url: String(args.base_url).replace(/\/+$/, ''),
    api_key: String(args.api_key),
    model: String(args.model),
    capabilities: caps,
    max_images: Math.min(Math.max(Number(args.max_images) || 4, 1), 12),
    video_format: ['file', 'openai'].includes(args.video_format) ? args.video_format : 'file',
    audio_format: ['file', 'openai'].includes(args.audio_format) ? args.audio_format : 'file',
    added_at: new Date().toISOString(),
  };
  const existing = cfg.providers.find((p) => p.name === entry.name);
  if (existing) Object.assign(existing, entry);
  else cfg.providers.push(entry);
  if (args.is_default || !cfg.default) cfg.default = entry.name;
  writeVisionConfig(cfg);
  return makeResult('media.vision_provider_add', {
    meta: { provider: Object.assign({}, entry, { api_key: '***' }), default: cfg.default, count: cfg.providers.length },
  });
}

async function vision_provider_remove(args) {
  if (!args.name) throw new ToolError('name requis');
  const cfg = visionConfig();
  const before = cfg.providers.length;
  cfg.providers = cfg.providers.filter((p) => p.name !== args.name);
  if (cfg.providers.length === before) throw new ToolError(`provider vision introuvable: ${args.name}`);
  if (cfg.default === args.name) cfg.default = cfg.providers.length ? cfg.providers[0].name : null;
  writeVisionConfig(cfg);
  return makeResult('media.vision_provider_remove', { meta: { removed: args.name, default: cfg.default, count: cfg.providers.length } });
}

async function vision_provider_list() {
  const cfg = visionConfig();
  const states = readProviderState();
  return makeResult('media.vision_provider_list', {
    meta: {
      default: cfg.default,
      providers: cfg.providers.map((p) => ({
        name: p.name, base_url: p.base_url, model: p.model, capabilities: p.capabilities,
        video_format: p.video_format || 'file', audio_format: p.audio_format || 'file',
        api_key: maskKey(p.api_key), is_default: p.name === cfg.default,
        circuit: (states['vision:' + p.name] || { state: 'closed' }).state,
      })),
    },
  });
}

async function vision_default_set(args) {
  if (!args.name) throw new ToolError('name requis');
  const cfg = visionConfig();
  if (!cfg.providers.find((p) => p.name === args.name)) throw new ToolError(`provider vision introuvable: ${args.name}`);
  cfg.default = args.name;
  writeVisionConfig(cfg);
  return makeResult('media.vision_default_set', { meta: { default: cfg.default } });
}

async function vision_prompt_list() {
  return makeResult('media.vision_prompt_list', { meta: visionPrompts() });
}

async function vision_prompt_set(args) {
  if (!args.task) throw new ToolError('task requis (ex: quality_check)');
  if (!args.user && !args.system) throw new ToolError('user ou system requis');
  const p = visionPrompts();
  const prev = p.prompts[args.task] || {};
  p.prompts[args.task] = { system: args.system !== undefined ? String(args.system) : prev.system || '', user: args.user !== undefined ? String(args.user) : prev.user || '' };
  if (args.is_default) p.default_task = args.task;
  writeVisionPrompts(p);
  return makeResult('media.vision_prompt_set', { meta: { task: args.task, default_task: p.default_task, prompt: p.prompts[args.task] } });
}

async function vision_prompt_remove(args) {
  if (!args.task) throw new ToolError('task requis');
  const p = visionPrompts();
  if (!p.prompts[args.task]) throw new ToolError(`tâche introuvable: ${args.task}`);
  delete p.prompts[args.task];
  if (p.default_task === args.task) p.default_task = Object.keys(p.prompts)[0] || null;
  writeVisionPrompts(p);
  return makeResult('media.vision_prompt_remove', { meta: { removed: args.task, default_task: p.default_task } });
}

const VISION_GUIDE_FILE = path.join(__dirname, 'QWEN_RUNTIME_MULTIMODAL_CURL_GUIDE.md');

/*
 * media.vision_guide — self-contained access to the Qwen Runtime multimodal
 * integration guide (file join formats, limits, audio perception thresholds).
 * Clients without file access (reasonix, ...) can read it through the MCP.
 */
async function vision_guide(args) {
  let text = '';
  try {
    text = fs.readFileSync(VISION_GUIDE_FILE, 'utf8');
  } catch (e) {
    throw new ToolError(`guide introuvable: ${e.message}`);
  }
  const summary = args.summary === true;
  if (summary) {
    text = text
      .split('\n')
      .filter((l) => !l.trim().startsWith('```'))
      .join('\n');
  }
  return makeResult('media.vision_guide', {
    local_path: VISION_GUIDE_FILE,
    meta: {
      path: VISION_GUIDE_FILE,
      bytes: Buffer.byteLength(text, 'utf8'),
      summary,
      guide: text,
    },
  });
}

async function visionChatCall(provider, messages, timeoutMs) {
  const res = await api(`${provider.base_url}/chat/completions`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${provider.api_key}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: { model: provider.model, messages },
    timeout: timeoutMs,
  });
  const j = parseJsonRes(res);
  if (!res.ok) {
    throw new ToolError(`vision ${provider.name}: HTTP ${res.status} ${typeof j === 'string' ? j.slice(0, 200) : JSON.stringify(j).slice(0, 200)}`);
  }
  const text = j && j.choices && j.choices[0] && j.choices[0].message ? String(j.choices[0].message.content || '') : '';
  if (!text) throw new ToolError(`vision ${provider.name}: réponse vide`);
  return text;
}

const VIDEO_EXT = ['.mp4', '.webm', '.mkv', '.avi', '.mov', '.m4v'];
const AUDIO_EXT = ['.mp3', '.wav', '.aac', '.flac', '.ogg', '.m4a'];

const VIDEO_MIME = { '.mp4': 'video/mp4', '.webm': 'video/webm', '.mkv': 'video/x-matroska', '.avi': 'video/x-msvideo', '.mov': 'video/quicktime', '.m4v': 'video/x-m4v' };

function audioDurationSec(p) {
  try {
    const out = require('child_process').execSync(
      `ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration -of csv=p=0 ${JSON.stringify(p)}`,
      { timeout: 10000, stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'ignore'] }
    ).toString().trim();
    const n = Number(out);
    return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : null;
  } catch (_) { return null; }
}

function visionCapable(p, needed) {
  return (p.capabilities || []).includes(needed);
}

/*
 * Build the provider-specific message parts for a media batch.
 *
 * Image sources are always sent as OpenAI image_url parts (universal).
 * Video sources are sent natively when the provider declares video
 * capability (part format from provider.video_format), otherwise degraded
 * to extracted keyframes when the provider is image-capable. Audio sources
 * require audio capability and are delivered as an mp3 file-part ('file'
 * format, Qwen runtime style) or wav input_audio ('openai' format, Gemini
 * style). File parts always carry mime_type and filename, otherwise the
 * Qwen file-join silently drops the attachment. max_images caps the number
 * of image_url parts (native images + keyframes).
 */
async function buildVisionParts(p, work, framesArg) {
  const parts = [];
  const warnings = [];
  let imageCount = 0;
  for (const s of work.sources) {
    if (s.kind === 'image') {
      if (!visionCapable(p, 'image')) throw new Error(`provider '${p.name}' sans capacité image`);
      parts.push({ type: 'image_url', image_url: { url: toDataUri(s.path) } });
      imageCount++;
    } else if (s.kind === 'video') {
      if (visionCapable(p, 'video')) {
        const uri = toDataUri(s.path);
        if ((p.video_format || 'file') === 'openai') {
          parts.push({ type: 'video_url', video_url: { url: uri } });
        } else {
          const ext = (path.extname(s.path) || '.mp4').toLowerCase();
          parts.push({ type: 'file', file: { url: uri, mime_type: VIDEO_MIME[ext] || 'video/mp4', filename: 'video' + ext } });
        }
      } else if (visionCapable(p, 'image')) {
        const n = Math.min(Math.max(Number(framesArg) || 3, 1), 8);
        const tmp = await fs.promises.mkdtemp(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'mcm-vis-'));
        work.tmpDirs.push(tmp);
        await runCmd('ffmpeg', ['-y', '-hide_banner', '-loglevel', 'error', '-i', s.path, '-vf', 'fps=1,scale=1024:-2', '-frames:v', String(n), path.join(tmp, 'f_%03d.jpg')]);
        const files = fs.readdirSync(tmp).filter((f) => f.endsWith('.jpg')).sort().slice(0, n);
        if (!files.length) throw new Error('extraction de frames impossible: ' + s.path);
        for (const f of files) parts.push({ type: 'image_url', image_url: { url: toDataUri(path.join(tmp, f)) } });
        imageCount += files.length;
        warnings.push(`vidéo → ${files.length} frame(s) (provider sans vidéo native)`);
      } else {
        throw new Error(`provider '${p.name}' ne peut traiter la vidéo (ni capacité video ni image)`);
      }
    } else if (s.kind === 'audio') {
      if (!visionCapable(p, 'audio')) throw new Error(`provider '${p.name}' sans capacité audio (utiliser un provider audio ou media.stt)`);
      const dur = audioDurationSec(s.path);
      if (dur !== null && dur < 45) warnings.push(`audio court (${dur.toFixed(1)}s) : l'upload peut réussir sans perception — viser ≥ 48s`);
      let local = s.path;
      if ((p.audio_format || 'file') === 'openai') {
        if (path.extname(local).toLowerCase() !== '.wav') {
          const tmp = await fs.promises.mkdtemp(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'mcm-aud-'));
          work.tmpDirs.push(tmp);
          local = path.join(tmp, 'audio.wav');
          await runCmd('ffmpeg', ['-y', '-hide_banner', '-loglevel', 'error', '-i', s.path, '-ac', '2', '-ar', '44100', local]);
        }
        const b64 = fs.readFileSync(local).toString('base64');
        parts.push({ type: 'input_audio', input_audio: { data: b64, format: 'wav' } });
      } else {
        if (path.extname(local).toLowerCase() !== '.mp3') {
          const tmp = await fs.promises.mkdtemp(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'mcm-aud-'));
          work.tmpDirs.push(tmp);
          local = path.join(tmp, 'audio.mp3');
          await runCmd('ffmpeg', ['-y', '-hide_banner', '-loglevel', 'error', '-i', s.path, '-codec:a', 'libmp3lame', '-b:a', '128k', local]);
        }
        const b64 = fs.readFileSync(local).toString('base64');
        parts.push({ type: 'file', file: { url: 'data:audio/mpeg;base64,' + b64, mime_type: 'audio/mpeg', filename: 'audio.mp3' } });
      }
    }
  }
  const maxImages = Math.min(Math.max(Number(p.max_images) || 4, 1), 12);
  if (imageCount > maxImages) {
    let seen = 0;
    const filtered = [];
    for (const pt of parts) {
      if (pt.type === 'image_url') { if (seen >= maxImages) continue; seen++; }
      filtered.push(pt);
    }
    warnings.push(`${imageCount - maxImages} image(s) retirée(s) (max_images=${maxImages})`);
    return { parts: filtered, warnings, imageCount: seen };
  }
  return { parts, warnings, imageCount };
}

async function vision_check(args, ctx) {
  if (!args.source) throw new ToolError('source requis (chemin/URL ou tableau)');
  const cfg = visionConfig();
  if (!cfg.providers.length) throw new ToolError('aucun provider vision configuré \u2014 utiliser media.vision_provider_add');
  const sources = Array.isArray(args.source) ? args.source.slice(0, 5) : [args.source];
  const tmpDirs = [];
  try {
    const work = { sources: [], tmpDirs };
    for (const s of sources) {
      const src = await resolveSource(s);
      try {
        const ext = path.extname(src.path).toLowerCase();
        let kind = 'image';
        if (VIDEO_EXT.includes(ext)) kind = 'video';
        else if (AUDIO_EXT.includes(ext)) kind = 'audio';
        work.sources.push({ path: src.path, kind });
      } finally { await src.cleanup(); }
    }
    const kinds = [...new Set(work.sources.map((s) => s.kind))];
    const mediaType = kinds.includes('audio') ? 'audio' : kinds.includes('video') ? 'video' : 'image';

    const prompts = visionPrompts();
    const task = args.task || prompts.default_task || 'media_qa';
    let sysText = '';
    let userText;
    if (args.custom_prompt) {
      userText = fillTemplate(String(args.custom_prompt), { question: args.question || '', prompt: args.prompt || '', media_type: mediaType });
    } else {
      const tpl = prompts.prompts[task];
      if (!tpl) throw new ToolError(`tâche prompt inconnue: ${task} (voir media.vision_prompt_list)`);
      sysText = tpl.system || '';
      userText = fillTemplate(tpl.user, { question: args.question || '', prompt: args.prompt || '', media_type: mediaType });
    }

    let order;
    if (args.provider) {
      const f = cfg.providers.find((p) => p.name === args.provider);
      if (!f) throw new ToolError(`provider vision inconnu: ${args.provider}`);
      order = [f];
    } else {
      order = cfg.providers.slice();
      const def = order.find((p) => p.name === cfg.default);
      if (def) order = [def, ...order.filter((p) => p !== def)];
    }
    if (!order.length) throw new ToolError('aucun provider configuré');

    const timeoutMs = Math.min(Math.max(Number(args.timeout_s) || 60, 10), 180) * 1000;
    const tried = [];
    for (const p of order) {
      const vname = 'vision:' + p.name;
      if (!args.provider && !args.no_fallback && providerCircuitOpen(vname)) {
        tried.push({ provider: p.name, skipped: 'circuit_open' });
        continue;
      }
      try {
        const built = await buildVisionParts(p, work, args.frames);
        if (!built.parts.length) throw new Error(`provider '${p.name}' ne peut traiter les médias ${kinds.join(',')}`);
        const messages = [];
        if (sysText) messages.push({ role: 'system', content: sysText });
        messages.push({ role: 'user', content: [{ type: 'text', text: userText }, ...built.parts] });
        const text = await visionChatCall(p, messages, timeoutMs);
        recordProvider(vname, true);
        let parsed = null;
        try {
          const m = text.match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/);
          if (m) parsed = JSON.parse(m[0]);
        } catch (_) {}
        return makeResult('media.vision_check', {
          meta: {
            provider: p.name, model: p.model, task: args.custom_prompt ? 'custom' : task,
            media_type: mediaType, files_sent: built.parts.length, forced: !!args.provider, no_fallback: !!args.no_fallback,
            warnings: built.warnings, tried, analysis: { text, parsed },
          },
        });
      } catch (e) {
        recordProvider(vname, false, errMsg(e));
        tried.push({ provider: p.name, error: errMsg(e) });
        if (args.provider || args.no_fallback) break;
      }
    }
    throw new ToolError(`vision_check: échec provider(s): ${tried.map((t) => t.provider + ': ' + (t.error || t.skipped)).join(' | ')}`, { tried });
  } finally {
    for (const t of tmpDirs) fs.promises.rm(t, { recursive: true, force: true }).catch(() => {});
  }
}

/* ================================================================== *
 *  P1.3 — Job Manager (persistent, threshold-gated async execution)
 *  Policy (.env, never agent-controlled):
 *    MEDIA_JOB_MIN_SECONDS  — below this, auto mode stays synchronous
 *    MEDIA_JOB_MAX_TTL_SECONDS — retention of finished jobs
 *  Per-call control: execution_mode auto|sync|async (bounded by policy)
 * ================================================================== */
const JOBS_FILE = path.join(__dirname, '.mcm-jobs.json');
const JOBS = new Map();
const TYPICAL_S = {
  'media.video_gen': 240, 'media.video_avatar': 300, 'media.video_animate': 240,
  'media.video_replace': 240, 'media.image_try_on': 180, 'media.navy_image_gen': 90,
  'media.tts': 45, 'media.avatar_lipsync': 240, 'media.subtitle_generate': 120,
};

function loadJobs() {
  try {
    const arr = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(JOBS_FILE, 'utf8'));
    for (const j of Array.isArray(arr) ? arr : []) {
      if (j && j.job_id) {
        if (j.status === 'running') { j.status = 'failed'; j.error = 'server restarted during execution'; }
        JOBS.set(j.job_id, j);
      }
    }
  } catch (_) {}
}
function persistJobs() {
  try {
    const arr = [...JOBS.values()].slice(-200);
    const tmp = JOBS_FILE + '.tmp';
    fs.writeFileSync(tmp, JSON.stringify(arr, null, 1));
    fs.renameSync(tmp, JOBS_FILE);
  } catch (e) { log('jobs persist failed: ' + errMsg(e)); }
}
function jobSummary(j) {
  return { job_id: j.job_id, tool: j.tool, status: j.status, created_at: j.created_at, updated_at: j.updated_at, error: j.error || null };
}
function startJob(tool, args, ctx) {
  const jobId = 'job_' + Date.now().toString(36) + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8);
  const job = { job_id: jobId, tool: tool.name, status: 'running', created_at: new Date().toISOString(), updated_at: null, error: null, result: null };
  JOBS.set(jobId, job);
  persistJobs();
  (async () => {
    const t0 = Date.now();
    try {
      const out = await tool.handler(args, ctx);
      if (out && typeof out === 'object') { out.timing = { execution_ms: Date.now() - t0 }; out.job_id = jobId; }
      if (job.status === 'running') job.status = 'completed';
      job.result = out;
    } catch (e) {
      if (job.status === 'running') { job.status = 'failed'; job.error = errMsg(e); }
    }
    job.updated_at = new Date().toISOString();
    persistJobs();
    log(`job ${jobId} (${tool.name}) ${job.status}`);
  })();
  return job;
}
loadJobs();

async function job_status(args) {
  const j = JOBS.get(String(args.job_id || ''));
  if (!j) throw new ToolError(`job introuvable: ${args.job_id}`);
  return makeResult('media.job_status', { meta: jobSummary(j) });
}
async function job_wait(args) {
  const j = JOBS.get(String(args.job_id || ''));
  if (!j) throw new ToolError(`job introuvable: ${args.job_id}`);
  const timeoutS = Math.min(Math.max(Number(args.timeout_s) || 300, 5), 600);
  const deadline = Date.now() + timeoutS * 1000;
  while (j.status === 'running' && Date.now() < deadline) await sleep(500);
  if (j.status === 'running') throw new ToolError(`timeout après ${timeoutS}s — job ${j.job_id} toujours en cours`, { job_id: j.job_id });
  return makeResult('media.job_wait', { meta: jobSummary(j) });
}
async function job_result(args) {
  const j = JOBS.get(String(args.job_id || ''));
  if (!j) throw new ToolError(`job introuvable: ${args.job_id}`);
  if (j.status === 'running') throw new ToolError(`job ${j.job_id} toujours en cours — utiliser media.job_wait`, { job_id: j.job_id });
  if (j.status !== 'completed') throw new ToolError(`job ${j.job_id} non terminé (${j.status}): ${j.error || 'pas de résultat'}`, { job_id: j.job_id });
  return j.result;
}
async function job_cancel(args) {
  const j = JOBS.get(String(args.job_id || ''));
  if (!j) throw new ToolError(`job introuvable: ${args.job_id}`);
  if (j.status !== 'running') return makeResult('media.job_cancel', { meta: Object.assign(jobSummary(j), { note: 'déjà terminé, rien à annuler' }) });
  j.status = 'cancelled'; j.updated_at = new Date().toISOString(); j.error = 'cancelled by client';
  persistJobs();
  return makeResult('media.job_cancel', { meta: jobSummary(j) });
}
async function job_list(args) {
  const limit = Math.min(Math.max(Number(args.limit) || 20, 1), 200);
  const arr = [...JOBS.values()].slice(-limit).map(jobSummary);
  return makeResult('media.job_list', { meta: { count: arr.length, jobs: arr } });
}
async function job_cleanup() {
  const ttlMs = CFG.JOB_TTL_SECONDS * 1000;
  let removed = 0;
  for (const [jid, j] of [...JOBS.entries()]) {
    const ts = new Date(j.updated_at || j.created_at).getTime();
    if (j.status !== 'running' && Date.now() - ts > ttlMs) { JOBS.delete(jid); removed++; }
  }
  persistJobs();
  return makeResult('media.job_cleanup', { meta: { removed, remaining: JOBS.size, ttl_s: CFG.JOB_TTL_SECONDS } });
}

/* ================================================================== *
 *  P2.3 — Technical quality control (ffmpeg local)
 * ================================================================== */
async function media_validate(args) {
  if (!args.source) throw new ToolError('source requis');
  const src = await resolveSource(args.source);
  try {
    const info = await probe(src.path);
    const issues = [];
    if (!info.video_codec && !info.audio_codec) issues.push('aucun flux média détecté');
    if (info.duration_s <= 0) issues.push('durée nulle ou illisible');
    if (info.video_codec && (!info.width || !info.height)) issues.push('résolution illisible');
    let decode_errors = 0;
    try {
      const { err } = await runCmd('ffmpeg', ['-hide_banner', '-v', 'error', '-i', src.path, '-f', 'null', '-']);
      decode_errors = (err.match(/Error|Invalid|corrupt/gi) || []).length;
      if (decode_errors > 0) issues.push(`${decode_errors} erreur(s) au décodage complet`);
    } catch (e) {
      issues.push('échec décodage: ' + errMsg(e).slice(0, 200));
    }
    return makeResult('media.media_validate', {
      meta: { valid: issues.length === 0, issues, duration_s: info.duration_s, video_codec: info.video_codec, audio_codec: info.audio_codec, width: info.width, height: info.height, decode_errors },
    });
  } finally { await src.cleanup(); }
}

async function quality_report(args, ctx) {
  if (!args.source) throw new ToolError('source requis');
  const src = await resolveSource(args.source);
  try {
    const info = await probe(src.path);
    const blackD = Math.max(0.05, Number(args.black_min_s) || 0.3);
    const freezeD = Math.max(0.5, Number(args.freeze_min_s) || 2);
    const vf = `blackdetect=d=${blackD}:pix_th=0.05,freezedetect=n=-40dB:d=${freezeD}`;
    const ffArgs = ['-hide_banner', '-i', src.path, '-vf', vf];
    if (info.has_audio) ffArgs.push('-af', 'silencedetect=n=-35dB:d=0.8,volumedetect');
    ffArgs.push('-f', 'null', '-');
    const { out, err } = await runCmd('ffmpeg', ffArgs);
    const text = out + err;
    const blacks = [];
    let m;
    const reB = /black_start:([0-9.]+)\s+black_end:([0-9.]+)/g;
    while ((m = reB.exec(text)) !== null) blacks.push({ start: parseFloat(m[1]), end: parseFloat(m[2]) });
    const freezes = [];
    const starts = [...text.matchAll(/freeze_start:([0-9.]+)/g)].map((x) => parseFloat(x[1]));
    const durs = [...text.matchAll(/freeze_duration:([0-9.]+)/g)].map((x) => parseFloat(x[1]));
    for (let i = 0; i < starts.length; i++) freezes.push({ start: starts[i], duration: durs[i] || 0 });
    const silences = [];
    const reS = /silence_start:\s*([0-9.]+)/g;
    while ((m = reS.exec(text)) !== null) silences.push({ start: parseFloat(m[1]) });
    const g = (re) => { const x = re.exec(text); return x ? parseFloat(x[1]) : null; };
    const meanDb = g(/mean_volume:\s*(-?[0-9.]+)/);
    const maxDb = g(/max_volume:\s*(-?[0-9.]+)/);
    const warnings = [];
    if (blacks.length) warnings.push(`${blacks.length} passage(s) noir(s)`);
    if (freezes.length) warnings.push(`${freezes.length} gel(s) d'image`);
    if (maxDb !== null && maxDb >= -0.05) warnings.push('clipping audio probable (max_volume \u2248 0 dB)');
    return makeResult('media.quality_report', {
      meta: {
        api: 'local', duration_s: info.duration_s, has_audio: info.has_audio,
        black_frames: blacks, freezes, silences,
        mean_volume_db: meanDb, max_volume_db: maxDb,
        acceptable: warnings.length === 0, warnings,
      },
    });
  } finally { await src.cleanup(); }
}

/* ================================================================== *
 *  P2.3b — Multi-format batch export (16:9 / 1:1 / 9:16 + manifest)
 * ================================================================== */
async function batch_export(args, ctx) {
  if (!args.source) throw new ToolError('source requis');
  const ratios = Array.isArray(args.ratios) && args.ratios.length ? args.ratios.slice(0, 3) : ['16:9', '1:1', '9:16'];
  const heights = Array.isArray(args.heights) && args.heights.length ? args.heights.slice(0, 2).map((h) => clampNum(h, 720, 64, 4320)) : [1080, 720];
  const mode = ['crop', 'blur', 'pad'].includes(args.mode) ? args.mode : 'crop';
  const src = await resolveSource(args.source);
  try {
    const dir = path.join(ctx.saveDir, `batch_${Date.now()}`);
    await ensureDir(dir);
    const stem = path.basename(src.path).replace(/\.[^.]+$/, '');
    const outputs = [];
    const errors = [];
    for (const ratio of ratios) {
      const [rw, rh] = String(ratio).split(':').map((x) => clampNum(x, 9, 1, 100));
      for (const H of heights) {
        const W = Math.round((H * rw) / rh / 2) * 2;
        const HH = Math.round(H / 2) * 2;
        let vf;
        if (mode === 'crop') vf = `scale=${W}:${HH}:force_original_aspect_ratio=increase,crop=${W}:${HH}`;
        else if (mode === 'pad') vf = `scale=${W}:${HH}:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease,pad=${W}:${HH}:(ow-iw)/2:(oh-ih)/2:black`;
        else vf = `split[a][b];[a]scale=${W}:${HH}:force_original_aspect_ratio=increase,boxblur=luma_radius=min(h\\,w)/40:luma_power=1[bgb];[b]scale=${W}:${HH}:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease[fg];[bgb][fg]overlay=(W-w)/2:(H-h)/2`;
        const outPath = path.join(dir, `${stem}_${String(ratio).replace(':', 'x')}_${HH}p.mp4`);
        try {
          await runCmd('ffmpeg', ['-y', '-hide_banner', '-loglevel', 'error', '-i', src.path, '-vf', vf, '-c:v', 'libx264', '-preset', 'medium', '-crf', String(clampNum(args.crf, 20, 0, 51)), '-c:a', 'aac', '-movflags', '+faststart', outPath]);
          outputs.push({ ratio, height: HH, width: W, file: outPath, bytes: fs.statSync(outPath).size });
        } catch (e) {
          errors.push({ ratio, height: HH, error: errMsg(e).slice(0, 200) });
        }
      }
    }
    if (!outputs.length) throw new ToolError(`batch_export: aucun export produit (${errors.map((e) => e.error).join(' | ')})`);
    const manifest = {
      source: src.path, mode, generated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      outputs: outputs.map((o) => ({ ratio: o.ratio, height: o.height, width: o.width, file: o.file, bytes: o.bytes })),
      errors,
    };
    const manifestPath = path.join(dir, 'manifest.json');
    fs.writeFileSync(manifestPath, JSON.stringify(manifest, null, 2));
    const out = makeResult('media.batch_export', {
      local_path: outputs[0].file,
      meta: { api: 'local', mode, count: outputs.length, outputs, errors, manifest: manifestPath },
    });
    if (ctx.upload) out.url = (await uploadChain(outputs[0].file, '24h')).url;
    return out;
  } finally { await src.cleanup(); }
}

/* ================================================================== *
 *  P2.2 — Typed recipe engine (sequential DAG with named steps)
 * ================================================================== */
async function runRecipe(name, steps, ctx) {
  const results = {};
  const errors = [];
  for (const s of steps) {
    const t0 = Date.now();
    try {
      results[s.name] = await s.run(results);
      log(`recipe ${name}: step ${s.name} ok (${Date.now() - t0} ms)`);
    } catch (e) {
      errors.push({ step: s.name, error: errMsg(e) });
      log(`recipe ${name}: step ${s.name} FAILED: ${errMsg(e)}`);
      if (s.required) throw new ToolError(`recipe ${name}: étape requise '${s.name}' a échoué: ${errMsg(e)}`);
    }
  }
  return { results, errors };
}

async function recipe_review_pack(args, ctx) {
  if (!args.source) throw new ToolError('source requis');
  const src = await resolveSource(args.source);
  const dir = path.join(ctx.saveDir, `review_${Date.now()}`);
  await ensureDir(dir);
  const stepCtx = { saveDir: dir, upload: false, timeoutS: 240 };
  try {
    const steps = [
      { name: 'probe', required: true, run: async () => probe(src.path) },
      { name: 'validate', required: false, run: async () => media_validate({ source: src.path }) },
      { name: 'contact_sheet', required: false, run: async () => video_contact_sheet({ source: src.path, save_dir: dir }, stepCtx) },
      { name: 'scenes', required: false, run: async () => video_scene_detect({ source: src.path }, stepCtx) },
      {
        name: 'audio_report', required: false,
        run: async (r) => (r.probe && r.probe.has_audio ? video_audio_report({ source: src.path }, stepCtx) : { skipped: 'no audio track' }),
      },
      {
        name: 'waveform', required: false,
        run: async (r) => (r.probe && r.probe.has_audio ? video_waveform({ source: src.path, save_dir: dir }, stepCtx) : { skipped: 'no audio track' }),
      },
      {
        name: 'quality', required: false,
        run: async () => quality_report({ source: src.path }, stepCtx),
      },
    ];
    const { results, errors } = await runRecipe('review_pack', steps, stepCtx);
    const manifest = {
      recipe: 'media.recipe_review_pack',
      source: src.path,
      generated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      info: results.probe || null,
      validate: results.validate ? results.validate.meta : null,
      contact_sheet: results.contact_sheet && results.contact_sheet.local_path ? results.contact_sheet.local_path : null,
      scenes: results.scenes ? results.scenes.meta.scenes : null,
      audio_report: results.audio_report && results.audio_report.meta ? results.audio_report.meta : results.audio_report || null,
      waveform: results.waveform && results.waveform.local_path ? results.waveform.local_path : null,
      quality: results.quality ? results.quality.meta : null,
      errors,
    };
    const manifestPath = path.join(dir, 'review_manifest.json');
    fs.writeFileSync(manifestPath, JSON.stringify(manifest, null, 2));
    return makeResult('media.recipe_review_pack', {
      local_path: manifestPath,
      meta: { api: 'local', dir, steps_ok: Object.keys(results), errors },
    });
  } finally { await src.cleanup(); }
}

/* ================================================================== *
 *  Control tools (P1.6–P1.8): doctor, preflight, estimate
 * ================================================================== */
async function doctor() {
  const checks = {};
  checks.node = { ok: true, version: process.version };
  try {
    const { out } = await runCmd('ffmpeg', ['-version']);
    const m = out.match(/ffmpeg version ([^\s]+)/);
    checks.ffmpeg = { ok: true, version: m ? m[1] : 'unknown' };
  } catch (_) { checks.ffmpeg = { ok: false }; }
  try {
    const { out } = await runCmd('ffprobe', ['-version']);
    checks.ffprobe = { ok: true, version: (out.match(/ffprobe version ([^\s]+)/) || [])[1] || 'unknown' };
  } catch (_) { checks.ffprobe = { ok: false }; }
  try {
    const { out } = await runCmd('tesseract', ['--version']);
    checks.tesseract = { ok: true, version: (out.match(/tesseract ([^\s]+)/) || [])[1] || 'unknown' };
  } catch (_) { checks.tesseract = { ok: false }; }
  const filters = ['vidstabtransform', 'subtitles', 'drawtext', 'chromakey', 'loudnorm', 'xfade'];
  checks.filters = {};
  for (const f of filters) {
    try {
      const { out } = await runCmd('ffmpeg', ['-hide_banner', '-filters']);
      checks.filters[f] = out.includes(f);
    } catch (_) { checks.filters[f] = false; }
  }
  checks.providers = {
    pruna: !!CFG.PRUNA_KEY,
    navy: !!CFG.NAVY_KEY,
    imgtools: !!CFG.IMGTOOLS_KEY,
    tts: !!CFG.TTS_KEY,
  };
  try {
    const st = fs.statfsSync(CFG.DEFAULT_DIR);
    checks.disk = { ok: true, free_gb: Math.round(st.bavail * st.bsize / 1e9 * 10) / 10 };
  } catch (_) {
    try {
      fs.mkdirSync(CFG.DEFAULT_DIR, { recursive: true });
      const st = fs.statfsSync(CFG.DEFAULT_DIR);
      checks.disk = { ok: true, free_gb: Math.round(st.bavail * st.bsize / 1e9 * 10) / 10 };
    } catch (e) { checks.disk = { ok: false, error: errMsg(e) }; }
  }
  const allOk = checks.ffmpeg.ok && checks.ffprobe.ok;
  return makeResult('media.doctor', { meta: { healthy: allOk, checks } });
}

async function preflight(args) {
  if (!args.source) throw new ToolError('source requis');
  const src = await resolveSource(args.source);
  try {
    const info = await probe(src.path);
    const st = fs.statSync(src.path);
    const warnings = [];
    if (info.duration_s > 7200) warnings.push('duration exceeds 2h limit');
    if (info.width * info.height > 33177600) warnings.push('resolution exceeds 8K');
    if (!info.has_audio && args.needs_audio) warnings.push('no audio track');
    return makeResult('media.preflight', {
      meta: {
        source: src.path,
        bytes: st.size,
        duration_s: info.duration_s,
        width: info.width,
        height: info.height,
        fps: info.fps,
        has_audio: info.has_audio,
        video_codec: info.video_codec,
        audio_codec: info.audio_codec || null,
        compatible: warnings.length === 0,
        warnings,
      },
    });
  } finally { await src.cleanup(); }
}

async function estimate(args) {
  if (!args.tool) throw new ToolError('tool requis (ex: media.video_gen)');
  const tool = TOOLS.find((t) => t.name === args.tool || t.name === 'media.' + args.tool);
  if (!tool) throw new ToolError(`outil inconnu: ${args.tool}`);
  const est = {
    tool: tool.name,
    category: tool.category,
    execution: tool.execution,
    risk_level: tool.risk_level,
    dependencies: tool.dependencies,
    requires_network: tool.dependencies.includes('network'),
    requires_ffmpeg: tool.dependencies.includes('ffmpeg'),
    estimated_duration: tool.execution === 'async' ? '30-300s (provider polling)' : '1-60s (local)',
    cost: tool.category.startsWith('gen') ? 'quota-based (free tier or wallet)' : 'free (local)',
  };
  if (args.source && fs.existsSync(String(args.source))) {
    try {
      const st = fs.statSync(String(args.source));
      est.source_bytes = st.size;
      est.output_estimate = Math.round(st.size * (tool.name.includes('upscale') ? 4 : tool.name.includes('gif') ? 0.3 : 0.8));
    } catch (_) {}
  }
  return makeResult('media.estimate', { meta: est });
}

/* ================================================================== *
 *  Artifact management tools (P1.2)
 * ================================================================== */
async function artifact_list(args) {
  const idx = readArtifactIndex();
  const limit = Math.min(Math.max(Number(args.limit) || 50, 1), 500);
  return makeResult('media.artifact_list', { meta: { count: idx.length, artifacts: idx.slice(-limit) } });
}

async function artifact_info(args) {
  if (!args.artifact_id && !args.local_path) throw new ToolError('artifact_id ou local_path requis');
  const idx = readArtifactIndex();
  const entry = idx.find((e) => (args.artifact_id && e.artifact_id === args.artifact_id) || (args.local_path && e.local_path === path.resolve(args.local_path)));
  if (!entry) throw new ToolError('artefact introuvable dans l\'index');
  const exists = fs.existsSync(entry.local_path);
  let verified = false;
  if (exists && entry.sha256) {
    try {
      const st = fs.statSync(entry.local_path);
      if (st.size <= 64 * 1024 * 1024) {
        verified = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(fs.readFileSync(entry.local_path)).digest('hex') === entry.sha256;
      }
    } catch (_) {}
  }
  return makeResult('media.artifact_info', { meta: { artifact: entry, exists, sha256_verified: verified } });
}

async function artifact_cleanup() {
  const idx = readArtifactIndex();
  const kept = idx.filter((e) => fs.existsSync(e.local_path));
  writeArtifactIndex(kept);
  return makeResult('media.artifact_cleanup', { meta: { before: idx.length, after: kept.length, removed: idx.length - kept.length } });
}

/* ================================================================== *
 *  Tool registry — single source of truth: tool-registry.json
 *  Metadata (title/category/risk/annotations/outputSchema) lives in
 *  the JSON file; handler implementations live in this file.
 * ================================================================== */
const TOOL_REGISTRY = JSON.parse(
  fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname, 'tool-registry.json'), 'utf8')
);

const HANDLERS = {
  job_status,
  job_wait,
  job_result,
  job_cancel,
  job_list,
  job_cleanup,
  doctor,
  preflight,
  estimate,
  media_validate,
  quality_report,
  batch_export,
  recipe_review_pack,
  image_best,
  video_best,
  tts_best,
  provider_status,
  vision_provider_add,
  vision_provider_remove,
  vision_provider_list,
  vision_default_set,
  vision_check,
  vision_prompt_list,
  vision_prompt_set,
  vision_prompt_remove,
  vision_guide,
  artifact_list,
  artifact_info,
  artifact_cleanup,
  image_gen,
  image_gen_ideogram,
  image_edit,
  image_upscale,
  image_try_on,
  video_gen,
  video_avatar,
  video_animate,
  video_replace,
  pruna_status,
  navy_models,
  navy_image_gen,
  image_bg_remove,
  image_object_remove,
  image_upscale_imgs,
  image_enhance,
  tts,
  avatar_lipsync,
  stt,
  extract_audio,
  extract_frames,
  video_info,
  upload_file,
  video_trim,
  video_concat,
  video_transitions,
  video_transcode,
  video_aspect,
  video_split,
  video_speed,
  video_reverse,
  video_fade,
  video_crop,
  video_rotate,
  video_stabilize,
  video_chromakey,
  video_colorgrade,
  video_zoompan,
  video_title,
  video_watermark,
  video_pip,
  audio_mix,
  audio_normalize,
  audio_denoise,
  audio_remove_silence,
  audio_convert,
  audio_tempo,
  audio_pitch,
  video_mux_audio,
  subtitle_generate,
  subtitle_burn,
  video_contact_sheet,
  video_scene_detect,
  video_audio_report,
  video_gif,
  video_waveform,
  video_ocr,
};

const TOOLS = TOOL_REGISTRY.map((r) => {
  const handler = HANDLERS[r.handler];
  if (!handler) { log('registry: missing handler for ' + r.name); return null; }
  return {
    name: r.name,
    title: r.title,
    description: r.description,
    category: r.category,
    version: r.version,
    risk_level: r.risk_level,
    dependencies: r.dependencies,
    inputSchema: r.inputSchema,
    outputSchema: r.outputSchema,
    annotations: r.annotations,
    execution: r.execution,
    handler,
  };
}).filter(Boolean);
/* ================================================================== *
 *  P1.4 — Lightweight JSON Schema validation (zero-dep)
 * ================================================================== */
function validateArgs(schema, args) {
  if (!schema || !schema.properties) return null;
  const errors = [];
  const props = schema.properties;
  if (Array.isArray(schema.required)) {
    for (const r of schema.required) {
      if (args[r] === undefined || args[r] === null) errors.push(`missing required parameter: ${r}`);
    }
  }
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(args)) {
    const spec = props[k];
    if (!spec) {
      if (schema.additionalProperties === false) errors.push(`unknown parameter: ${k}`);
      continue;
    }
    if (v === undefined || v === null) continue;
    if (spec.type) {
      const types = Array.isArray(spec.type) ? spec.type : [spec.type];
      const actual = Array.isArray(v) ? 'array' : typeof v === 'number' && Number.isInteger(v) ? 'integer' : typeof v;
      if (!types.some((t) => t === actual || (t === 'number' && actual === 'integer'))) {
        errors.push(`${k}: expected ${types.join('|')}, got ${actual}`);
        continue;
      }
    }
    if (spec.enum && !spec.enum.includes(v)) errors.push(`${k}: must be one of [${spec.enum.join(', ')}]`);
    if (typeof v === 'string' && spec.minLength && v.length < spec.minLength) errors.push(`${k}: too short (min ${spec.minLength})`);
    if (typeof v === 'number') {
      if (spec.minimum !== undefined && v < spec.minimum) errors.push(`${k}: below minimum (${spec.minimum})`);
      if (spec.maximum !== undefined && v > spec.maximum) errors.push(`${k}: above maximum (${spec.maximum})`);
    }
    if (Array.isArray(v) && spec.minItems && v.length < spec.minItems) errors.push(`${k}: needs at least ${spec.minItems} items`);
  }
  return errors.length ? errors.join('; ') : null;
}

/* ================================================================== *
 *  MCP protocol loop (JSON-RPC 2.0 over stdio)
 * ================================================================== */
function send(obj) {
  process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify(obj) + '\n');
}

function sendError(id, code, message, data) {
  const err = { code, message };
  if (data !== undefined) err.data = data;
  send({ jsonrpc: '2.0', id: id === undefined ? null : id, error: err });
}

async function handleMessage(line) {
  let msg;
  try {
    msg = JSON.parse(line);
  } catch (_) {
    sendError(null, -32700, 'Parse error');
    return;
  }
  if (!msg || typeof msg !== 'object' || typeof msg.method !== 'string') {
    sendError(msg && msg.id !== undefined ? msg.id : null, -32700, 'Parse error');
    return;
  }
  const id = msg.id !== undefined ? msg.id : null;
  const isNotification = id === null;

  switch (msg.method) {
    case 'initialize': {
      const SUPPORTED = ['2025-06-18', '2025-11-25', '2026-07-28'];
      const requested = (msg.params && msg.params.protocolVersion) || '2025-06-18';
      const negotiated = SUPPORTED.includes(requested) ? requested : SUPPORTED[0];
      send({
        jsonrpc: '2.0',
        id,
        result: {
          protocolVersion: negotiated,
          capabilities: { tools: { listChanged: false } },
          serverInfo: { name: 'mcp-media', version: CFG.VERSION },
        },
      });
      break;
    }
    case 'notifications/initialized':
      break; // no response expected
    case 'ping':
      send({ jsonrpc: '2.0', id, result: {} });
      break;
    case 'tools/list':
      send({
        jsonrpc: '2.0',
        id,
        result: {
          tools: TOOLS.map((t) => ({
            name: t.name,
            title: t.title,
            description: t.description,
            inputSchema: t.inputSchema,
            // outputSchema intentionally omitted: opencode (and other strict
            // MCP clients) require structured content when an outputSchema is
            // declared, but this server always returns plain-text content.
            annotations: t.annotations,
          })),
        },
      });
      break;
    case 'tools/call': {
      const name = msg.params && msg.params.name;
      const args = (msg.params && msg.params.arguments) || {};
      const tool = TOOLS.find((t) => t.name === name);
      if (!tool) {
        sendError(id, -32602, `Unknown tool: ${name}`);
        break;
      }
      const execMode = ['sync', 'async', 'auto'].includes(args.execution_mode) ? args.execution_mode : 'auto';
      const cleanArgs = Object.assign({}, args);
      delete cleanArgs.execution_mode;
      const validationError = validateArgs(tool.inputSchema, cleanArgs);
      if (validationError) {
        send({ jsonrpc: '2.0', id, result: { isError: true, content: [{ type: 'text', text: JSON.stringify({ ok: false, tool: name, error: 'validation', message: validationError }) }] } });
        break;
      }
      const isAsyncTool = tool.execution === 'async';
      const typicalS = TYPICAL_S[name] !== undefined ? TYPICAL_S[name] : (isAsyncTool ? 120 : 5);
      const wantJob = execMode === 'async' || (execMode === 'auto' && isAsyncTool && typicalS >= CFG.JOB_MIN_SECONDS);
      if (wantJob && name !== 'media.job_wait') {
        const job = startJob(tool, cleanArgs, ctxOf(cleanArgs));
        send({ jsonrpc: '2.0', id, result: { content: [{ type: 'text', text: JSON.stringify({ ok: true, status: 'queued', tool: name, job_id: job.job_id, local_path: null, url: null, meta: { execution_mode: execMode, typical_s: typicalS, job_min_s: CFG.JOB_MIN_SECONDS, next: 'media.job_wait ou media.job_result avec ce job_id' } }) }] } });
        break;
      }
      try {
        const t0 = Date.now();
        const out = await tool.handler(cleanArgs, ctxOf(cleanArgs));
        if (out && typeof out === 'object') {
          out.timing = { execution_ms: Date.now() - t0 };
        }
        send({ jsonrpc: '2.0', id, result: { content: [{ type: 'text', text: JSON.stringify(out) }] } });
      } catch (e) {
        if (e instanceof TimeoutError) {
          send({ jsonrpc: '2.0', id, result: { isError: true, content: [{ type: 'text', text: JSON.stringify({ ok: false, tool: name, error: 'timeout', message: e.message, job_id: e.jobId }) }] } });
        } else if (e instanceof ToolError) {
          send({ jsonrpc: '2.0', id, result: { isError: true, content: [{ type: 'text', text: JSON.stringify({ ok: false, tool: name, error: 'tool', message: e.message, ...e.meta }) }] } });
        } else {
          log('tool error: ' + errMsg(e));
          send({ jsonrpc: '2.0', id, result: { isError: true, content: [{ type: 'text', text: JSON.stringify({ ok: false, tool: name, error: 'internal', message: errMsg(e) }) }] } });
        }
      }
      break;
    }
    default:
      if (!isNotification) sendError(id, -32601, 'Method not found');
      break;
  }
}

const rl = readline.createInterface({ input: process.stdin, terminal: false });
rl.on('line', (line) => {
  if (!line.trim()) return;
  handleMessage(line).catch((e) => log('fatal: ' + errMsg(e))); // never exit on an error
});
rl.on('close', () => process.exit(0));

// Client disconnected (broken pipe): exit quietly instead of crashing on stdout writes.
process.stdout.on('error', (e) => {
  if (e && e.code === 'EPIPE') process.exit(0);
  log('stdout error: ' + errMsg(e));
});

log(`mcp-media v${CFG.VERSION} ready — ${TOOLS.length} tools`);

```

### 📄 `data/infra_snapshots/objects/ba/8b36c7d860d6ef37887b6ef496a486e91aefe5229f65157cc8b44725b9bec5`

```text
# cookie

[![NPM Version][npm-version-image]][npm-url]
[![NPM Downloads][npm-downloads-image]][npm-url]
[![Node.js Version][node-image]][node-url]
[![Build Status][ci-image]][ci-url]
[![Coverage Status][coveralls-image]][coveralls-url]

Basic HTTP cookie parser and serializer for HTTP servers.

## Installation

This is a [Node.js](https://nodejs.org/en/) module available through the
[npm registry](https://www.npmjs.com/). Installation is done using the
[`npm install` command](https://docs.npmjs.com/getting-started/installing-npm-packages-locally):

```sh
$ npm install cookie
```

## API

```js
var cookie = require('cookie');
```

### cookie.parse(str, options)

Parse an HTTP `Cookie` header string and returning an object of all cookie name-value pairs.
The `str` argument is the string representing a `Cookie` header value and `options` is an
optional object containing additional parsing options.

```js
var cookies = cookie.parse('foo=bar; equation=E%3Dmc%5E2');
// { foo: 'bar', equation: 'E=mc^2' }
```

#### Options

`cookie.parse` accepts these properties in the options object.

##### decode

Specifies a function that will be used to decode a cookie's value. Since the value of a cookie
has a limited character set (and must be a simple string), this function can be used to decode
a previously-encoded cookie value into a JavaScript string or other object.

The default function is the global `decodeURIComponent`, which will decode any URL-encoded
sequences into their byte representations.

**note** if an error is thrown from this function, the original, non-decoded cookie value will
be returned as the cookie's value.

### cookie.serialize(name, value, options)

Serialize a cookie name-value pair into a `Set-Cookie` header string. The `name` argument is the
name for the cookie, the `value` argument is the value to set the cookie to, and the `options`
argument is an optional object containing additional serialization options.

```js
var setCookie = cookie.serialize('foo', 'bar');
// foo=bar
```

#### Options

`cookie.serialize` accepts these properties in the options object.

##### domain

Specifies the value for the [`Domain` `Set-Cookie` attribute][rfc-6265-5.2.3]. By default, no
domain is set, and most clients will consider the cookie to apply to only the current domain.

##### encode

Specifies a function that will be used to encode a cookie's value. Since value of a cookie
has a limited character set (and must be a simple string), this function can be used to encode
a value into a string suited for a cookie's value.

The default function is the global `encodeURIComponent`, which will encode a JavaScript string
into UTF-8 byte sequences and then URL-encode any that fall outside of the cookie range.

##### expires

Specifies the `Date` object to be the value for the [`Expires` `Set-Cookie` attribute][rfc-6265-5.2.1].
By default, no expiration is set, and most clients will consider this a "non-persistent cookie" and
will delete it on a condition like exiting a web browser application.

**note** the [cookie storage model specification][rfc-6265-5.3] states that if both `expires` and
`maxAge` are set, then `maxAge` takes precedence, but it is possible not all clients by obey this,
so if both are set, they should point to the same date and time.

##### httpOnly

Specifies the `boolean` value for the [`HttpOnly` `Set-Cookie` attribute][rfc-6265-5.2.6]. When truthy,
the `HttpOnly` attribute is set, otherwise it is not. By default, the `HttpOnly` attribute is not set.

**note** be careful when setting this to `true`, as compliant clients will not allow client-side
JavaScript to see the cookie in `document.cookie`.

##### maxAge

Specifies the `number` (in seconds) to be the value for the [`Max-Age` `Set-Cookie` attribute][rfc-6265-5.2.2].
The given number will be converted to an integer by rounding down. By default, no maximum age is set.

**note** the [cookie storage model specification][rfc-6265-5.3] states that if both `expires` and
`maxAge` are set, then `maxAge` takes precedence, but it is possible not all clients by obey this,
so if both are set, they should point to the same date and time.

##### partitioned

Specifies the `boolean` value for the [`Partitioned` `Set-Cookie`](rfc-cutler-httpbis-partitioned-cookies)
attribute. When truthy, the `Partitioned` attribute is set, otherwise it is not. By default, the
`Partitioned` attribute is not set.

**note** This is an attribute that has not yet been fully standardized, and may change in the future.
This also means many clients may ignore this attribute until they understand it.

More information about can be found in [the proposal](https://github.com/privacycg/CHIPS).

##### path

Specifies the value for the [`Path` `Set-Cookie` attribute][rfc-6265-5.2.4]. By default, the path
is considered the ["default path"][rfc-6265-5.1.4].

##### priority

Specifies the `string` to be the value for the [`Priority` `Set-Cookie` attribute][rfc-west-cookie-priority-00-4.1].

  - `'low'` will set the `Priority` attribute to `Low`.
  - `'medium'` will set the `Priority` attribute to `Medium`, the default priority when not set.
  - `'high'` will set the `Priority` attribute to `High`.

More information about the different priority levels can be found in
[the specification][rfc-west-cookie-priority-00-4.1].

**note** This is an attribute that has not yet been fully standardized, and may change in the future.
This also means many clients may ignore this attribute until they understand it.

##### sameSite

Specifies the `boolean` or `string` to be the value for the [`SameSite` `Set-Cookie` attribute][rfc-6265bis-09-5.4.7].

  - `true` will set the `SameSite` attribute to `Strict` for strict same site enforcement.
  - `false` will not set the `SameSite` attribute.
  - `'lax'` will set the `SameSite` attribute to `Lax` for lax same site enforcement.
  - `'none'` will set the `SameSite` attribute to `None` for an explicit cross-site cookie.
  - `'strict'` will set the `SameSite` attribute to `Strict` for strict same site enforcement.

More information about the different enforcement levels can be found in
[the specification][rfc-6265bis-09-5.4.7].

**note** This is an attribute that has not yet been fully standardized, and may change in the future.
This also means many clients may ignore this attribute until they understand it.

##### secure

Specifies the `boolean` value for the [`Secure` `Set-Cookie` attribute][rfc-6265-5.2.5]. When truthy,
the `Secure` attribute is set, otherwise it is not. By default, the `Secure` attribute is not set.

**note** be careful when setting this to `true`, as compliant clients will not send the cookie back to
the server in the future if the browser does not have an HTTPS connection.

## Example

The following example uses this module in conjunction with the Node.js core HTTP server
to prompt a user for their name and display it back on future visits.

```js
var cookie = require('cookie');
var escapeHtml = require('escape-html');
var http = require('http');
var url = require('url');

function onRequest(req, res) {
  // Parse the query string
  var query = url.parse(req.url, true, true).query;

  if (query && query.name) {
    // Set a new cookie with the name
    res.setHeader('Set-Cookie', cookie.serialize('name', String(query.name), {
      httpOnly: true,
      maxAge: 60 * 60 * 24 * 7 // 1 week
    }));

    // Redirect back after setting cookie
    res.statusCode = 302;
    res.setHeader('Location', req.headers.referer || '/');
    res.end();
    return;
  }

  // Parse the cookies on the request
  var cookies = cookie.parse(req.headers.cookie || '');

  // Get the visitor name set in the cookie
  var name = cookies.name;

  res.setHeader('Content-Type', 'text/html; charset=UTF-8');

  if (name) {
    res.write('<p>Welcome back, <b>' + escapeHtml(name) + '</b>!</p>');
  } else {
    res.write('<p>Hello, new visitor!</p>');
  }

  res.write('<form method="GET">');
  res.write('<input placeholder="enter your name" name="name"> <input type="submit" value="Set Name">');
  res.end('</form>');
}

http.createServer(onRequest).listen(3000);
```

/**

/**

    if (chunk.length === 0) {

    }

    if (this.buffer) {

    }

    // the processing of the incoming data
    if (this.checkBOM) {

        case 1:

            return

        case 2:

          ) {

        case 3:

    // If the line contains a U+003A COLON character (:)
    if (colonPosition !== -1) {
      // Collect the characters on the line before the first U+003A COLON
      // character (:), and let field be that string.
      // TODO: Investigate if there is a more performant way to extract the
      // field
      // see: https://github.com/nodejs/undici/issues/2630
      field = line.subarray(0, colonPosition).toString('utf8')

      // Collect the characters on the line after the first U+003A COLON
      // character (:), and let value be that string.
      // If value starts with a U+0020 SPACE character, remove it from value.
      let valueStart = colonPosition + 1
      if (line[valueStart] === SPACE) {
        ++valueStart
      }
      // TODO: Investigate if there is a more performant way to extract the
      // value
      // see: https://github.com/nodejs/undici/issues/2630
      value = line.subarray(valueStart).toString('utf8')

      // Otherwise, the string is not empty but does not contain a U+003A COLON
      // character (:)
    } else {
      // Process the field using the steps described below, using the whole
      // line as the field name, and the empty string as the field value.
      field = line.toString('utf8')
      value = ''
    }

    // Modify the event with the field name and value. The value is also
    // decoded as UTF-8
    switch (field) {
      case 'data':
        if (event[field] === undefined) {
          event[field] = value
        } else {
          event[field] += `\n${value}`
        }
        break
      case 'retry':
        if (isASCIINumber(value)) {
          event[field] = value
        }
        break
      case 'id':
        if (isValidLastEventId(value)) {
          event[field] = value
        }
        break
      case 'event':
        if (value.length > 0) {
          event[field] = value
        }
        break
    }
  }

  /**
   * @param {EventSourceStreamEvent} event
   */
  processEvent (event) {
    if (event.retry && isASCIINumber(event.retry)) {
      this.state.reconnectionTime = parseInt(event.retry, 10)
    }

    if (event.id && isValidLastEventId(event.id)) {
      this.state.lastEventId = event.id
    }

    // only dispatch event, when data is provided
    if (event.data !== undefined) {
      this.push({
        type: event.event || 'message',
        options: {
          data: event.data,
          lastEventId: this.state.lastEventId,
          origin: this.state.origin
        }
      })
    }
  }

  clearEvent () {
    this.event = {
      data: undefined,
      event: undefined,
      id: undefined,
      retry: undefined
    }
  }
}

module.exports = {
  EventSourceStream
}
