### 📄 `data/infra_snapshots/objects/de/a4d0753839d953a1428d1bc6c585beb25f8f5d3d6784b4838abf59dfd26463`

```text
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Hermes Agent — Update CONTRÔLÉ (remplace l'auto-update.sh cassé)
#
# Pourquoi : l'ancien cron faisait `compose pull hermes` sur une image
# custom locale → "pull access denied" → figé 9 jours sans le savoir.
#
# Ce script fait un update SÛR et RÉVERSIBLE :
#   1. Backup du volume hermes-data (config, sessions, skills, mémoire)
#   2. Pull de la version de base CIBLE (tag daté, pas latest)
#   3. Rebuild de l'image custom
#   4. Restart + health check
#   5. Rollback auto si le health check échoue
#
# Usage :
#   ./update.sh                 # update vers HERMES_VERSION du .env
#   ./update.sh v2026.6.19      # update vers une version précise
#   ./update.sh --backup-only   # juste un backup, sans toucher au reste
#   ./update.sh --rollback      # restaure le dernier backup
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
set -euo pipefail

STACK_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
cd "$STACK_DIR"

BACKUP_DIR="${STACK_DIR}/backups"
mkdir -p "$BACKUP_DIR"
TS="$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)"

log() { echo -e "\033[1;36m[update]\033[0m $*"; }
err() { echo -e "\033[1;31m[update:ERROR]\033[0m $*" >&2; }

# ── Backup du volume hermes-data (tar.gz via conteneur jetable) ──
backup_data() {
  local out="${BACKUP_DIR}/hermes-data-${TS}.tar.gz"
  log "Backup volume hermes-data → ${out}"
  docker run --rm \
    -v hermes-data:/data:ro \
    -v "${BACKUP_DIR}:/backup" \
    alpine:3.20 \
    tar czf "/backup/hermes-data-${TS}.tar.gz" -C /data . 
  # Sauvegarde aussi la config.yaml en clair (lecture rapide / diff)
  docker cp hermes-agent:/opt/data/config.yaml "${BACKUP_DIR}/config-${TS}.yaml" 2>/dev/null || true
  log "Backup OK ($(du -h "$out" | cut -f1))"
  echo "$out"
}

# ── Health check : gateway répond + api_server (OSINT) joignable ──
# Test PRIMAIRE : 8642/v1/models avec Bearer API_SERVER_KEY (endpoint réel de
#   l'app PMU, démarré seulement si la gateway tourne — le plus représentatif).
# Test SECONDAIRE (info only) : 9119/api/status (dashboard) — échoue sans auth
#   en 0.18, c'est OK, juste loggué pour diagnostic.
# ⚠️ Ne PAS baser le verdict sur 9119 SANS creds : le hardening 0.18 fait que le
#    dashboard non-auth 0.0.0.0 démarre plus — sinon faux rollback (cas v2026.7.1
#    du 2026-07-05 résolu par cette correction).
# Charge .env pour récupérer API_SERVER_KEY (passthrough docker-compose).
[ -f .env ] && set -a && . ./.env && set +a 2>/dev/null || true
health_check() {
  log "Health check (40s max)…"
  local key="${API_SERVER_KEY:-}"
  local dash_user="${HERMES_DASHBOARD_BASIC_AUTH_USERNAME:-}"
  local dash_pass="${HERMES_DASHBOARD_BASIC_AUTH_PASSWORD:-}"
  for i in $(seq 1 20); do
    # ── Test primaire : api_server (8642) ──
    if [ -n "$key" ] && curl -sf -m 5 -H "Authorization: Bearer $key" \
        http://127.0.0.1:8642/v1/models >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      local models; models=$(curl -s -m 5 -H "Authorization: Bearer $key" \
        http://127.0.0.1:8642/v1/models | grep -oE '"id":"[^"]+"' | wc -l)
      log "api_server UP (8642) — $models modèles exposés"
      # ── Test secondaire info : dashboard (9119) ──
      if [ -n "$dash_user" ] && [ -n "$dash_pass" ]; then
        local v; v=$(curl -s -m 5 -u "$dash_user:$dash_pass" \
          http://127.0.0.1:9119/api/status 2>/dev/null | grep -oE '"version":"[^"]+"' | head -1)
        log "Dashboard UP (9119) — ${v:-no-version} (auth BasicAuth OK)"
      else
        log "Dashboard : test skip (pas de creds BASIC_AUTH — info only)"
      fi
      return 0
    fi
    sleep 2
  done
  err "api_server (8642) ne répond pas après 40s"
  # Diagnostic final avant abandon
  log "Diagnostic : docker logs (last 30 lignes) :"
  docker logs --tail 30 hermes-agent 2>&1 | sed 's/^/    /' || true
  return 1
}

# ── Rollback : restaure le dernier backup ──
rollback() {
  local last; last=$(ls -t "${BACKUP_DIR}"/hermes-data-*.tar.gz 2>/dev/null | head -1)
  [ -z "$last" ] && { err "Aucun backup à restaurer"; exit 1; }
  log "Rollback depuis ${last}"
  docker compose stop hermes
  docker run --rm -v hermes-data:/data -v "${BACKUP_DIR}:/backup" alpine:3.20 \
    sh -c "rm -rf /data/* && tar xzf /backup/$(basename "$last") -C /data"
  docker compose up -d hermes
  health_check && log "Rollback réussi" || err "Rollback : gateway KO, intervention manuelle requise"
}

# ── Dispatch des options ──
case "${1:-}" in
  --backup-only) backup_data; exit 0 ;;
  --rollback)    rollback;    exit 0 ;;
esac

# Charge .env pour les DÉFAUTS (clés, HERMES_VERSION par défaut)
[ -f .env ] && set -a && . ./.env && set +a

# L'argument CLI (vYYYY.M.D) a PRIORITÉ sur le .env
case "${1:-}" in
  v*) HERMES_VERSION="$1" ;;
esac
export HERMES_VERSION
TARGET="${HERMES_VERSION:-v2026.6.5}"
log "Version cible : ${TARGET}"

# ── 1. Backup AVANT toute modif ──
BACKUP_FILE=$(backup_data)

# ── 2. Pull de la base pinnée ──
log "Pull nousresearch/hermes-agent:${TARGET}"
docker pull "nousresearch/hermes-agent:${TARGET}"

# ── 3. Rebuild image custom ──
log "Build image custom (HERMES_VERSION=${TARGET})"
HERMES_VERSION="${TARGET}" docker compose build hermes

# ── 4. Restart + health ──
log "Restart de la stack"
HERMES_VERSION="${TARGET}" docker compose up -d

if health_check; then
  log "Update vers ${TARGET} réussi."
  # Persiste la version dans .env : sinon un futur `compose up` (sans ce script)
  # recréerait le conteneur sur l'ancienne version épinglée dans .env.
  if [ -f .env ]; then
    if grep -q '^HERMES_VERSION=' .env; then
      sed -i "s|^HERMES_VERSION=.*|HERMES_VERSION=${TARGET}|" .env
    else
      printf '\nHERMES_VERSION=%s\n' "${TARGET}" >> .env
    fi
    log ".env mis à jour : HERMES_VERSION=${TARGET}"
  fi
  log "Backup conservé : ${BACKUP_FILE}"
  docker image prune -f >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
else
  err "Health check KO → ROLLBACK automatique"
  rollback
  exit 1
fi

```

```text
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { CLIENT_API_KEY } from './config.js';
import { load, safeSave } from './store.js';

// Clés d'appel de l'API (clients) : { id, label, key, active, createdAt, lastUsed }
let clientKeys = load('client_keys', []);

function persist() { safeSave('client_keys', clientKeys); }

export function listClientKeys() {
  return clientKeys.map((k) => ({ ...k, key: mask(k.key) }));
}

export function verifyClientKey(token) {
  if (!token) return false;
  if (CLIENT_API_KEY && token === CLIENT_API_KEY) return 'env';
  const k = clientKeys.find((c) => c.active && c.key === token);
  if (k) { k.lastUsed = Date.now(); safeSave('client_keys', clientKeys); return k.id; }
  return false;
}

export function addClientKey({ label }) {
  const key = `sk-master-${randomUUID().replace(/-/g, '').slice(0, 24)}`;
  const rec = { id: randomUUID(), label: label || 'client', key, active: true, createdAt: new Date().toISOString(), lastUsed: 0 };
  clientKeys.push(rec);
  safeSave('client_keys', clientKeys);
  return { ok: true, key, id: rec.id };
}

export function removeClientKey(id) {
  clientKeys = clientKeys.filter((k) => k.id !== id || k.key === CLIENT_API_KEY);
  safeSave('client_keys', clientKeys);
}

// Déactivation/réactivation + édition label d'une clé client
export function updateClientKey(id, { label, active } = {}) {
  const k = clientKeys.find((c) => c.id === id);
  if (!k) return { ok: false, error: 'clé client introuvable' };
  if (typeof label === 'string' && label !== '') k.label = label;
  if (typeof active === 'boolean') k.active = active;
  safeSave('client_keys', clientKeys);
  return { ok: true };
}

function mask(k) { return k ? k.slice(0, 11) + '…' + k.slice(-4) : ''; }
```

# 🌸 Pollinations AI Plugin para OpenCode (v6.4.9)

## ✨ Novedades v6.4.9

- 🎯 **Quests & Gamificación**: `polli_quests` + `/poll quests`. Usar el plugin completa quests **retroactivamente**.
- 🆓 **Herramientas gratis (sin clave)** — para **cualquier** modelo OpenCode:
  - `gen_edit_image_free` — generar **y** editar (~20/día)
  - `gen_video_free` — texto→vídeo (~5/día)
  - `object_remover` / `image_upscaler` / `image_enhancer` — procesado de imagen gratis
  - `remove_background` — recorte IA gratis (rmbg / bgeraser)
- 🔐 **Login en 1 clic**: `/poll login` + `polli_login`. `/poll connect sk_...` sigue disponible.
- 🧊 **Catálogo completo**: text, image, video, audio, **3D**, **embeddings**, realtime.
- 🧪 **CI + packaging**: Node ≥ 18, CLI `npx opencode-pollinations-plugin`, tests unit + i18n.
- 🌍 **6 idiomas**: en, fr, es, de, it, zh — onboarding y comandos alineados.


<div align="center">

---

## 📖 Filosofía: IA Abierta para Creadores

> **"Sin puertas cerradas, sin bloqueos corporativos — simplemente buenas herramientas y buena gente."**

**Pollinations.ai** es una plataforma de código abierto creada por y para la comunidad. Ofrecemos una API unificada y directa para generar imágenes, texto, audio y vídeo.

- 🌍 **Transparente**: Nuestro código, hoja de ruta (roadmap) y discusiones son de acceso público.
- ⚖️ **Economía Justa**: Una moneda única (**Pollen 🌻**) para todo tipo de archivos multimedia y modelos. Precios predecibles, transparentes y sin ataduras propietarias.

---

## ✨ Novedades de la V6.4

- ⏱️ **Cuotas por Hora**: ¡Dile adiós a los límites diarios! Los Tiers de Desarrollador se recargan **cada hora** exacta (a la hora en punto `:00`), asegurando que siempre tengas créditos frescos para tus largas jornadas de código.
- ⚡ **Motor 100% Dinámico**: ¡Se acabaron las listas de modelos quemadas en el código y los precios estáticos! En V6.2, el agente obtiene dinámicamente los últimos LLMs, parámetros, etiquetas (`[💎 Paid]`, `[🌿 Free]`) y costes aproximados conectándose continuamente a la API de Pollinations.
- 🛡️ **Seguridad Robusta**: Completamente integradas las mitigaciones contra path traversal y una estricta validación de URLs.
- 🔍 **Búsqueda Web Mejorada**: El componente `polli_web_search` accede directamente a las opciones modernas de indexación como Gemini Fast, Perplexity y otros asistentes personalizados por red.

---

## 🧰 Herramientas y Comandos

Aparte de conversar, cuando conectas tu API Key, el Agente OpenCode adquiere superpoderes multimedia desarrollados por los modelos de Pollinations:

### 💎 Herramientas Generativas (ENTER ONLY - requiere API Key)
- 🎨 `polli_gen_image` : Modelos creativos líderes (`Flux`, `Sana`, `Midjourney`, etc.).
- 🎬 `polli_gen_video` : Modelos robustos de Texto-a-Vídeo e Imagen-a-Vídeo (`Wan`, `Veo`, `LTX`, `Reveal`).
- 🔊 `polli_gen_audio` y `polli_gen_music` : Síntesis de voz mágica (ElevenLabs, OpenAI TTS) y Música de IA.
- 🎙️ `polli_stt` : Alta eficiencia en el paso de voz a texto (Whisper V3).
- 🌐 `polli_web_search` : Búsqueda web inteligente y conocimiento en tiempo real (`gemini-search`, `perplexity...`).

### 🧰 Herramientas Integradas Gratuitas (Siempre disponibles)
- ✂️ `remove_background` : Eliminación rápida del fondo de cualquier imagen de forma offline nativa.
- 🛠️ Herramientas como `gen_qrcode`, `gen_diagram`, `extract_frames`, `extract_audio`, y `file_to_url` para mejorar el día a día.

### 💻 Lista Completa de Comandos en Terminal
Solo llama al bot usando los alias **`/poll`** o **`/pollinations`** en tu terminal:
- `/poll help` : Muestra todo el cuadro de ayuda interactivo.
- `/poll connect` : Interfaz de configuración "Bring Your Own Key" (Trae tu proipa Clave).
- `/poll usage full` : Panel de control en tiempo real, recargas de saldo y uso del Tiers Gratuitos.
- `/poll config` : Refinamiento de idiomas, alertas de costes (Cost Guards) y logs.
- `/poll models` : Ver los modelos ahora viables y en línea.
- `/poll pricing` : Mirar la lista de precios unificados de Pollen al día.
- `/poll fallback` : Configurar tus redes de seguridad para las conversaciones y el Agente.
- `/poll infos` : Información vital del ecosistema, sobre cómo funciona todo y formas de subir de nivel en los Roles.

---

## 🛡️ "Cost Guard" & El "Safety Net" (Red de Seguridad)

Nos preocupamos de tu cartera y de tu ritmo de trabajo, incluyendo barreras fundamentales que aseguran tu tranquilidad:

- 🛟 **Red de Seguridad**: Al agotar tu saldo diario/por hora o si un error bloqueante 429 sucediese, el ecosistema transita suave y calladamente hacia modelos Free de seguridad. Tu chat jamás se cortará sin un aviso.
- 🚦 **Cost Guard de Herramientas**: Ya que los modelos potentes de Audio o Video consumen bastante (y un agente podría sobrepasar ese límite por afición a resolver un problema a nivel visual), implementamos interceptores. Una parada asíncrona solicitará tu confirmación directa ante transacciones altas.

---

## 🐝 Entendiendo el Pollen & "Free Tiers"

Antes Pollinations se sustentaba de anuncios para todos. Hoy, correr grandes servidores y maravillas como Claude 3.5 Sonnet, cuestan dinero. El mundo llamado **Enter Universe** precisa entonces de tu propia APi Key.

**¡Pero espera que NO necesitas registrar una tarjeta bancaria!**

El **Pollen 🌻** dicta la ley unificada del crédito (1$ ≈ 1 Pollen). Sólo vinculando una clave Key sencilla gratuita abres el camino hacia el **beneficio del sistema de recarga automática por hora**:

| Tier | Recarga Hora ⏱️ | Aprox Diario* | Requisito a Cumplir |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 🍄 **Spore** | **0.01 Pollen / hora** | ~0.24 /día | Examen de perfil y verificación |
| 🌱 **Seed** | **0.15 Pollen / hora** | ~3.6 /día | Desarrollador activo en Github (+8 pts) |
| 🌸 **Flower** | **0.40 Pollen / hora** | ~9.6 /día | **Completar y Publicar una App** |
| 🍯 **Nectar** | **0.80 Pollen / hora** | ~19.2 /día | Pendiente a futuras actualizaciones 🔮 |

_*Los cálculos diarios solo son estimaciones teóricas (~24h × cuota/hora). El reinicio limpio sucede exacto en el minuto `:00` de las horas del reloj._

> 🎁 **Obtén tu Clave Gratuita Personal (BYOK) desde [Pollinations.ai](https://enter.pollinations.ai/authorize?redirect_url=https://github.com/fkom13/opencode-pollinations-plugin) ¡Y dale alas a tu OpenCode!**

**¿Cómo es el ciclo?**
1. Lo que consumas lo deduce el plugin de tu cuota de Tier gratuita (ej: los 0.40 🌻/h si eres Flower).
2. Si llegas al límite horario de gratis, bajará los procesos a modos pasivos y lentos del ecosistema Gratuito.
3. Lo introducido en saldo comprado solo afectará la orden si fallan las vías de red anteriores.
4. ¿Ha llegado la hora siguiente? 💥 Bam. Tus cuotas se resetean totalmente de nuevo.

---

## 🌍 Soporte Nativo de Diversos Idiomas (i18n)

Pollinations se comunica fluidamente en varios idiomas usando bases directas:
- Interfaz del entorno, Alarmas Flotantes (Toasts), Notificaciones y Comandos vienen localizados a **Inglés**, **Francés**, **Español**, **Alemán**, **Italiano**, y **Chino**.
- Ingresa el comando `/poll config lang <en|fr|es|de|it|zh>` para cambiar entre esquemas casi mágicamente.

## 🚀 Instalación y Emparejamiento

### 🐧 1. Soporte a Todas las Plataformas vía NPM CLI
Este núcleo ha sido forjado para acoplarse y detectar con vida propia sobre (Windows, macOS, Linux).

   ```

```bash
/poll connect
```
Sigue el simpático sistema base para inyectar y comprobar tu clave Pollinations personal. *(Nota: Haz el amago de cerrar OpenCode y ejecutarlo de nuevo para purgar el visor de modelos al instante).*

/*
 * Jake JavaScript build tool
 * Copyright 2112 Matthew Eernisse (mde@fleegix.org)
 *
 * Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (the "License");
 * you may not use this file except in compliance with the License.

 * distributed under the License is distributed on an "AS IS" BASIS,
 * WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND, either express or implied.
 * See the License for the specific language governing permissions and
 * limitations under the License.
 *
*/

let path = require('path');
let fs = require('fs');
let existsSync = fs.existsSync;
let utils = require('./utils');

// Files like jakelib/foobar.jake.js
const JAKELIB_FILE_PAT = /\.jake$|\.js$/;
const SUPPORTED_EXTENSIONS = {
  'js': null,
  'cjs': null,
  'coffee': function () {
    try {
      let cs = require('coffeescript');
      if (typeof cs.register == 'function') {
        cs.register();
      }
    }
    catch(e) {
      throw new Error('You have a CoffeeScript Jakefile, but have not installed CoffeeScript');
    }
  },
  'ls': function () {
    try {
      require('livescript');
    }
    catch (e) {
      throw new Error('You have a LiveScript Jakefile, but have not installed LiveScript');
    }
  },
  'ts': function () {
    try {
      require('ts-node/register/transpile-only');
    }
    catch (e) {
      throw new Error('You have a TypeScript Jakefile, but have not installed TypeScript and ts-node');
    }
  }
};
const IMPLICIT_JAKEFILE_NAMES = [
  'Jakefile',
  'Gulpfile'
];

let Loader = function () {
  // Load a Jakefile, running the code inside -- this may result in
  // tasks getting defined using the original Jake API, e.g.,
  // `task('foo' ['bar', 'baz']);`, or can also auto-create tasks
  // from any functions exported from the file
  function loadFile(filePath) {
    let exported = require(filePath);
    for (let [key, value] of Object.entries(exported)) {
      let t;
      if (typeof value == 'function') {
        t = jake.task(key, value);
        t.description = '(Exported function)';
      }
    }
  }

  function fileExists(name) {
    let nameWithExt = null;
    // Support no file extension as well
    let exts = Object.keys(SUPPORTED_EXTENSIONS).concat(['']);
    exts.some((ext) => {
      let fname = ext ? `${name}.${ext}` : name;
      if (existsSync(fname)) {
        nameWithExt = fname;
        return true;
      }
    });
    return nameWithExt;
  }

  // Recursive
  function findImplicitJakefile() {
    let cwd = process.cwd();
    let names = IMPLICIT_JAKEFILE_NAMES;
    let found = null;
    names.some((name) => {
      let n;
      // Prefer all-lowercase
      n = name.toLowerCase();
      if ((found = fileExists(n))) {
        return found;
      }
      // Check mixed-case as well
      n = name;
      if ((found = fileExists(n))) {
        return found;
      }
    });
    if (found) {
      return found;
    }
    else {
      process.chdir("..");
      // If we've walked all the way up the directory tree,
      // bail out with no result
      if (cwd === process.cwd()) {
        return null;
      }
      return findImplicitJakefile();
    }
  }

  this.loadFile = function (fileSpecified) {
    let jakefile;
    let origCwd = process.cwd();

    if (fileSpecified) {
      if (existsSync(fileSpecified)) {
        jakefile = fileSpecified;
      }
    }
    else {
      jakefile = findImplicitJakefile();
    }

    if (jakefile) {
      let ext = jakefile.split('.')[1];
      let loaderFunc = SUPPORTED_EXTENSIONS[ext];
      loaderFunc && loaderFunc();

      loadFile(utils.file.absolutize(jakefile));
      return true;
    }
    else {
      if (!fileSpecified) {
        // Restore the working directory on failure
        process.chdir(origCwd);
      }
      return false;
    }
  };

  this.loadDirectory = function (d) {
    let dirname = d || 'jakelib';
    let dirlist;
    dirname = utils.file.absolutize(dirname);
    if (existsSync(dirname)) {
      dirlist = fs.readdirSync(dirname);
      dirlist.forEach(function (filePath) {
        if (JAKELIB_FILE_PAT.test(filePath)) {
          loadFile(path.join(dirname, filePath));
        }
      });
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  };

};

module.exports = function () {
  return new Loader();
};

```

```text
'use strict';

const kDone = Symbol('kDone');
const kRun = Symbol('kRun');

/**
 * A very simple job queue with adjustable concurrency. Adapted from
 * https://github.com/STRML/async-limiter
 */
class Limiter {
  /**
   * Creates a new `Limiter`.
   *
   * @param {Number} [concurrency=Infinity] The maximum number of jobs allowed
   *     to run concurrently
   */
  constructor(concurrency) {
    this[kDone] = () => {
      this.pending--;
      this[kRun]();
    };
    this.concurrency = concurrency || Infinity;
    this.jobs = [];
    this.pending = 0;
  }

  /**
   * Adds a job to the queue.
   *
   * @param {Function} job The job to run
   * @public
   */
  add(job) {
    this.jobs.push(job);
    this[kRun]();
  }

  /**
   * Removes a job from the queue and runs it if possible.
   *
   * @private
   */
  [kRun]() {
    if (this.pending === this.concurrency) return;

    if (this.jobs.length) {
      const job = this.jobs.shift();

      this.pending++;
      job(this[kDone]);
    }
  }
}

module.exports = Limiter;

```

# ─── Cible amont ───────────────────────────────────────────────
ZEN_BASE_URL=https://opencode.ai/zen/v1

# ─── Réseau ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
PORT=3081
HOST=0.0.0.0

# ─── Clé Zen initiale (auth.json) — gitignorée ─────────────────
ZEN_KEY=[SECRET REDACTED]
# Les autres comptes (nom, email, api_key) se saisissent via le dashboard.

# ─── Clé d'appel de l'API (clients) ─────────────────────────────
CLIENT_API_KEY=[SECRET REDACTED]
ADMIN_TOKEN=[SECRET REDACTED]
ADMIN_USERNAME=fkomp
ADMIN_PASSWORD=[SECRET REDACTED]
COOKIE_SECRET=[SECRET REDACTED]

# ─── Retry / backoff (relay amont, modifiable à chaud) ──────────
FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS=60000          # timeout d'une requête amont (s)
RETRY_TOTAL_BUDGET_MS=120000    # budget max de retries pour une requête (s)

# ─── Pool / rotation (modifiable à chaud) ──────────────────────

# ─── Modèles ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
MODEL_CACHE_TTL=3600            # cache /v1/models (s)
FREE_ONLY=true                  # whitelist stricte des modèles free
FOCUS_MODEL=deepseek-v4-flash-free
FALLBACK_MODELS=big-pickle,mimo-v2.5-free,laguna-s-2.1-free,nemotron-3-ultra-free

# ─── Limites clients / IP ──────────────────────────────────────
IP_RATE_LIMIT_RPM=60
IP_RATE_LIMIT_RPD=2000
MAX_CONCURRENT_PER_IP=4

# ─── Persistance ───────────────────────────────────────────────
DATA_DIR=./data

# ─── Stratégie de sélection (par défaut round_robin) ───────────
# round_robin : répartition égale entre clés (recommandé)
# least_loaded : clé la moins chargée en tokens/jour
# (modifiable à chaud via Dashboard → Config, sans variable .env)
# Egress optionnels (activés seulement si prouvés nécessaires). Les relais publics doivent être HTTPS.
# ZEN_EGRESS_RELAYS_JSON=[{"id":"vps-eu-1","url":"https://relay1.example.com","key":"[SECRET REDACTED]","priority":1,"maxConcurrency":1}]
# ZEN_EGRESS_RELAY_URLS=https://relay1.example.com,https://relay2.example.com
# ZEN_EGRESS_RELAY_KEY_B64=[SECRET REDACTED]
ZEN_DIRECT_MAX_CONCURRENCY=2
MAX_UPSTREAM_ATTEMPTS=2        # par vague: anonyme + un compte, sur une seule IP
KEY_MAX_CONCURRENCY=[SECRET REDACTED]
FREE_LIMIT_RETRY_MS=20000
FREE_LIMIT_MAX_BACKOFF_MS=60000
QUOTA_CONFIRM_EGRESS_COUNT=2
QUOTA_RECHECK_MS=20000
EGRESS_CIRCUIT_THRESHOLD=2
EGRESS_CIRCUIT_WINDOW_MS=60000
EGRESS_CIRCUIT_MS=600000

    container_name: zen-proxy
    restart: unless-stopped
    # -- Sécurité : bind localhost UNIQUEMENT, exposé via nginx (zen.esprit-artificiel.com)
    # L'hôte possède une IPv6 saine vers Zen, contrairement au bridge Docker.
    # HOST=127.0.0.1 maintient l'API privée et accessible uniquement via nginx.
    network_mode: host
    env_file:
      - ./production.env
    volumes:
      - ./data:/app/data
      - ./logs:/app/logs
    environment:
      - NODE_ENV=production
      - HOST=127.0.0.1
    mem_limit: 512m
    cpus: 1.0

volumes: {}

```

### 📁 nginx

#### 📄 `nginx/zen.esprit-artificiel.com.conf`

```text
server {
    server_name zen.esprit-artificiel.com;
    location /.well-known/acme-challenge/ { root /var/www/html; }
    location / {
        proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:3081;
        proxy_http_version 1.1;
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
        client_max_body_size 100m;
        proxy_read_timeout 600s;
        proxy_send_timeout 600s;
        proxy_buffering off;  # SSE
        proxy_set_header Upgrade $http_upgrade;
        proxy_set_header Connection "upgrade";
    }

    listen [::]:443 ssl; # managed by Certbot
    listen 443 ssl; # managed by Certbot
    ssl_certificate /etc/letsencrypt/live/zen.esprit-artificiel.com/fullchain.pem; # managed by Certbot
    ssl_certificate_key /etc/letsencrypt/live/zen.esprit-artificiel.com/privkey.pem; # managed by Certbot
    include /etc/letsencrypt/options-ssl-nginx.conf; # managed by Certbot
    ssl_dhparam /etc/letsencrypt/ssl-dhparams.pem; # managed by Certbot
}
server {
    if ($host = zen.esprit-artificiel.com) {
        return 301 https://$host$request_uri;
    } # managed by Certbot
    server_name zen.esprit-artificiel.com;
    listen 80;
    listen [::]:80;
    return 404; # managed by Certbot
}
```

import { configBoolean, configNumber, configString } from './config.js';

function sharedRelayKey() {
  if (process.env.ZEN_EGRESS_RELAY_KEY_B64) {
    try { return Buffer.from(process.env.ZEN_EGRESS_RELAY_KEY_B64, 'base64').toString('utf8'); }
    catch (error) { console.error('[egress] ZEN_EGRESS_RELAY_KEY_B64 invalide:', error.message); }
  }
  return process.env.ZEN_EGRESS_RELAY_KEY || '';
}

function genericRelays() {
  const sharedKey = [SECRET REDACTED]
  const rawJson = process.env.ZEN_EGRESS_RELAYS_JSON || '';
  if (rawJson) {
    try {
      const rows = JSON.parse(rawJson);
      if (Array.isArray(rows)) return rows.map((row, index) => ({
        id: String(row.id || `relay-${index + 1}`), type: 'generic-relay',
        baseUrl: String(row.url || '').replace(/\/$/, ''), key: [SECRET REDACTED],
        priority: Number(row.priority ?? index + 10),
        maxConcurrency: Math.max(1, Number(row.maxConcurrency || configNumber('ZEN_RELAY_MAX_CONCURRENCY', 1))),
      })).filter(validRelay);
    } catch (error) { console.error('[egress] ZEN_EGRESS_RELAYS_JSON invalide:', error.message); }
  }

  return configString('ZEN_EGRESS_RELAY_URLS', '').split(',').map((url) => url.trim()).filter(Boolean)
    .map((url, index) => ({
      id: `relay-${index + 1}`, type: 'generic-relay', baseUrl: url.replace(/\/$/, ''), key: [SECRET REDACTED],
      priority: index + 10, maxConcurrency: Math.max(1, configNumber('ZEN_RELAY_MAX_CONCURRENCY', 1)),
    })).filter(validRelay);
}

function validRelay(row) {
  if (!row.baseUrl || !row.key) return false;
  try {
    const url = new URL(row.baseUrl);
    const privateHost = /^(127\.|10\.|192\.168\.|172\.(1[6-9]|2\d|3[01])\.)/.test(url.hostname) || url.hostname === 'localhost';
    return url.protocol === 'https:' || privateHost || process.env.ZEN_ALLOW_INSECURE_PUBLIC_RELAY === 'true';
  } catch { return false; }
}

export function getEgresses() {
  const rows = [];
  const primaryUrl = configString('ZEN_PRIMARY_RELAY_URL', '') || process.env.ZEN_IPV6_RELAY_URL || '';
  const primarySecret = [SECRET REDACTED]'';
  if (configBoolean('ZEN_PRIMARY_RELAY_ENABLED', false) && primaryUrl && primarySecret) {
    rows.push({
      id: 'primary-relay', type: 'zen-relay', baseUrl: primaryUrl.replace(/\/$/, ''), key: [SECRET REDACTED],
      priority: 1, maxConcurrency: Math.max(1, configNumber('ZEN_RELAY_MAX_CONCURRENCY', 1)),
    });
  }
  if (configBoolean('ZEN_DIRECT_ENABLED', true)) {
    rows.push({ id: 'direct', type: 'direct', priority: 0, maxConcurrency: Math.max(1, configNumber('ZEN_DIRECT_MAX_CONCURRENCY', 2)) });
  }
  rows.push(...genericRelays());
  return rows.sort((a, b) => a.priority - b.priority);
}

export function publicEgresses() {
  return getEgresses().map(({ key, ...row }) => row);
}

export async function fetchViaEgress(egress, path, init) {
  const base = configString('ZEN_BASE_URL', 'https://opencode.ai/zen/v1').replace(/\/$/, '');
  const targetUrl = `${base}${path}`;
  if (!egress || egress.type === 'direct') return fetch(targetUrl, init);

  const headers = new Headers(init.headers || {});
  if (egress.type === 'zen-relay') {
    headers.set('X-Zen-Relay-Secret', egress.key);
    return fetch(`${egress.baseUrl}${path}`, { ...init, headers });
  }

  const target = new URL(targetUrl);
  headers.set('X-EA-ProxyPass-Key', egress.key);
  headers.set('X-Target-URL', targetUrl);
  return fetch(`${egress.baseUrl}${target.pathname}${target.search}`, { ...init, headers });
}

import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';

  ZEN_KEY, configNumber, configBoolean,
} from './config.js';
import { load, safeSave } from './store.js';

// Santé persistée :
// - compte : auth_invalid uniquement quand l'erreur Zen est explicite ;
// - modèle/clé : quota suspecté seulement après échec via plusieurs IP ;
// - route clé×modèle×egress : cooldown transitoire ;
// - egress×modèle : circuit partagé si plusieurs clés distinctes échouent.

let pool = load('zen_keys', []);
let health = load('pool_health', { egressModels: {}, globalModels: {}, events: [] });
const anonymousKey = [SECRET REDACTED]
  id: 'anonymous', name: 'Zen anonyme', apiKey:[SECRET REDACTED]'', active: true, state: 'active',
  usageEvents: [], routeHealth: {}, modelHealth: {}, errors: 0,
  lastErrorKind: '', lastErrorDetail: '', lastErrorAt: 0,
};
const inFlight = new Map();
const inFlightEgress = new Map();
let rotationMode = 'round_robin';

if (pool.length === 0 && ZEN_KEY) {
  pool.push(newKey('compte-initial', '', ZEN_KEY));
  persist();
}

for (const key of pool) migrateKey(key);
migrateKey(anonymousKey);

const n = (key, fallback) => configNumber(key, fallback);

function newKey(name, email, apiKey) {
  return {
    id: randomUUID().slice(0, 8), name, email, apiKey,
    active: true, state: 'active', createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    usageEvents: [], routeHealth: {}, modelHealth: {},
    errors: 0, lastErrorKind: '', lastErrorDetail: '', lastErrorAt: 0,
  };
}

function migrateKey(k) {
  k.active = k.active !== false;
  k.state = ['auth_invalid', 'cold'].includes(k.state) ? k.state : 'active';
  k.usageEvents = Array.isArray(k.usageEvents) ? k.usageEvents : [];
  if (k.usageEvents.length === 0 && (Number(k.tokensToday || 0) > 0 || Number(k.reqToday || 0) > 0)) {
    k.usageEvents.push({
      at: Number(k.lastUsedAt || Date.now()), tokens: [SECRET REDACTED],
      requests: Number(k.reqToday || 0), model: 'legacy', egressId: 'direct', source: 'legacy-counter',
    });
  }
  k.routeHealth = k.routeHealth && typeof k.routeHealth === 'object' ? k.routeHealth : {};
  k.modelHealth = k.modelHealth && typeof k.modelHealth === 'object' ? k.modelHealth : {};
  k.errors = Number(k.errors || 0);
  // Les anciens COLD étaient ambigus. On conserve l'observation pour audit, sans la traiter comme preuve.
  if (k.lastErrorKind === 'quota' && !k.migratedLegacyColdAt) k.migratedLegacyColdAt = Date.now();
  if (!k.nativeQuotaStateVersion) {
    k.legacyQuotaHits = Number(k.quotaHits || k.freeLimitHits || 0);
    k.quotaHits = 0;
    k.freeLimitHits = 0;
    k.state = k.state === 'auth_invalid' ? 'auth_invalid' : 'active';
    k.wakeAt = 0;
    k.nativeQuotaStateVersion = 1;
  }
}

function persist() {
  safeSave('zen_keys', pool);
  safeSave('pool_health', health);
}

export function maskKey(k) { return k ? `${k.slice(0, 7)}…${k.slice(-4)}` : ''; }

function pruneUsage(k, now = Date.now()) {
  const cutoff = now - 48 * 3600 * 1000;
  k.usageEvents = k.usageEvents.filter((e) => Number(e.at) >= cutoff);
}

function usage24h(k, now = Date.now()) {
  pruneUsage(k, now);
  const d = new Date(now);
  const cutoff = Date.UTC(d.getUTCFullYear(), d.getUTCMonth(), d.getUTCDate());
  return k.usageEvents.filter((e) => Number(e.at) >= cutoff)
    .reduce((a, e) => ({ tokens: [SECRET REDACTED], requests: a.requests + Number(e.requests || 0) }), { tokens: [SECRET REDACTED], requests: 0 });
}

function cleanup(now = Date.now()) {
  health.egressModels ||= {};
  health.globalModels ||= {};
  health.events = Array.isArray(health.events) ? health.events.slice(-1000) : [];
  for (const k of [anonymousKey, ...pool]) {
    pruneUsage(k, now);
    for (const [id, route] of Object.entries(k.routeHealth)) {
      if (route.cooldownUntil <= now && now - Number(route.lastFailureAt || 0) > 24 * 3600 * 1000) delete k.routeHealth[id];
    }
    for (const model of Object.values(k.modelHealth)) {
      model.evidence = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(model.evidence || {}).filter(([, at]) => now - Number(at) < 24 * 3600 * 1000));
      if (model.blockedUntil <= now) model.status = 'ready';
    }
  }
  for (const [id, circuit] of Object.entries(health.egressModels || {})) {
    circuit.failures = (circuit.failures || []).filter((f) => now - f.at <= n('EGRESS_CIRCUIT_WINDOW_MS', 60000));
    if (circuit.openUntil <= now && circuit.failures.length === 0) delete health.egressModels[id];
  }
  for (const [model, circuit] of Object.entries(health.globalModels || {})) {
    circuit.failures = (circuit.failures || []).filter((f) => now - f.at <= n('EGRESS_CIRCUIT_WINDOW_MS', 60000));
    if (circuit.openUntil <= now && circuit.failures.length === 0) delete health.globalModels[model];
  }
}

function publicKey(k) {
  const u = usage24h(k);
  const activeBlocks = Object.entries(k.modelHealth).filter(([, m]) => m.status !== 'ready' && m.blockedUntil > Date.now());
  let state = !k.active ? 'disabled' : ['auth_invalid', 'cold'].includes(k.state) ? k.state : activeBlocks.length ? 'limited' : 'active';
  const next = k.state === 'cold' ? Number(k.wakeAt || 0) : activeBlocks.length ? Math.min(...activeBlocks.map(([, m]) => m.blockedUntil)) : 0;
  return {
    ...k, apiKey: [SECRET REDACTED], state,
    tokensToday: [SECRET REDACTED], reqToday: u.requests,
    usage24h: u, wakeAt: next, cooldownUntil: next,
    inFlight: inFlight.get(k.id) || 0,
  };
}

  const k = pool.find((x) => x.id === id);

  if (!k) return { ok: false, error: 'compte introuvable' };

  if (typeof email === 'string') k.email = email;
  if (typeof apiKey =[SECRET REDACTED]'string' && apiKey.startsWith('sk-')) { k.apiKey = [SECRET REDACTED]'active'; k.routeHealth = {}; k.modelHealth = {}; }
  if (typeof active === 'boolean') k.active = active;

export function setRotationMode(mode) { if (['round_robin', 'least_loaded'].includes(mode)) rotationMode = mode; }
export function getRotationMode() { return rotationMode; }

function circuitId(model, egressId) { return `${model}@@${egressId}`; }

function routeReady(k, model, egress, now) {
  const egressId = egress.id;
  if (!k.active || ['auth_invalid', 'cold'].includes(k.state)) return false;
  if ((inFlight.get(k.id) || 0) >= n('KEY_MAX_CONCURRENCY', 1)) return false;
  if ((inFlightEgress.get(egressId) || 0) >= Number(egress.maxConcurrency || 1)) return false;
  const modelState = k.modelHealth[model];
  if (modelState?.status === 'unsupported') return false;
  if (Number(modelState?.blockedUntil || 0) > now) return false;
  if (Number(k.routeHealth[routeId(model, egressId)]?.cooldownUntil || 0) > now) return false;
  if (Number(health.egressModels?.[circuitId(model, egressId)]?.openUntil || 0) > now) return false;
  const minute = rollingUsage({ keyId: [SECRET REDACTED], sinceMs: 60_000 }, now);
  if (minute.requests >= n('KEY_RATE_LIMIT_RPM', 10)) return false;
  if (minute.tokens >= n('KEY_RATE_LIMIT_TPM', 100000)) return false;
  return true;
}

export function acquireRoute({ model, egresses, attempted = new Set(), preferredKeyId[SECRET REDACTED]'', strictPreferred = false, excludedKeyIds = [SECRET REDACTED], now = Date.now() }) {
  cleanup(now);
  const candidates = [];
  const keys = [SECRET REDACTED]'ANONYMOUS_ENABLED', false) ? [anonymousKey, ...pool] : pool;
  for (const k of keys) for (const egress of egresses) {
    const id = `${k.id}@@${model}@@${egress.id}`;
    if (excludedKeyIds.has(k.id)) continue;
    if (strictPreferred && preferredKeyId && k.id !== preferredKeyId) continue;
    if (!attempted.has(id) && routeReady(k, model, egress, now)) candidates.push({ [SECRET REDACTED], egress, id, egressCount: egresses.length });
  }
  if (!candidates.length) return null;
  candidates.sort((a, b) => {
    const aPreferred = a.key.id === preferredKeyId ? 0 : 1;
    const bPreferred = b.key.id === preferredKeyId ? 0 : 1;
    if (aPreferred !== bPreferred) return aPreferred - bPreferred;
    const aAnonymous = a.key.id === 'anonymous' ? 0 : 1;
    const bAnonymous = b.key.id === 'anonymous' ? 0 : 1;
    if (aAnonymous !== bAnonymous) return aAnonymous - bAnonymous;
    if (a.egress.priority !== b.egress.priority) return a.egress.priority - b.egress.priority;
    if (rotationMode === 'least_loaded') return usage24h(a.key, now).tokens - usage24h(b.key, now).tokens;
    const routeA = a.key.routeHealth[routeId(model, a.egress.id)]?.lastUsedAt || a.key.lastUsedAt || 0;
    const routeB = b.key.routeHealth[routeId(model, b.egress.id)]?.lastUsedAt || b.key.lastUsedAt || 0;
    return routeA - routeB;
  });
  const selected = candidates[0];
  inFlight.set(selected.key.id, (inFlight.get(selected.key.id) || 0) + 1);
  inFlightEgress.set(selected.egress.id, (inFlightEgress.get(selected.egress.id) || 0) + 1);
  attempted.add(selected.id);

export function releaseRoute(route) {

  inFlight.set(route.key.id, Math.max(0, (inFlight.get(route.key.id) || 1) - 1));
  inFlightEgress.set(route.egress.id, Math.max(0, (inFlightEgress.get(route.egress.id) || 1) - 1));
}

function modelState(k, model) {

function routeState(k, model, egressId) {

function freeLimitBackoff(failures, retryAfterMs) {
  const max = n('FREE_LIMIT_MAX_BACKOFF_MS', 60000);

  circuit.failures = circuit.failures.filter((f) => now - f.at <= n('EGRESS_CIRCUIT_WINDOW_MS', 60000));
  circuit.failures.push({ keyId: [SECRET REDACTED], at: now });

    console.warn(`[circuit] OPEN egress=${egressId} model=${model} keys=[SECRET REDACTED]} until=${new Date(circuit.openUntil).toISOString()}`);

function rollingUsage({ keyId[SECRET REDACTED]'', model = '', egressId = '', sinceMs = 60_000 }, now = Date.now()) {

  for (const k of [anonymousKey, ...pool]) {

      if (model && event.model !== model) continue;
      if (egressId && event.egressId !== egressId) continue;
      tokens += Number(event.tokens || 0);
      requests += Number(event.requests || 0);
    }
  }

}

  if (health.events.length > 1000) health.events.splice(0, health.events.length - 1000);

    retryAfterMs: classification.retryAfterMs || 0, cfRay: classification.cfRay || '',
    keyTokens1m: [SECRET REDACTED], keyRequests1m: [SECRET REDACTED],
    egressTokens1m: [SECRET REDACTED], egressRequests1m: egressMinute.requests,

export function recordRouteSuccess(route, model, tokens = [SECRET REDACTED], requests = 1) {
  const { [SECRET REDACTED], egress } = route;
  const now = Date.now();
  const rs = routeState(k, model, egress.id);
  const ms = modelState(k, model);
  const failedEgresses = Object.keys(ms.evidence || {}).filter((id) => id !== egress.id);
  rs.failures = 0; rs.cooldownUntil = 0; rs.lastSuccessAt = now; rs.lastUsedAt = now;
  // La même clé vient de réussir ailleurs : les échecs précédents sont donc liés
  // à la route/IP/modèle, pas à un quota global de cette clé.
  for (const failedEgressId of failedEgresses) {

    circuit.openUntil = Math.max(circuit.openUntil || 0, now + n('EGRESS_CIRCUIT_MS', 60000));
    circuit.confidence = 'proven';
    circuit.lastReason = `même clé OK via ${egress.id} après limite via ${failedEgressId}`;
    console.warn(`[circuit] OPEN proven egress=${failedEgressId} model=${model} alternate=${egress.id} until=${new Date(circuit.openUntil).toISOString()}`);
  }
  ms.status = 'ready'; ms.blockedUntil = 0; ms.evidence = {};
  k.state = 'active'; k.lastUsedAt = now; k.errors = Math.max(0, k.errors - 1); k.freeLimitHits = 0;
  k.usageEvents.push({ at: now, tokens: [SECRET REDACTED], requests: Number(requests || 1), model, egressId: egress.id });
  const circuit = health.egressModels[circuitId(model, egress.id)];
  if (circuit) circuit.failures = circuit.failures.filter((f) => f.keyId !== k.id);
  appendHealthEvent({ at: now, outcome: 'success', keyId: [SECRET REDACTED], model, egressId: egress.id, tokens: [SECRET REDACTED]});

}

// Compatibilité pour la découverte /models : direct, sans réservation durable.
export function selectBestKey() {
  cleanup();
  return pool.find((k) => k.active && k.state !== 'auth_invalid') || null;
}

export function poolRetryHint(model = '') {
  cleanup();
  const now = Date.now();
  const times = [];
  for (const k of [anonymousKey, ...pool]) {
    if (!k.active || k.state === 'auth_invalid') continue;
    if (model && k.modelHealth[model]?.blockedUntil > now) times.push(k.modelHealth[model].blockedUntil);
    for (const [id, r] of Object.entries(k.routeHealth)) if ((!model || id.startsWith(`${model}@@`)) && r.cooldownUntil > now) times.push(r.cooldownUntil);
  }
  for (const [id, circuit] of Object.entries(health.egressModels || {})) if ((!model || id.startsWith(`${model}@@`)) && circuit.openUntil > now) times.push(circuit.openUntil);

}

// Ancienne API : le scheduler ne pilote plus les limites ambiguës.
function nextUtcMidnight(now = Date.now()) {
  const d = new Date(now);
  return Date.UTC(d.getUTCFullYear(), d.getUTCMonth(), d.getUTCDate() + 1);
}

export function collectWakeCandidates(now = Date.now()) {
  return pool.filter((k) => k.active && k.state === 'cold' && Number(k.wakeAt || 0) <= now);
}
export function wakeFailed(id) {
  const k = pool.find((x) => x.id === id); if (!k) return;
  k.coldProbeFailures = Number(k.coldProbeFailures || 0) + 1;

  const max = n('COLD_PROBE_MAX_INTERVAL_HOURS', 12);
  const hours = Math.min(max, base * 2 ** Math.max(0, k.coldProbeFailures - 1));
  k.wakeAt = Date.now() + hours * 3600_000;
  persist();
}
export function wakeOk(id) { return setKeyStatus(id, { state: 'active' }); }
export function recordUsage(id, tokens, reqs = 1) {
  const k = pool.find((x) => x.id === id); if (!k) return;
  k.usageEvents.push({ at: Date.now(), tokens: [SECRET REDACTED], requests: Number(reqs || 1), model: 'unknown', egressId: 'direct' }); persist();
}
export function recordError(id, type, detail = '') {
  const k = pool.find((x) => x.id === id); if (!k) return;
  k.errors += 1; k.lastErrorKind = type; k.lastErrorDetail = String(detail).slice(0, 400); k.lastErrorAt = Date.now(); persist();
}

export function poolHealth() {
  cleanup();
  return { anonymous: publicKey(anonymousKey), egressModels: health.egressModels, events: health.events.slice(-200), inFlight: Object.fromEntries(inFlight), inFlightEgress: Object.fromEntries(inFlightEgress) };

import { MODEL_CACHE_TTL, FREE_ONLY, FOCUS_MODEL, FALLBACK_MODELS, ZEN_BASE_URL } from './config.js';
import { selectBestKey } from './keyPool.js';
import { zenFetch } from './zenFetch.js';

// Limites de contexte (tokens) — fallback statique (source models.dev, 2026-08)
// Zen n'expose pas ces infos dans /v1/models : on essaie d'abord models.dev (cache 1h),
// puis on retombe sur cette table locale. JAMIS comme vérité ferme.
const CONTEXT_FALLBACK = {
  'deepseek-v4-flash-free': 200000,
  'big-pickle': 200000,
  'mimo-v2.5-free': 200000,
  'ling-3.0-flash-free': 262144,
  'nemotron-3-ultra-free': 1000000,
  'north-mini-code-free': 256000,
  'laguna-s-2.1-free': 256000,
  'longcat-2.0-free': 1000000,
};
const OUTPUT_FALLBACK = {
  'deepseek-v4-flash-free': 128000,
  'big-pickle': 32000,
  'mimo-v2.5-free': 32000,
  'ling-3.0-flash-free': 32768,
  'nemotron-3-ultra-free': 128000,
  'north-mini-code-free': 64000,
  'laguna-s-2.1-free': 32000,
  'longcat-2.0-free': 131072,
};

let cache = { at: 0, list: [] };
let limitsCache = { at: 0, map: {} };   // cache des limites (models.dev), TTL même que modèles

async function loadModelLimits(force = false) {
  const now = Date.now();
  if (force || Object.keys(limitsCache.map).length === 0 || now - limitsCache.at >= MODEL_CACHE_TTL * 1000) {
    try {
      const r = await fetch('https://models.dev/api.json', { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(10000) });
      if (r.ok) {
        const root = await r.json();
        const p = root?.opencode || {};
        const map = {};
        for (const [id, m] of Object.entries(p.models || {})) {
          const limit = m.limit || {};
          map[id] = { context: limit.context || null, output: limit.output || null };
        }
        limitsCache = { at: now, map };
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('[limits] models.dev unreachable, fallback local:', e.message);
    }
  }
  return limitsCache.map;
}

// Applique les limites connues à une liste de modèles : models.dev d'abord, fallback local
export async function applyLimits(models) {
  const remote = await loadModelLimits();
  return (models || []).map((m) => {
    const r = remote[m.id];
    const f = { context: CONTEXT_FALLBACK[m.id] || null, output: OUTPUT_FALLBACK[m.id] || null };
    return { ...m, limit: (r && typeof r.context === 'number' && r.context > 0 ? r : f) };
  });
}

// Discovery des modèles depuis Zen (cache TTL), en passant par une clé libre
export async function getModels(_force = false) {
  const now = Date.now();
  if (!_force && cache.list.length && now - cache.at < MODEL_CACHE_TTL * 1000) return cache.list;

  const key = [SECRET REDACTED]
  if (!key) return cache.list.length ? cache.list : [];

  try {
    const r = await zenFetch(`${ZEN_BASE_URL}/models`, {
      headers: { Authorization: [SECRET REDACTED]}` },
    });
    if (!r.ok) return cache.list.length ? cache.list : [];
    const data = await r.json();
    const list = Array.isArray(data) ? data : data?.data || [];
    cache = { at: Date.now(), list };
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('[models] discovery failed:', e.message);
  }
  return cache.list;
}

// Whitelist : les modèles free réellement exposés (découverte) + override manuels
export async function allowedModels() {
  const discovered = await getModels();
  const ids = new Set(discovered.map((m) => m.id));
  if (!FREE_ONLY) return discovered;

  // On retient uniquement ce que Zen expose (les modèles payants non dispo sur le compte
  // ne remontent pas dans /v1/models du compte free, mais on garde un garde-fou suffixe)
  return discovered.filter((m) => {
    const id = m.id || '';
    return ids.has(id) && (id.includes('-free') || id.includes('big-pickle') || id.includes('longcat'));
  });
}

// Réponse /v1/models du proxy : découverte filtrée (+ paramètres)
export async function filteredModels(query = {}) {
  const all = await allowedModels();
  const q = query;
  let out = await applyLimits(all);

  if (q.focus) out = out.filter((m) => m.id === q.focus);
  if (q.type) {
    const types = String(q.type).split(',').filter(Boolean);
    if (types.length) out = out.filter((m) => matchType(m, types));
  }
  if (q.context_min) {
    const min = parseInt(q.context_min, 10);
    out = out.filter((m) => {
      const ctx = m.limit?.context || 0;
      return ctx >= min;
    });
  }
  out.sort((a, b) => (a.id === FOCUS_MODEL ? -1 : 0) - (b.id === FOCUS_MODEL ? -1 : 0));

  return { object: 'list', data: out };
}

function matchType(m, types) {
  // approximations légères depuis /v1/models (pas de métadonnées riches côté Zen)
  const id = (m.id || '').toLowerCase();
  const owned = (m.owned_by || '').toLowerCase();
  const viaEndpoint = owned.includes('gemini') || owned.includes('anthropic') || owned.includes('openai');
  if (types.includes('chat')) return true;
  if (types.includes('reasoning') && owned.includes('reason')) return true;
  if (types.includes('free') && (id.includes('-free') || id.includes('big-pickle') || id.includes('longcat'))) return true;
  return false;
}

export function isAllowed(id) {
  if (!FREE_ONLY) return true;
  return id.includes('-free') || id === FOCUS_MODEL || FALLBACK_MODELS.includes(id) || id === 'big-pickle' || id === 'longcat-2.0-free';
}

export function focusAndFallbacks() {
  return { focus: FOCUS_MODEL, fallbacks: FALLBACK_MODELS };
}

#### 📄 `src/rateLimiter.js`

```javascript
import { configNumber } from './config.js';

// Rate limiter par IP (fenêtres glissantes simples) + compteur de concurrence
const rps = new Map();   // ip -> { startMinute, countMinute, startDay, countDay, concurrent }
const CONCURRENCY_TTL = 10_000; // anti-usage au bout d'une réponse trop lente
const CONCURRENT_TTL = CONCURRENCY_TTL;

export function ipLimiter(req, res, next) {
  const ip = (req.headers['x-forwarded-for'] || '').split(',')[0].trim() || req.socket.remoteAddress || '?';
  const now = Date.now();
  let e = rps.get(ip);
  if (!e) { e = { ws: now, c: 0, wd: now, d: 0, concurrent: 0 }; rps.set(ip, e); }

  // fenêtre minute
  if (now - e.ws > 60_000) { e.ws = now; e.c = 0; }
  // fenêtre jour
  if (now - e.wd > 86_400_000) { e.wd = now; e.d = 0; }

  if (e.c >= configNumber('IP_RATE_LIMIT_RPM', 60)) return retry(res, 60);
  if (e.d >= configNumber('IP_RATE_LIMIT_RPD', 2000)) return retry(res, 3600);
  if (e.concurrent >= configNumber('MAX_CONCURRENT_PER_IP', 4)) return retry(res, 30, 'trop de requêtes simultanées');

  e.c++; e.d++; e.concurrent++;

  req._ip = ip;
  let released = false;
  const release = () => {
    if (released) return;
    released = true;
    const cur = rps.get(ip);
    if (cur) cur.concurrent = Math.max(0, cur.concurrent - 1);
  };
  res.on('finish', release);
  res.on('close', release);
  setTimeout(release, Math.max(CONCURRENT_TTL, configNumber('FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS', 60000) + 5000));

  // nettoyage = un Map glisse, peut grossir lentement, acceptable pour petites volume
  return next();
}

function retry(res, seconds) {
  res.setHeader('Retry-After', String(seconds));
  return res.status(429).json({
    error: { message: `zen-proxy: limite ${seconds}s atteinte pour votre IP`, type: 'rate_limit', code: '[SECRET REDACTED]' },
  });
}

export function getClientIp(req) { return req._ip || req.socket.remoteAddress || '?'; }

import { configNumber } from './config.js';
import { acquireRoute, releaseRoute, recordRouteFailure, recordRouteSuccess, poolRetryHint } from './keyPool.js';
import { getEgresses, fetchViaEgress } from './egress.js';
import { classifyUpstream } from './upstreamError.js';
import { nativeRequest, parseSse, openAiResponse } from './zenNative.js';
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';

const fetchTimeout = () => Math.max(1000, configNumber('FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS', 60000));
const retryBudget = () => Math.max(1000, configNumber('RETRY_TOTAL_BUDGET_MS', 30000));
const maxAttempts = () => Math.max(1, configNumber('MAX_UPSTREAM_ATTEMPTS', 20));
let queued = 0;

// Compatibilité tests/imports existants.
export function classifyError(status, bodyText = '') {
  const kind = classifyUpstream(status, bodyText).kind;
  if (kind === 'free_limit' || kind === 'credits') return 'quota';
  if (kind === 'auth_invalid') return 'auth';
  if (kind === 'server' || kind === 'saturation') return 'server';
  if (kind === 'network') return 'network';
  if (kind === 'rate_limit') return 'rate';
  return null;
}

export async function relay(req, res, path, bodyText) {
  let body = null;
  try { body = bodyText ? JSON.parse(bodyText) : null; } catch { /* erreur relayée par Zen */ }
  const model = String(body?.model || 'unknown');
  const isStream = body?.stream === true;
  const started = Date.now();
  const attempted = new Set();
  const excludedKeyIds = [SECRET REDACTED]
  const egresses = getEgresses();
  const requestId = String(req.headers['x-request-id'] || randomUUID()).slice(0, 80);
  let attempts = 0;
  let lastFailure = null;
  let clientGone = false;

  const onClientClose = () => { clientGone = true; };
  res.on('close', onClientClose);

  while (!clientGone && attempts < maxAttempts() && Date.now() - started < retryBudget()) {
    let route = acquireRoute({ model, egresses, attempted, excludedKeyIds });
    if (!route && attempts === 0) route = await waitForRoute({ model, egresses, attempted, excludedKeyIds, started, clientGone: () => clientGone });
    if (!route) break;
    attempts += 1;
    let held = true;
    const controller = new AbortController();
    const remaining = Math.max(1, retryBudget() - (Date.now() - started));
    const timer = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), Math.min(fetchTimeout(), remaining));
    const attemptStarted = Date.now();

    try {
      const native = nativeRequest(body || {}, requestId);
      const upstreamHeaders = { ...native.headers, 'X-Request-ID': requestId };
      if (route.key.apiKey) upstreamHeaders.Authorization = [SECRET REDACTED]}`;
      const upstream = await fetchViaEgress(route.egress, path, {
        method: req.method,
        headers: upstreamHeaders,
        body: ['POST', 'PUT', 'PATCH'].includes(req.method) ? native.body : undefined,
        signal: controller.signal,
        redirect: 'manual',
      });
      clearTimeout(timer);

      if (!upstream.ok) {
        const errText = await upstream.text();
        const failure = classifyUpstream(upstream.status, errText, upstream.headers);
        lastFailure = { ...failure, text: errText };
        recordRouteFailure(route, model, failure, errText);
        releaseRoute(route); held = false;
        logAttempt({ requestId, route, model, status: upstream.status, kind: failure.kind, durationMs: Date.now() - attemptStarted, cfRay: failure.cfRay });

        if (!failure.retriable) return passUpstreamError(res, upstream, errText);
        if (['free_limit', 'credits', 'auth_invalid', 'rate_limit'].includes(failure.kind)) excludedKeyIds.add(route.key.id);
        continue;
      }

      const contentType = upstream.headers.get('content-type') || '';
      logAttempt({ requestId, route, model, status: upstream.status, kind: 'success', durationMs: Date.now() - attemptStarted, cfRay: upstream.headers.get('cf-ray') || '' });
      if (isStream && contentType.includes('text/event-stream')) {
        pipeSse(res, upstream, route, model);
        held = false; // le pipe détient la réservation jusqu'à sa fermeture
        return;
      }

      const raw = await upstream.text();
      const parsed = contentType.includes('text/event-stream') ? parseSse(raw) : null;
      let responseBody;
      try { responseBody = parsed ? openAiResponse(parsed, model) : JSON.parse(raw); }
      catch { responseBody = { id: `chatcmpl-${requestId}`, object: 'chat.completion', model, choices: [{ index: 0, message: { role: 'assistant', content: raw }, finish_reason: 'stop' }] }; }
      const tokens = [SECRET REDACTED], Math.ceil((parsed?.content.length || 0) / 4));
      recordRouteSuccess(route, model, tokens, 1);
      releaseRoute(route); held = false;
      res.status(upstream.status);
      res.setHeader('Content-Type', 'application/json; charset=utf-8');
      res.json(responseBody);
      return;
    } catch (error) {
      clearTimeout(timer);
      if (clientGone) return;
      const failure = classifyUpstream(0, JSON.stringify({ error: { type: 'NetworkError', message: error.message } }));
      lastFailure = { ...failure, text: error.message };
      recordRouteFailure(route, model, failure, error.message);
      logAttempt({ requestId, route, model, status: 0, kind: failure.kind, durationMs: Date.now() - attemptStarted, cfRay: '' });
    } finally {
      clearTimeout(timer);
      if (held) releaseRoute(route);
    }
  }

  if (clientGone) return;
  const hint = poolRetryHint(model);
  return sendUnavailable(res, lastFailure, attempts, hint, Date.now() - started);
}

async function waitForRoute({ model, egresses, attempted, excludedKeyIds, started, clientGone }) {
  if (queued >= Math.max(0, configNumber('QUEUE_MAX_SIZE', 100))) return null;
  queued += 1;
  try {
    const deadline = Math.min(started + retryBudget(), Date.now() + Math.max(0, configNumber('QUEUE_TIMEOUT_MS', 30000)));
    const poll = Math.max(25, configNumber('QUEUE_POLL_MS', 100));
    while (!clientGone() && Date.now() < deadline) {
      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, poll));
      const route = acquireRoute({ model, egresses, attempted, excludedKeyIds });
      if (route) return route;
    }
    return null;
  } finally { queued = Math.max(0, queued - 1); }
}

function pipeSse(res, upstream, route, model) {
  copyHeaders(res, upstream);
  res.status(200);
  res.setHeader('Content-Type', 'text/event-stream; charset=utf-8');
  res.setHeader('Cache-Control', 'no-cache');
  res.setHeader('Connection', 'keep-alive');
  const decoder = [SECRET REDACTED]
  const reader = upstream.body.getReader();
  let chars = 0;
  let usageTokens = [SECRET REDACTED]
  let pending = '';
  let closed = false;
  let idleTimer = null;

  const finish = () => {
    if (closed) return;
    closed = true;
    if (idleTimer) clearTimeout(idleTimer);
    recordRouteSuccess(route, model, usageTokens || Math.max(1, Math.ceil(chars / 4)), 1);
    releaseRoute(route);
    reader.cancel().catch(() => {});
    try { res.end(); } catch { /* déjà fermé */ }
  };
  const armIdle = () => {
    if (idleTimer) clearTimeout(idleTimer);
    idleTimer = setTimeout(finish, Math.max(1000, configNumber('STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS', 300000)));
  };
  res.on('close', finish);

  (async () => {
    try {
      armIdle();
      while (!closed) {
        const { done, value } = await reader.read();
        if (done) return finish();
        armIdle();
        const chunk = decoder.decode(value, { stream: true });
        chars += chunk.length;
        pending += chunk;
        const lines = pending.split(/\r?\n/); pending = lines.pop() || '';
        for (const line of lines) if (line.startsWith('data: ') && line !== 'data: [DONE]') {
          try { usageTokens = [SECRET REDACTED]} catch {}
        }
        if (!res.writableEnded) res.write(Buffer.from(value));
      }
    } catch { finish(); }
  })();
}

function copyHeaders(res, upstream) {
  upstream.headers.forEach((value, key) => {
    if (!/^(content-encoding|content-length|transfer-encoding|connection|keep-alive)$/i.test(key)) res.setHeader(key, value);
  });
}

function passUpstreamError(res, upstream, text) {
  copyHeaders(res, upstream);
  return res.status(upstream.status).send(text);
}

function sendUnavailable(res, failure, attempts, hint, elapsedMs) {
  const limited = hint.limited || ['free_limit', 'rate_limit', 'saturation', 'credits'].includes(failure?.kind);
  const waitMs = hint.nextFreeMs || failure?.retryAfterMs || 60_000;
  const waitSec = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(waitMs / 1000));
  res.setHeader('Retry-After', String(waitSec));
  return res.status(limited ? 429 : 503).json({
    error: {
      message: `zen-proxy: aucune route disponible après ${attempts} tentative(s) (${Math.round(elapsedMs / 1000)}s) — ${failure?.kind || 'pool occupé'}`,
      type: limited ? 'rate_limit' : 'service_unavailable',
      code: [SECRET REDACTED]'all_routes_limited' : 'no_route_available',
      retry_after: waitSec,
    },
  });
}

function logAttempt({ requestId, route, model, status, kind, durationMs, cfRay }) {
  console.log(JSON.stringify({
    event: 'zen_upstream', requestId, keyId: [SECRET REDACTED], keyName: [SECRET REDACTED],
    model, egress: route.egress.id, status, kind, durationMs, cfRay,
  }));
}

function rawBody(req) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const chunks = [];
    req.on('data', (c) => chunks.push(c));
    req.on('end', () => resolve(Buffer.concat(chunks).toString('utf8')));
    req.on('error', reject);
  });

```javascript
import { readFileSync, writeFileSync, mkdirSync, existsSync, renameSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { DATA_DIR } from './config.js';

mkdirSync(DATA_DIR, { recursive: true });

// Charge ou initialise un fichier JSON de data/ (atomique)
export function load(name, fallback) {
  const p = join(DATA_DIR, `${name}.json`);
  try {
    if (existsSync(p)) return JSON.parse(readFileSync(p, 'utf8'));
  } catch (e) {
    console.error(`[store] read ${name}.json failed:`, e.message);
  }
  return fallback;
}

// Écriture atomique (tmp + rename) pour ne pas corrompre en cas de crash
export function save(name, data) {
  const p = join(DATA_DIR, `${name}.json`);
  const tmp = `${p}.tmp`;
  writeFileSync(tmp, JSON.stringify(data, null, 2));
  renameSync(tmp, p);
  return data;
}

export function safeSave(name, data) {
  const p = join(DATA_DIR, `${name}.json`);
  try {
    writeFileSync(`${p}.tmp`, JSON.stringify(data, null, 2));
    renameSync(`${p}.tmp`, p);
  } catch (e) {
    console.error(`[store] write ${name}.json failed:`, e.message);
  }
}

// Classification structurée des réponses Zen.
// Important : le statut HTTP seul ne décrit pas la portée de la limite.

function parseBody(bodyText = '') {
  try {
    const json = JSON.parse(bodyText);
    const error = json?.error && typeof json.error === 'object' ? json.error : json;
    return {
      json,
      type: String(error?.type || error?.code || ''),
      message: String(error?.message || json?.message || ''),
    };
  } catch {
    return { json: null, type: '', message: String(bodyText || '') };
  }
}

export function parseRetryAfter(value, now = Date.now()) {
  if (!value) return 0;
  const seconds = Number(value);
  if (Number.isFinite(seconds)) return Math.max(0, Math.round(seconds * 1000));
  const date = Date.parse(value);
  return Number.isFinite(date) ? Math.max(0, date - now) : 0;
}

export function classifyUpstream(status, bodyText = '', headers = null) {
  const parsed = parseBody(bodyText);
  const type = parsed.type.toLowerCase();
  const message = parsed.message.toLowerCase();
  const text = `${type} ${message} ${String(bodyText || '').toLowerCase()}`;
  const retryAfterMs = parseRetryAfter(headers?.get?.('retry-after'));

  const base = {
    status,
    upstreamType: parsed.type,
    message: parsed.message,
    retryAfterMs,
    cfRay: headers?.get?.('cf-ray') || '',
    retriable: false,
  };

  if (status >= 200 && status < 300) return { ...base, kind: 'success' };

  // Zen peut renvoyer 401 pour un modèle absent/désactivé : ce n'est pas une clé invalide.
  if (type.includes('modelerror') || /model .*(not supported|unsupported|disabled|not available)/i.test(parsed.message)) {
    return { ...base, kind: 'model_unsupported', retriable: true };
  }

  if (type.includes('freeusagelimiterror') || text.includes('free usage limit') || text.includes('free usage exceeded')) {
    return { ...base, kind: 'free_limit', retriable: true };
  }

  if (type.includes('creditserror') || text.includes('insufficient credits') || text.includes('insufficient_quota')) {
    return { ...base, kind: 'credits', retriable: true };
  }

  if (text.includes('request queue is full') || text.includes('overloaded') || text.includes('capacity')) {
    return { ...base, kind: 'saturation', retriable: true };
  }

  const explicitAuth = [SECRET REDACTED]'authentication') || type.includes('unauthorized') ||
    type.includes('apikey') || /invalid (api )?key|missing (api )?key|unauthorized/i.test(parsed.message);
  if (status === 401 && explicitAuth) return { ...base, kind: 'auth_invalid', retriable: true };

  if (status === 429 || text.includes('too many requests') || text.includes('rate limit')) {
    return { ...base, kind: 'rate_limit', retriable: true };
  }

  if (status >= 500) return { ...base, kind: 'server', retriable: true };
  if (!status) return { ...base, kind: 'network', retriable: true };

  // Un 401 inconnu ne doit jamais condamner définitivement une clé.
  if (status === 401) return { ...base, kind: 'account_or_request', retriable: true };
  return { ...base, kind: 'request', retriable: false };
}

```javascript
import { collectWakeCandidates, wakeFailed, wakeOk } from './keyPool.js';
import { ZEN_BASE_URL } from './config.js';
import { nativeRequest } from './zenNative.js';
import { configNumber } from './config.js';

// ─── Scheduler : probe les clés COLD dont le réveil est passé ──
// Tout les 60s on regarde s'il y a une clé à réveiller. Si oui → la sort temporairement
// du pool actif (toujours exclue car state='cold') et on fait un ping.
let running = false;
let timer = null;

export function startWakeScheduler() {
  if (running) return;
  running = true;
  schedule(5_000);
  console.log('[wake] scheduler démarré (intervalle dynamique)');
}

function schedule(delay = Math.max(10_000, configNumber('COLD_SCHEDULER_INTERVAL_MS', 60000))) {
  if (timer) clearTimeout(timer);
  timer = setTimeout(async () => {
    try { await runOnce(); }
    finally { schedule(); }
  }, delay);
}

async function runOnce() {
  const candidates = collectWakeCandidates();
  for (const k of candidates) {
    const ok = await probe(k);
    if (ok) { console.log(`[wake] ${k.name} réveillée`); wakeOk(k.id); }
    else { console.log(`[wake] ${k.name} toujours bloquée → +backoff`); wakeFailed(k.id); }
  }
}

async function probe(k) {
  try {
    const ctrl = new AbortController();
    const t = setTimeout(() => ctrl.abort(), 15_000);
    const native = nativeRequest({ model: 'deepseek-v4-flash-free', messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Réponds uniquement OK' }] }, `wake-${k.id}`);
    const r = await fetch(`${ZEN_BASE_URL}/chat/completions`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { ...native.headers, Authorization: [SECRET REDACTED]}` },
      body: native.body,
      signal: ctrl.signal,
    });
    clearTimeout(t);
    const body = await r.text();
    if (r.ok) return true;
    const t2 = body.toLowerCase();
    return !(r.status === 429 || t2.includes('freeusagelimiterror') || t2.includes('free usage exceeded') || t2.includes('quota'));
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

```javascript
import { Agent, fetch } from 'undici';

// Les IPv4 datacenter actuelles sont limitées par Zen tandis que l'IPv6 du VPS
// répond. Le lookup forcé évite que Node/undici préfère silencieusement IPv4.
const ipv6Agent = new Agent({ connect: { family: 6 } });
const relayBase = String(process.env.ZEN_IPV6_RELAY_URL || '').replace(/\/$/, '');
const relaySecret = [SECRET REDACTED]'';

export function zenFetch(url, init = {}) {
  const target = new URL(url);
  if (relayBase && relaySecret && target.hostname === 'opencode.ai' && target.pathname.startsWith('/zen/v1/')) {
    const relayUrl = `${relayBase}${target.pathname.slice('/zen/v1'.length)}${target.search}`;
    const headers = new Headers(init.headers || {});
    headers.set('X-Zen-Relay-Secret', relaySecret);
    return fetch(relayUrl, { ...init, headers });
  }
  return fetch(url, { ...init, dispatcher: ipv6Agent });
}

```javascript
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { configNumber } from './config.js';

export function nativeRequest(body = {}, requestId = randomUUID()) {
  return {
    body: JSON.stringify({
      ...body,
      max_tokens: [SECRET REDACTED]'ZEN_NATIVE_MAX_TOKENS', 32000),
      stream: true,
      stream_options: { include_usage: true },
    }),
    headers: {
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      'User-Agent': 'opencode/1.18.16 ai-sdk/provider-utils/4.0.23 runtime/node',
      'X-OpenCode-Client': 'cli',
      'X-OpenCode-Project': 'zen-proxy',
      'X-OpenCode-Request': requestId,
      'X-OpenCode-Session': requestId,
    },
  };
}

export function parseSse(text) {
  let content = '';
  let reasoning = '';
  let usage = null;
  let id = '';
  let model = '';
  let finishReason = 'stop';
  const toolCalls = [];
  for (const line of text.split(/\r?\n/)) {
    if (!line.startsWith('data: ') || line === 'data: [DONE]') continue;
    try {
      const event = JSON.parse(line.slice(6));
      id ||= event.id || '';
      model ||= event.model || '';
      const choice = event.choices?.[0];
      content += choice?.delta?.content || '';
      reasoning += choice?.delta?.reasoning_content || '';
      for (const call of choice?.delta?.tool_calls || []) {
        const index = Number(call.index || 0);
        const current = toolCalls[index] ||= { id: '', type: 'function', function: { name: '', arguments: '' } };
        current.id ||= call.id || '';
        current.type = call.type || current.type;
        current.function.name += call.function?.name || '';
        current.function.arguments += call.function?.arguments || '';
      }
      finishReason = choice?.finish_reason || finishReason;
      usage = event.usage || usage;
    } catch {}
  }
  return { id, model, content, reasoning, finishReason, usage, toolCalls: toolCalls.filter(Boolean) };
}

export function openAiResponse(parsed, fallbackModel) {
  const message = { role: 'assistant', content: parsed.content };
  if (parsed.reasoning) message.reasoning_content = parsed.reasoning;
  if (parsed.toolCalls?.length) message.tool_calls = parsed.toolCalls;
  return {
    id: parsed.id || `chatcmpl-${randomUUID()}`,
    object: 'chat.completion',
    created: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000),
    model: parsed.model || fallbackModel,
    choices: [{ index: 0, message, finish_reason: parsed.finishReason }],
    usage: parsed.usage || undefined,
  };
}

  const emitter = new EventEmitter();
  return Object.assign(emitter, {
    headers: {}, statusCode: [SECRET REDACTED], body: '', writableEnded: false,
    setHeader(key, value) { this.headers[String(key).toLowerCase()] = String(value); },
    status(code) { this.statusCode = [SECRET REDACTED]},
    json(value) { this.body = JSON.stringify(value); this.writableEnded = true; emitter.emit('finish'); return this; },
    send(value) { this.body = String(value); this.writableEnded = true; emitter.emit('finish'); return this; },
    end(value = '') { this.body += value; this.writableEnded = true; emitter.emit('finish'); return this; },
    write(value) { this.body += String(value); return true; },
  });
}

```

#### 📄 `test/upstreamError.test.js`

```javascript
import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { classifyUpstream, parseRetryAfter } from '../src/upstreamError.js';

test('FreeUsageLimitError reste une limite ambiguë', () => {
  const result = classifyUpstream(429, JSON.stringify({
    type: 'error', error: { type: 'FreeUsageLimitError', message: 'Rate limit exceeded. Please try again later.' },
  }));
  assert.equal(result.kind, 'free_limit');
  assert.equal(result.retriable, true);
});

test('401 ModelError ne condamne pas la clé', () => {
  const result = classifyUpstream(401, JSON.stringify({
    error: { type: 'ModelError', message: 'Model ling-3.0-flash-free is not supported' },
  }));
  assert.equal(result.kind, 'model_unsupported');
});

test('seule une erreur auth explicite invalide la clé', () => {
  assert.equal(classifyUpstream(401, JSON.stringify({ error: { type: 'AuthenticationError', message: 'Invalid API key' } })).kind, 'auth_invalid');
  assert.equal(classifyUpstream(401, JSON.stringify({ error: { type: 'UnknownError', message: 'Denied' } })).kind, 'account_or_request');
});

test('Retry-After accepte secondes et date HTTP', () => {
  assert.equal(parseRetryAfter('12'), 12_000);
  assert.equal(parseRetryAfter(new Date(20_000).toUTCString(), 10_000), 10_000);
});

  <script>
    async function load() {
      const r = await fetch('/admin/api/config');
      if (r.status === 401) { document.getElementById('save-result').textContent = 'Session expirée.'; return; }
      const d = await r.json();
      document.getElementById('rotationMode').value = d.rotationMode || 'round_robin';
      const run = d.runtime || {};
      for (const key of ['FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS','RETRY_BACKOFF_MS','RETRY_TOTAL_BUDGET_MS','MAX_UPSTREAM_ATTEMPTS','KEY_MAX_CONCURRENCY','KEY_RATE_LIMIT_RPM','KEY_RATE_LIMIT_TPM','QUEUE_MAX_SIZE','QUEUE_TIMEOUT_MS','QUEUE_POLL_MS','ZEN_NATIVE_MAX_TOKENS','STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS','COOLDOWN_SECONDS','QUOTA_PAUSE_MS','QUOTA_COLD_THRESHOLD','FREE_LIMIT_RETRY_MS','FREE_LIMIT_MAX_BACKOFF_MS','QUOTA_CONFIRM_EGRESS_COUNT','QUOTA_RECHECK_MS','EGRESS_CIRCUIT_THRESHOLD','EGRESS_CIRCUIT_WINDOW_MS','EGRESS_CIRCUIT_MS','COLD_WAKE_BACKOFF_HOURS','COLD_WAKE_MAX_BACKOFF_HOURS','COLD_PROBE_INTERVAL_HOURS','COLD_PROBE_MAX_INTERVAL_HOURS','COLD_SCHEDULER_INTERVAL_MS','ZEN_PRIMARY_RELAY_ENABLED','ZEN_PRIMARY_RELAY_URL','ZEN_DIRECT_ENABLED','ZEN_DIRECT_MAX_CONCURRENCY','ZEN_RELAY_MAX_CONCURRENCY','ZEN_EGRESS_RELAY_URLS','ANONYMOUS_ENABLED','FOCUS_MODEL','MODEL_CACHE_TTL','FREE_ONLY','IP_RATE_LIMIT_RPM','IP_RATE_LIMIT_RPD','MAX_CONCURRENT_PER_IP']) {
        const el = document.getElementById(key);
        if (el) el.value = run[key] !== undefined ? run[key] : (d.defaults[key] !== undefined ? d.defaults[key] : '');
      }
    }
    async function save() {
      const out = document.getElementById('save-result');
      out.textContent = '⏳ enregistrement…';
      out.className = '';
      const ids = ['FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS','RETRY_BACKOFF_MS','RETRY_TOTAL_BUDGET_MS','MAX_UPSTREAM_ATTEMPTS','KEY_MAX_CONCURRENCY','KEY_RATE_LIMIT_RPM','KEY_RATE_LIMIT_TPM','QUEUE_MAX_SIZE','QUEUE_TIMEOUT_MS','QUEUE_POLL_MS','ZEN_NATIVE_MAX_TOKENS','STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS','COOLDOWN_SECONDS','QUOTA_PAUSE_MS','QUOTA_COLD_THRESHOLD','FREE_LIMIT_RETRY_MS','FREE_LIMIT_MAX_BACKOFF_MS','QUOTA_CONFIRM_EGRESS_COUNT','QUOTA_RECHECK_MS','EGRESS_CIRCUIT_THRESHOLD','EGRESS_CIRCUIT_WINDOW_MS','EGRESS_CIRCUIT_MS','COLD_WAKE_BACKOFF_HOURS','COLD_WAKE_MAX_BACKOFF_HOURS','COLD_PROBE_INTERVAL_HOURS','COLD_PROBE_MAX_INTERVAL_HOURS','COLD_SCHEDULER_INTERVAL_MS','ZEN_PRIMARY_RELAY_ENABLED','ZEN_PRIMARY_RELAY_URL','ZEN_DIRECT_ENABLED','ZEN_DIRECT_MAX_CONCURRENCY','ZEN_RELAY_MAX_CONCURRENCY','ZEN_EGRESS_RELAY_URLS','ANONYMOUS_ENABLED','FOCUS_MODEL','MODEL_CACHE_TTL','FREE_ONLY','IP_RATE_LIMIT_RPM','IP_RATE_LIMIT_RPD','MAX_CONCURRENT_PER_IP'];
      const runtime = {};
      for (const id of ids) {
        const v = document.getElementById(id).value;
        runtime[id] = ['FREE_ONLY','ZEN_PRIMARY_RELAY_ENABLED','ZEN_DIRECT_ENABLED','ANONYMOUS_ENABLED'].includes(id) ? (v === 'true') : v;
      }
      const body = { runtime, rotationMode: document.getElementById('rotationMode').value };
      const r = await fetch('/admin/api/config', {
        method: 'PATCH',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify(body),
      });
      const d = await r.json();
      if (r.ok && d.ok) { out.textContent = '✅ configuration appliquée à chaud'; out.className = 'ok'; }
      else { out.textContent = '❌ ' + (d.error || 'échec'); out.className = 'err'; }
    }
    setTimeout(load, 200);
  </script>
</body>
