var simpleCharsetRegExp = /^\s*([^\s;]+)\s*(?:;(.*))?$/;

/**
 * Parse the Accept-Charset header.
 * @private
 */

function parseAcceptCharset(accept) {
  var accepts = accept.split(',');

  for (var i = 0, j = 0; i < accepts.length; i++) {
    var charset = parseCharset(accepts[i].trim(), i);

    if (charset) {
      accepts[j++] = charset;
    }
  }

  // trim accepts
  accepts.length = j;

  return accepts;
}

/**
 * Parse a charset from the Accept-Charset header.
 * @private
 */

function parseCharset(str, i) {
  var match = simpleCharsetRegExp.exec(str);
  if (!match) return null;

  var charset = match[1];
  var q = 1;
  if (match[2]) {
    var params = match[2].split(';')
    for (var j = 0; j < params.length; j++) {
      var p = params[j].trim().split('=');
      if (p[0] === 'q') {
        q = parseFloat(p[1]);
        break;
      }
    }
  }

  return {
    charset: charset,
    q: q,
    i: i
  };
}

/**
 * Get the priority of a charset.
 * @private
 */

function getCharsetPriority(charset, accepted, index) {
  var priority = {o: -1, q: 0, s: 0};

  for (var i = 0; i < accepted.length; i++) {
    var spec = specify(charset, accepted[i], index);

    if (spec && (priority.s - spec.s || priority.q - spec.q || priority.o - spec.o) < 0) {
      priority = spec;
    }
  }

  return priority;
}

/**
 * Get the specificity of the charset.
 * @private
 */

function specify(charset, spec, index) {
  var s = 0;
  if(spec.charset.toLowerCase() === charset.toLowerCase()){
    s |= 1;
  } else if (spec.charset !== '*' ) {
    return null
  }

  return {
    i: index,
    o: spec.i,
    q: spec.q,
    s: s
  }
}

/**
 * Get the preferred charsets from an Accept-Charset header.
 * @public
 */

function preferredCharsets(accept, provided) {
  // RFC 2616 sec 14.2: no header = *
  var accepts = parseAcceptCharset(accept === undefined ? '*' : accept || '');

  if (!provided) {
    // sorted list of all charsets
    return accepts
      .filter(isQuality)
      .sort(compareSpecs)
      .map(getFullCharset);
  }

  var priorities = provided.map(function getPriority(type, index) {
    return getCharsetPriority(type, accepts, index);
  });

  // sorted list of accepted charsets
  return priorities.filter(isQuality).sort(compareSpecs).map(function getCharset(priority) {
    return provided[priorities.indexOf(priority)];
  });
}

/**
 * Compare two specs.
 * @private
 */

function compareSpecs(a, b) {
  return (b.q - a.q) || (b.s - a.s) || (a.o - b.o) || (a.i - b.i) || 0;
}

/**
 * Get full charset string.
 * @private
 */

function getFullCharset(spec) {
  return spec.charset;
}

/**
 * Check if a spec has any quality.
 * @private
 */

function isQuality(spec) {
  return spec.q > 0;
}

```text
import * as https from 'https';
import { loadConfig } from './config.js';

// === INTERFACES ===

import { DetailedUsageEntry } from './pollinations-api.js';

interface BalanceResponse {
    total?: number;       // PR #12449 (new format)
    allowance?: number;   // PR #12449 — hourly refill (0.01/0.15/0.4/0.8/10)
    pack?: number;        // PR #12449 — paid pollen
    balance?: number;     // legacy format (single combined number)
    currency?: string;
}

interface ResetInfo {
    nextReset: Date;
    lastReset: Date;
    timeUntilReset: number;
    timeSinceReset: number;
    resetHour: number;
    resetMinute: number;
    resetSecond: number;
    progressPercent: number;
}

export interface QuotaStatus {
    tierRemaining: number;
    tierUsed: number;
    tierLimit: number;       // hourly refill (deduced or native allowance)
    questStash: number;      // accumulated quest pollen (claimed - consumed)
    walletBalance: number;

    nextResetAt: Date;
    timeUntilReset: number;

    canUseEnterprise: boolean;
    isUsingWallet: boolean;
    needsAlert: boolean;

    tier: string;
    tierEmoji: string;
    errorType?: 'auth_limited' | 'network' | 'unknown';
}

// === CACHE & CONSTANTS ===

const CACHE_TTL = 30000;
let cachedQuota: QuotaStatus | null = null;
let lastQuotaFetch: number = 0;

const STASH_CACHE_TTL = 5 * 60 * 1000; // 5 min — le stash Quest change rarement
let cachedStash: { questStash: number; claimedQuestTier: number; tierConsumedSinceClaim: number } | null = null;
let lastStashFetch: number = 0;

const ONE_HOUR_MS = 60 * 60 * 1000;

const KNOWN_REFILLS = [
    { pollen: 0,    emoji: '👤', label: 'anonymous' },
    { pollen: 0.01, emoji: '🍄', label: 'spore' },
    { pollen: 0.15, emoji: '🌱', label: 'seed' },
    { pollen: 0.4,  emoji: '🌸', label: 'flower' },
    { pollen: 0.8,  emoji: '🍯', label: 'nectar' },
    { pollen: 10,   emoji: '🐝', label: 'router' },
];

// === LOGGING ===
import { logApi } from './logger.js';
function logQuota(msg: string) {
    logApi(`[QUOTA] ${msg}`);
}

// === SMART FETCH API (cursor-based) ===

export async function fetchUsageForPeriod(apiKey: string, lastReset: Date): Promise<DetailedUsageEntry[]> {
    let allUsage: DetailedUsageEntry[] = [];
    const limit = 100;
    let cursorEventId: string | null = null;

    while (true) {
        let queryPath = `/account/usage?limit=${limit}`;
        if (cursorEventId) {
            queryPath += `&before_event_id=${encodeURIComponent(cursorEventId)}`;
        }

        let usageRes;
        try {
            usageRes = await fetchAPI<{ usage: DetailedUsageEntry[]; count: number }>(queryPath, apiKey);
        } catch (e) {
            logQuota(`SmartFetch failed: ${e}`);
            break;
        }

        if (!usageRes.usage || usageRes.usage.length === 0) {
            break;
        }

        let reachedCutoff = false;
        for (const entry of usageRes.usage) {
            const timestampStr = entry.timestamp.includes('Z')
                ? entry.timestamp
                : entry.timestamp.replace(' ', 'T') + 'Z';
            const entryTime = new Date(timestampStr);
            if (entryTime < lastReset) {
                reachedCutoff = true;
                break;
            }
            allUsage.push(entry);
        }

        if (reachedCutoff || usageRes.usage.length < limit) {
            break;
        }

        const lastEntry = usageRes.usage[usageRes.usage.length - 1];
        cursorEventId = (lastEntry as any).cursor_event_id || null;
        if (!cursorEventId) break;
    }

    logQuota(`SmartFetch: Retrieved ${allUsage.length} transactions for current period.`);
    return allUsage;
}

// === ALLOWANCE DEDUCTION ===

async function fetchUsageForAllowance(apiKey: string): Promise<DetailedUsageEntry[]> {
    const sevenDaysAgo = new Date(Date.now() - 7 * 24 * ONE_HOUR_MS);
    const allUsage: DetailedUsageEntry[] = [];
    let cursorEventId: string | null = null;
    let pageCount = 0;
    const maxPages = 20;

    while (pageCount < maxPages) {
        let path = `/account/usage?days=7&limit=500`;
        if (cursorEventId) {
            path += `&before_event_id=${encodeURIComponent(cursorEventId)}`;
        }

        const res = await fetchAPI<{ usage: DetailedUsageEntry[]; count: number }>(path, apiKey);

        if (!res.usage || res.usage.length === 0) break;

        let reachedCutoff = false;
        for (const entry of res.usage) {
            const ts = (entry.timestamp.includes('Z') ? entry.timestamp : entry.timestamp.replace(' ', 'T') + 'Z');
            if (new Date(ts) < sevenDaysAgo) { reachedCutoff = true; break; }
            allUsage.push(entry);
        }

        if (reachedCutoff || res.usage.length < 500) break;

        const last = res.usage[res.usage.length - 1] as any;
        cursorEventId = last?.cursor_event_id || null;
        if (!cursorEventId) break;
        pageCount++;
    }

    logQuota(`deduceAllowance: fetched ${allUsage.length} records over ${pageCount + 1} pages`);
    return allUsage;
}

async function deduceAllowanceFromApi(apiKey: string): Promise<number> {
    try {
        const allUsage = await fetchUsageForAllowance(apiKey);
        if (allUsage.length === 0) return 0;

        const sevenDaysAgo = new Date(Date.now() - 7 * 24 * ONE_HOUR_MS);
        const hourlyBuckets = new Map<number, number>();

        for (const entry of allUsage) {
            if (entry.meter_source !== 'tier') continue;
            const ts = entry.timestamp.includes('Z') ? entry.timestamp : entry.timestamp.replace(' ', 'T') + 'Z';
            const entryTime = new Date(ts);
            if (entryTime < sevenDaysAgo) continue;

            const hourKey = entryTime.getUTCFullYear() * 1000000
                + entryTime.getUTCMonth() * 10000
                + entryTime.getUTCDate() * 100
                + entryTime.getUTCHours();
            hourlyBuckets.set(hourKey, (hourlyBuckets.get(hourKey) || 0) + entry.cost_usd);
        }

        const maxHourlyTier = Math.max(0, ...hourlyBuckets.values());
        const match = KNOWN_REFILLS.slice().reverse().find(r => r.pollen <= maxHourlyTier + 0.02);

        logQuota(`deduceAllowance: ${allUsage.length} records, ${hourlyBuckets.size} hourly buckets, max=${maxHourlyTier.toFixed(4)}, deduced=${match?.pollen ?? 0} (${match?.label})`);
        return match ? match.pollen : 0;
    } catch (e) {
        logQuota(`deduceAllowance failed: ${e}`);
        return 0;
    }
}

function deduceAllowanceFromUsage(usage: DetailedUsageEntry[]): number {
    const tierCosts = usage
        .filter(u => u.meter_source === 'tier')
        .map(u => u.cost_usd);
    const maxHourlyTier = Math.max(0, ...tierCosts);
    const match = KNOWN_REFILLS.slice().reverse().find(r => r.pollen <= maxHourlyTier + 0.02);
    return match ? match.pollen : 0;
}

/** Map hourly refill amount → display meta (exported for unit tests). */
export function tierMetaForAllowance(allowance: number): { label: string; emoji: string } {
    const match = KNOWN_REFILLS.find(r => r.pollen === allowance)
        || KNOWN_REFILLS.findLast(r => r.pollen <= allowance);
    return match
        ? { label: match.label, emoji: match.emoji }
        : { label: 'unknown', emoji: '❓' };
}

/** Known hourly refill ladder (read-only, for tests / UI). */
export function getKnownRefills(): ReadonlyArray<{ pollen: number; emoji: string; label: string }> {
    return KNOWN_REFILLS;
}

// === MAIN QUOTA FUNCTION ===

export async function getQuotaStatus(forceRefresh = false): Promise<QuotaStatus> {
    const config = loadConfig();

    if (!config.apiKey) {
        return createDefaultQuota('none', 0);
    }

    const now = Date.now();
    if (!forceRefresh && cachedQuota && (now - lastQuotaFetch) < CACHE_TTL) {
        return cachedQuota;
    }

    try {
        logQuota("Fetching Quota Data...");

        const balanceRes = await fetchAPI<BalanceResponse>('/account/balance', config.apiKey);

        const resetInfo = calculateResetInfo();
        const periodUsage = await fetchUsageForPeriod(config.apiKey, resetInfo.lastReset);

        const allowance = balanceRes.allowance
            ?? (config as any).refillOverride
            ?? await deduceAllowanceFromApi(config.apiKey);

        const tierMeta = tierMetaForAllowance(allowance);
        const tierLimit = allowance;

        const { tierUsed } = calculateCurrentPeriodUsage(periodUsage, resetInfo);
        const tierRemaining = Math.max(0, tierLimit - tierUsed);
        const cleanTierRemaining = Math.max(0, parseFloat(tierRemaining.toFixed(4)));

        const totalBalance = balanceRes.total
            ?? balanceRes.balance
            ?? 0;

        // Fetch quest stash BEFORE paidPollen calculation (cached 5 min)
        const nowStash = Date.now();
        if (!cachedStash || (nowStash - lastStashFetch) > STASH_CACHE_TTL) {
            try {
                cachedStash = await fetchQuestStash(config.apiKey!);
                lastStashFetch = nowStash;
            } catch { /* keep previous */ }
        }
        const questStash = cachedStash?.questStash ?? 0;

        const paidPollenNative = balanceRes.pack;
        const paidPollen = paidPollenNative !== undefined
            ? paidPollenNative
            : Math.max(0, totalBalance - cleanTierRemaining - questStash);

        const cleanWalletBalance = Math.max(0, parseFloat(paidPollen.toFixed(4)));

        const tierAlertPercent = tierLimit > 0 ? (cleanTierRemaining / tierLimit * 100) : 0;
        const tierNeedsAlert = tierLimit > 0 && tierAlertPercent <= config.thresholds.tier;
        const walletNeedsAlert = cleanWalletBalance > 0 && cleanWalletBalance < (config.thresholds.wallet || 0.5);

        logQuota(`Fetch Success. Allowance: ${allowance}, Stash: ${questStash}, Paid: ${cleanWalletBalance}, Total: ${totalBalance}`);

        cachedQuota = {
            tierRemaining: cleanTierRemaining,
            tierUsed,
            tierLimit,
            questStash,
            walletBalance: cleanWalletBalance,
            nextResetAt: resetInfo.nextReset,
            timeUntilReset: resetInfo.timeUntilReset,
            canUseEnterprise: cleanTierRemaining > 0.05 || cleanWalletBalance > 0.05,
            isUsingWallet: cleanTierRemaining <= 0.05 && cleanWalletBalance > 0.05,
            needsAlert: tierNeedsAlert || walletNeedsAlert,
            tier: tierMeta.label,
            tierEmoji: tierMeta.emoji
        };

        lastQuotaFetch = now;
        return cachedQuota;

    } catch (e: any) {
        logQuota(`ERROR fetching quota: ${e.message}`);

        let errorType: 'auth_limited' | 'network' | 'unknown' = 'unknown';
        if (e.message && e.message.includes('403')) errorType = 'auth_limited';
        else if (e.message && e.message.includes('Network Error')) errorType = 'network';

        return cachedQuota || { ...createDefaultQuota('error', 1), errorType };
    }
}

function createDefaultQuota(tierName: string, limit: number): QuotaStatus {
    const meta = tierMetaForAllowance(limit);
    return {
        tierRemaining: 0,
        tierUsed: 0,
        tierLimit: limit,
        questStash: 0,
        walletBalance: 0,
        nextResetAt: new Date(),
        timeUntilReset: 0,
        canUseEnterprise: false,
        isUsingWallet: false,
        needsAlert: false,
        tier: tierName !== 'none' ? meta.label : 'none',
        tierEmoji: meta.emoji
    };
}

// === HELPERS ===

function fetchAPI<T>(endpoint: string, apiKey: string): Promise<T> {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        const options = {
            hostname: 'gen.pollinations.ai',
            port: 443,
            path: endpoint,
            method: 'GET',
            headers: {
                'Authorization': `Bearer ${apiKey}`,
                'User-Agent': 'opencode-pollinations-plugin/6.4.1'
            }
        };

        const req = https.request(options, (res) => {
            let data = '';
            res.on('data', (chunk) => data += chunk);
            res.on('end', () => {
                if (res.statusCode && res.statusCode >= 400) {
                    reject(new Error(`API Error ${res.statusCode}: ${data}`));
                    return;
                }
                try {
                    const parsed = JSON.parse(data);
                    resolve(parsed);
                } catch (e: any) {
                    reject(new Error(`JSON Parse Error: ${e.message}`));
                }
            });
        });

        req.on('error', (e) => {
            reject(new Error(`Network Error: ${e.message}`));
        });

        req.end();
    });
}

/** Next top-of-hour UTC reset window (exported for unit tests). */
export function calculateResetInfo(): ResetInfo {
    const now = new Date();
    const nextReset = new Date(Date.UTC(
        now.getUTCFullYear(),
        now.getUTCMonth(),
        now.getUTCDate(),
        now.getUTCHours() + 1,
        0, 0, 0
    ));
    const lastReset = new Date(nextReset.getTime() - ONE_HOUR_MS);

    const timeUntilReset = Math.max(0, nextReset.getTime() - now.getTime());
    const timeSinceReset = Math.max(0, now.getTime() - lastReset.getTime());
    const progressPercent = Math.min(100, (timeSinceReset / ONE_HOUR_MS) * 100);

    return {
        nextReset,
        lastReset,
        timeUntilReset,
        timeSinceReset,
        resetHour: nextReset.getUTCHours(),
        resetMinute: 0,
        resetSecond: 0,
        progressPercent
    };
}

function calculateCurrentPeriodUsage(
    usage: DetailedUsageEntry[],
    resetInfo: ResetInfo
): { tierUsed: number; packUsed: number } {
    let tierUsed = 0;
    let packUsed = 0;

    const entriesAfterReset = usage.filter(entry => {
        const timestamp = entry.timestamp.replace(' ', 'T') + 'Z';
        const entryTime = new Date(timestamp);
        return entryTime >= resetInfo.lastReset;
    });

    for (const entry of entriesAfterReset) {
        if (entry.meter_source === 'tier') {
            tierUsed += entry.cost_usd;
        } else if (entry.meter_source === 'pack') {
            packUsed += entry.cost_usd;
        }
    }

    return { tierUsed, packUsed };
}

export function formatQuotaForToast(quota: QuotaStatus): string {
    if (quota.errorType === 'auth_limited') {
        return `🔑 CLE LIMITÉE (Génération Seule) | 💎 Wallet: N/A | ⏰ Reset: N/A`;
    }

    const tierPercent = quota.tierLimit > 0
        ? Math.round((quota.tierRemaining / quota.tierLimit) * 100)
        : 0;

    const ms = quota.timeUntilReset;
    const hours = Math.floor(ms / (1000 * 60 * 60));
    const minutes = Math.floor((ms % (1000 * 60 * 60)) / (1000 * 60));
    const resetIn = `${hours}h${minutes}m`;

    const stashStr = quota.questStash > 0
        ? ` | 🎁 ~${quota.questStash.toFixed(2)} (stash)`
        : '';

    return `${quota.tierEmoji} ${quota.tierRemaining.toFixed(2)}/${quota.tierLimit} (${tierPercent}%)${stashStr} | 💎 $${quota.walletBalance.toFixed(2)} | ⏰ ${resetIn}`;
}

export async function fetchQuestStash(apiKey: string): Promise<{ questStash: number; claimedQuestTier: number; tierConsumedSinceClaim: number }> {
    let claimedQuestTier = 0;
    let firstClaimMs = Infinity;
    let tierConsumedSinceClaim = 0;

    try {
        const qres = await fetchAPI<{ quests: Array<{ reward?: { pollenAmount: number; claimedAt: string | null; balanceBucket: string } | null }> }>('/account/quests', apiKey);
        for (const q of (qres?.quests || [])) {
            const r = q.reward;
            if (r && r.claimedAt && r.balanceBucket === 'tier') {
                claimedQuestTier += (r.pollenAmount || 0);
                const cms = new Date(r.claimedAt).getTime();
                if (!isNaN(cms) && cms < firstClaimMs) firstClaimMs = cms;
            }
        }

        if (claimedQuestTier > 0 && isFinite(firstClaimMs)) {
            const ures = await fetchAPI<{ usage: DetailedUsageEntry[] }>('/account/usage?limit=500', apiKey);
            for (const e of (ures?.usage || [])) {
                const ts = new Date(String(e.timestamp).replace(' ', 'T') + (String(e.timestamp).includes('Z') ? '' : 'Z')).getTime();
                if (e.meter_source === 'tier' && !isNaN(ts) && ts >= firstClaimMs) {
                    tierConsumedSinceClaim += (e.cost_usd || 0);
                }
            }
        }
    } catch { /* fallback gracefully */ }

    const questStash = Math.max(0, claimedQuestTier - tierConsumedSinceClaim);
    return { questStash, claimedQuestTier, tierConsumedSinceClaim };
}
```

'use strict'
const EventEmitter = require('node:events')

class Dispatcher extends EventEmitter {
  dispatch () {
    throw new Error('not implemented')
  }

  close () {
    throw new Error('not implemented')
  }

  destroy () {
    throw new Error('not implemented')
  }

  compose (...args) {
    // So we handle [interceptor1, interceptor2] or interceptor1, interceptor2, ...
    const interceptors = Array.isArray(args[0]) ? args[0] : args
    let dispatch = this.dispatch.bind(this)

    for (const interceptor of interceptors) {
      if (interceptor == null) {
        continue
      }

      if (typeof interceptor !== 'function') {
        throw new TypeError(`invalid interceptor, expected function received ${typeof interceptor}`)
      }

      dispatch = interceptor(dispatch)

      if (dispatch == null || typeof dispatch !== 'function' || dispatch.length !== 2) {
        throw new TypeError('invalid interceptor')
      }
    }

    return new ComposedDispatcher(this, dispatch)
  }
}

class ComposedDispatcher extends Dispatcher {
  #dispatcher = null
  #dispatch = null

  constructor (dispatcher, dispatch) {
    super()
    this.#dispatcher = dispatcher
    this.#dispatch = dispatch
  }

  dispatch (...args) {
    this.#dispatch(...args)
  }

  close (...args) {
    return this.#dispatcher.close(...args)
  }

  destroy (...args) {
    return this.#dispatcher.destroy(...args)
  }
}

module.exports = Dispatcher

```text
# Contributing to OpenCode Pollinations Plugin

Thank you for your interest in contributing! 🌸

## 🚀 Quick Start

### Prerequisites
- Node.js 18+
- npm or yarn
- Git

### Setup
```bash
# Clone the repository
git clone https://github.com/fkom13/opencode-pollinations-plugin.git
cd opencode-pollinations-plugin

# Install dependencies
npm install

# Build the project
npm run build

# Run tests
npm test
```

## 📁 Project Structure

```
opencode-pollinations-plugin/
├── src/                    # TypeScript source files
│   ├── index.ts           # Plugin entry point
│   └── server/            # Core logic
│       ├── proxy.ts       # Request routing & Safety Net
│       ├── commands.ts    # CLI commands (/pollinations)
│       ├── config.ts      # Configuration management
│       ├── quota.ts       # Usage tracking
│       └── generate-config.ts  # Model discovery
├── dist/                   # Compiled JavaScript (generated)
├── scripts/               # Development & testing scripts
│   ├── test-suite.cjs    # Main test suite (npm test)
│   ├── dev.sh            # Development launcher
│   └── run-standalone.js # Test without OpenCode
├── bin/                   # Installation scripts
├── docs/                  # Technical documentation
└── _archs/               # Archived/legacy code
```

## 🧪 Testing

### Run the test suite
```bash
npm test
```

The test suite validates:
- ✅ Package configuration
- ✅ Build output integrity
- ✅ Configuration module
- ✅ Model discovery API
- ✅ Proxy module exports
- ✅ Commands handling

### Manual testing
```bash
# Start a standalone proxy for debugging
node scripts/run-standalone.js

# Run validation scripts
./scripts/final-validation.sh
```

## 📝 Code Guidelines

### TypeScript
- Use strict typing
- Export functions and types explicitly
- Document complex logic with comments

### Commit Messages
Follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/):
```
feat: add new feature
fix: resolve bug
docs: update documentation
chore: maintenance tasks
refactor: code restructuring
test: add/update tests
```

### Pull Request Process
1. Fork the repository
2. Create a feature branch: `git checkout -b feat/my-feature`
3. Make your changes
4. Run tests: `npm test`
5. Commit with descriptive message
6. Push and create a Pull Request

## 🏗️ Architecture Overview

### Safety Net System
The plugin never blocks users. If an API call fails due to quota/auth issues:
1. Automatically falls back to free models
2. Notifies the user transparently
3. Continues the workflow

### Mode System
- **manual**: User controls model selection
- **alwaysfree**: Only free models
- **pro**: Enterprise models with fallback

### Configuration Hierarchy
Priority (highest to lowest):
1. `~/.pollinations/config.json`
2. `~/.local/share/opencode/auth.json`
3. `~/.config/opencode/opencode.json`

## 🐛 Reporting Issues

Please use [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/fkom13/opencode-pollinations-plugin/issues) with:
- Clear description

### 📄 `data/infra_snapshots/objects/e9/4cef705d2c8901b3b67b77b200e2c6ec7cb5a8893e6338f74f8c8f087fc7c0`

```text
# basic-auth

[![NPM Version][npm-image]][npm-url]
[![NPM Downloads][downloads-image]][downloads-url]
[![Node.js Version][node-version-image]][node-version-url]
[![Build Status][travis-image]][travis-url]
[![Test Coverage][coveralls-image]][coveralls-url]

Generic basic auth Authorization header field parser for whatever.

## Installation

This is a [Node.js](https://nodejs.org/en/) module available through the
[npm registry](https://www.npmjs.com/). Installation is done using the
[`npm install` command](https://docs.npmjs.com/getting-started/installing-npm-packages-locally):

```
$ npm install basic-auth
```

## API

<!-- eslint-disable no-unused-vars -->

```js
var auth = require('basic-auth')
```

### auth(req)

Get the basic auth credentials from the given request. The `Authorization`
header is parsed and if the header is invalid, `undefined` is returned,
otherwise an object with `name` and `pass` properties.

### auth.parse(string)

Parse a basic auth authorization header string. This will return an object
with `name` and `pass` properties, or `undefined` if the string is invalid.

## Example

Pass a Node.js request object to the module export. If parsing fails
`undefined` is returned, otherwise an object with `.name` and `.pass`.

<!-- eslint-disable no-unused-vars, no-undef -->

```js
var auth = require('basic-auth')
var user = auth(req)
// => { name: 'something', pass: 'whatever' }
```

A header string from any other location can also be parsed with
`auth.parse`, for example a `Proxy-Authorization` header:

<!-- eslint-disable no-unused-vars, no-undef -->

```js
var auth = require('basic-auth')
var user = auth.parse(req.getHeader('Proxy-Authorization'))
```

### With vanilla node.js http server

```js
var http = require('http')
var auth = require('basic-auth')
var compare = require('tsscmp')

// Create server
var server = http.createServer(function (req, res) {
  var credentials = auth(req)

  // Check credentials
  // The "check" function will typically be against your user store
  if (!credentials || !check(credentials.name, credentials.pass)) {
    res.statusCode = 401
    res.setHeader('WWW-Authenticate', 'Basic realm="example"')
    res.end('Access denied')
  } else {
    res.end('Access granted')
  }
})

// Basic function to validate credentials for example
function check (name, pass) {
  var valid = true

  // Simple method to prevent short-circut and use timing-safe compare
  valid = compare(name, 'john') && valid
  valid = compare(pass, 'secret') && valid

  return valid
}

// Listen
server.listen(3000)
```

```text
# AGENTS.md — Projet `mcp-media` (serveur MCP "Media : Gen + Extract")

> Ce fichier est la SPEC de référence pour l'agent Reasonix. Lis-le en entier avant
> de coder. Règles : laisser le protocole propre, ne jamais mettre de secret dans le
> code (ils vivent dans `.env`), exposer chaque capacité de l'API Pruna en tool
> explicite (pas de wrapper "générique"), coder en commentaires anglais.

## 1. Objectif

Construire un serveur **MCP (Model Context Protocol) en Node.js** accessible en
**stdio**, nommé `mcp-media`, qui expose des outils de :

- **Génération média** (GEN) : images, édition d'images, upscale, try-on, vidéo
  texte→vidéo, avatar/talking-head, animation, replacement (inpainting), TTS, STT,
  lip-sync avatar, nettoyage/amélioration d'image.
- **Extraction média** (EXTRACT) : extraction audio d'une vidéo, extraction de
  frames, métadonnées vidéo (ffprobe), upload local → URL publique.

C'est l'équivalent unifié des skills opencode `pruna-image`, `navy-image`,
`imgtools`, `tts-api`, `transcribe`, plus les outils ffmpeg/upload disponibles dans
opencode. Un seul serveur, exposé sous `mcp__media__*` dans Reasonix.

Fichiers à produire dans CE dossier :

| Fichier | Rôle |
|---|---|
| `server.js` | Le serveur MCP lui-même (single file, Node >= 18, `fetch` global, zéro dépendance npm) |
| `mcp-test.js` | Script de test du protocole + d'une sélection d'outils en direct (stdio) |
| `install.md` | Instructions d'installation (blocs config Reasonix + opencode) |
| `.env` | Secrets (déjà fourni dans le dossier — NE PAS l'écraser) |
| `.env.example` | Modèle documenté des variables attendues |

Aucun `package.json`, aucun `node_modules`, aucun `npm install` : `node server.js`
doit fonctionner immédiatement. `ffmpeg` / `ffprobe` et `curl` doivent être appelés
en sous-processus (`child_process`).

## 2. Contrat protocolaire MCP (à respecter à la lettre)

Serveur stdio : **une réponse JSON-RPC par ligne**, séparées par `\n`. Les logs
vont sur **stderr** UNIQUEMENT (jamais sur stdout, qui est réservé au protocole).

Séquence attendue côté Reasonix (client MCP) :
1. Le client envoie `initialize` :
```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"initialize","params":{"protocolVersion":"2025-06-18","capabilities":{},"clientInfo":{"name":"reasonix","version":"1"}}}
```
Répondre, avec notamment `serverInfo` et le version du protocole.
2. Le client envoie `notifications/initialized` (pas de réponse attendue).
3. Le client appelle `tools/list` → répondre avec **tous** les outils et leurs
   `inputSchema` (JSON Schema Draft 7 strict et précis : types, enum, descriptions
   courtes). Schémas stables et cache-friendly (ne pas régénérer du contenu
   aléatoire à chaque `tools/list`).
4. Le client appelle `tools/call` pour invoquer un outil :
```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":2,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"media.tts","arguments":{...}}}
```
Répondre (succès) :
```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":2,"result":{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"<JSON string>"}]}}}
```
Et en cas d'erreur outil (pas un crash) :
```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":2,"error":{"code":-32603,"message":"<erreur lisible>"}}
```
- Toute méthode inconnue → `{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":<id>,"error":{"code":-32601,"message":"Method not found"}}`.
  Une notification sans `id` (méthode inconnue) → ignorer silencieusement.
- Toute requête mal formée → code `-32700` (parse error) sans crash.
- **Le serveur ne doit jamais quitter** sur une erreur : wrapper la boucle de
  lecture dans un try/catch, continuer après chaque ligne.

## 3. Contrat de sortie des outils (uniforme)

Chaque tool réussit et renvoie un **objet JSON sérialisé** dans `content[0].text` :

```json
{
  "ok": true,
  "tool": "media.image_gen",
  "local_path": "/abs/path/xxx.png",   // null si pas de fichier local
  "url": "https://...",                 // null si pas d'upload
  "meta": { "model": "...", "api": "pruna", "width": 1024, "height": 1024 }
}
```

Règles :
- **Livraison par défaut : fichier local.** L'upload URL n'a lieu que si
  `upload: true` est passé en argument (`upload` bool, défaut `false`).
- Dossier de sortie par défaut : `~/Downloads/mcm-media/` (créer s'il manque) ;
  surchargeable via l'argument global `save_dir`.
- Les opérations **asynchrones** (vidéo, try-on, job) : lancer, poller jusqu'à
  `async_timeout_s` (défaut 240 s, max 600), télécharger le résultat en local, puis
  rendre `{ok, local_path, url?, meta}`. En cas de dépassement, rendre le `job_id`
  dans `meta` ET une erreur outil explicite "timeout, job encore en cours : <id>".
- Toujours parser la réponse du backend, vérifier `ok`/`success`, et propager un
  message d'erreur lisible (statut HTTP, message du backend) en cas d'échec.

## 4. Gestion des secrets

- Les secrets sont lus depuis le fichier **`.env` du dossier courant**
  (chargé au démarrage, avant la boucle, via `fs.readFileSync` + parse `KEY=VALUE`,
  sans dépendance npm). Ne **jamais** hardcoder une clé dans `server.js`.
- Variables attendues (voir `.env.example`) :
  `PRUNA_KEY`, `NAVY_KEY`, `NAVY_BASE_URL`, `IMGTOOLS_KEY`, `IMGTOOLS_API_URL`,
  `TTS_API_KEY`, `TTS_BASE_URL`.
- HTTP: les clés envoyées en header `Authorization: Bearer <key>` ET/OU
  `X-API-Key: <key>` selon le service (voir tableau ci-dessous).

## 5. Référence des APIs backend (à implémenter tels quels)

### 5.1 PRUNA — `https://pruna.esprit-artificiel.com` (génération image/vidéo, GRATUIT)
Auth header : `X-API-Key: ${PRUNA_KEY}` (et `Authorization: Bearer <same>`).
**Quotas par IP/jour** : 5 par modèle image (p-image, p-image-ideogram,
p-image-edit, p-image-upscale, p-image-try-on, compteurs séparés), 5 par modèle
vidéo (p-video, avatar, animate, replace, séparés), 20 pour l'ancien playground edit.
Le proxy sonde `?model=<modèle>` lui-même et gère les 429. Notre serveur doit juste
envoyer les requêtes et interpréter les réponses.

Règles de défauts service (v2.5.0) : tout param absent → défaut ; qualité = meilleure :
`thinking: high` (ideogram), `output_quality: 95`, `image_size: 2K`,
`prompt_upsampling: true`, vidéo `resolution: 1080p`, `fps: 48`, `draft: false`,
`save_audio: true`, edit engine `new` : `turbo: true`, `aspect_ratio: match_input_image`,
upscale : `target: 4`, `output_format: jpg`, try-on : `preserve_input_size: true`,
`output_quality: 95`.

Endpoints :

| Route | Méthode | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `POST /generate` | JSON `{prompt, aspect_ratio, model?, seed?, prompt_upsampling?, width?, height?}` | sync | p-image par défaut ; `model:"ideogram"` → Ideogram. Réponse `{success, imageUrl, generationCount, maxGenerations}` |
| `POST /ideogram` | JSON `{prompt, thinking?, image_size?, aspect_ratio?, output_format?, output_quality?, prompt_upsampling?, seed?, width?, height?}` | sync | `thinking: very low/low/medium/high` ; `image_size: 1K/2K` ; `aspect_ratio: 1:1,16:9,9:16,4:3,3:4,3:2,2:3,custom` ; `output_format: png/jpg/webp` ; `output_quality: 0-100` ; `width/height ≤ 2560` |
| `POST /edit` | JSON `{prompt, images: [dataURI|url|chemin local], engine?}` | sync | `engine` absent/`"old"`=ancien playground (compteur 20/jour) ; `"new"`=p-image-edit (turbo, match_input_image, seed) |
| `POST /upscale` | JSON `{image, target? (1-8, défaut 4), output_format?, output_quality?, enhance_details?, enhance_realism?}` | sync | |
| `POST /try-on` | multipart `person_image` + `garment_images` (+ `category, seed, prompt, turbo, output_format, output_quality, reference_pose, preserve_input_size`) | **async** → `GET /try-on/status/:id` | |
| `POST /video/generate` | JSON ou multipart `{prompt, duration? (1-10, défaut 5), aspect_ratio? (16:9,9:16,1:1), resolution? (720p,1080p), fps? (24,48), draft?, prompt_upsampling?, save_audio?, image?, audio?}` | **async** → `GET /video/status/:id` → `{status:"succeeded", output:"url.mp4"}` | |
| `POST /video/avatar` | multipart `{sourceImage, description?, voice?, language?, resolution?, video_prompt?, voice_prompt?, negative_prompt?}` | **async** → `GET /video/avatar/status/:id` | voix : Zephyr/Puck/Charon/Kore/Fenrir/Leda/Orus/Aoede/Callirrhoe/Iapetus |
| `POST /video/animate` | multipart `{sourceImage, sourceVideo, prompt?, turbo?, target_fps?, instruction_prompt?, resolution?}` | **async** → `GET /video/animate/status/:id` | |
| `POST /video/replace` | multipart `{sourceImage, sourceVideo, prompt?, turbs?, ...}` | **async** → `GET /video/replace/status/:id` | |
| `GET /status` | — | sync | quotas (→ tool `media.pruna_status`) |
| `GET /v1/models` | — | sync | catalogue OpenAI-compatible |

Pour les fichiers (multipart) : convertir un chemin local en un `File` Buffer et
l'envoyer avec `FormData` natif de Node 18+ ; une URL http(s) peut être passée
directement, et une `data:` URI telle quelle.

### 5.2 NAVY — `https://navy.fopacademy.fr/v1` (image / édition / STT, rotation 10 clés)
Auth : `Authorization: Bearer ${NAVY_KEY}`. Modèles dynamiques : **toujours**
interroger `/v1/models` avant de choisir. Routage auto via `/v1/usage` côté service.

| Route | Notes |
|---|---|
| `GET /v1/models` | catalogue (tool `media.navy_models`) |
| `POST /v1/images/generations` | `{model, prompt, size?|aspect?, seed?, image_url?}` — `image_url` : jusqu'à 5 URLs séparées par virgules pour la multi-ref / édition |
| `POST /v1/audio/transcriptions` | STT, 4 modèles free (envoi multipart `file` + `model`) |
| `POST /v1/chat/completions` | édition via modèles Gemini multimodal (messages avec parties image) |
| `POST /v1/images/generations` (async) | si `sync:false` → réponse job → `GET /v1/images/generations/:jobId` à poller |

### 5.3 IMGTOOLS — `https://imgtools.esprit-artificiel.com` (4 outils gratuits)
Auth header : `x-api-key: ${IMGTOOLS_KEY}`. Tous POST en `multipart/form-data`,
champ `file`. Option `?wait=true` (sync) et `?download=true` (image directe).

| Route | Paramètres | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `POST /rmbg?wait=true` | `file` | suppression arrière-plan |
| `POST /ruo?wait=true` | `file`, `prompt` | suppression d'objet par prompt |
| `POST /upscale?wait=true` | `file`, `ratio` (`200`=2x, `400`=4x) | |
| `POST /enhance?wait=true` | `file`, `target_longest_side` (`1024|2048|4096`) | |

### 5.4 TTS — `https://tts.esprit-artificiel.com` (TTS multi-moteurs + lip-sync)
Auth : `X-API-Key: ${TTS_API_KEY}` (ou `Authorization: Bearer <same>`).

| Route | Notes |
|---|---|
| `GET /v1/agent/quickstart` | à appeler 1× par session TTS : donne les enums + règles |
| `GET /v1/agent/recommend?language=&use_case=` | corps de speech prêt (recommander si model+voice non fournis) |
| `GET /v1/voices?engine=fish\|edge\|gemini&language=fr&curated_only=true` | listes |
| `POST /v1/audio/speech` | `{model, voice, input, persona?, response_format?, speed?, rate?, pitch?}` — **ne jamais inventer** un voice id Fish ; utiliser quickstart/recommend/voices. Réponse : audio binaire OU job JSON à poller `GET /v1/jobs/{id}` puis `GET /v1/jobs/{id}/audio` |
| `POST /v1/video/avatar` | multipart `image` + `audio` + `description` → lip-sync talking head (durée = durée audio) → poller `GET /v1/jobs/{id}` |

Modèles : `fish-s2.1-pro-free` (Fish free, voix FR curatées), `gemini-live-native-audio`
(acting via `persona`), `gemini-batch-tts`, `edge-tts` (gratuit, rate/pitch),
OpenAI aliases `tts-1`/`tts-1-hd`/`gpt-4o-mini-tts`, voix OpenAI alloy/echo/fable/
onyx/nova/shimmer.

### 5.5 EXTRACT — ffmpeg/ffprobe (local)
- `extract_audio(source, format?, start?, end?, output?)` :
  `ffmpeg -y -i <source> [-ss start] [-to end] -vn -acodec <codec> <output>`
  formats : mp3, wav, aac, flac.
- `extract_frames(source, at_time?, start?, end?, fps?, count?, output?)` :
  une frame à `at_time` : `ffmpeg -ss <t> -i <source> -frames:v 1 <out.png>` ;
  une série `start`→`end` à `fps` frames/s : `ffmpeg -ss <s> -to <e> -i <source> -vf fps=<fps> <out_%03d.png>` ;
  `metadata_only:true` → ffprobe.
- `video_info(source)` :
  `ffprobe -v error -print_format json -show_format -show_streams <source>`,
  extraire durée/résolution/fps/codecs vidéo+audio, présence piste audio.
- Sources : chemin local **ou** URL http(s) (télécharger en tmp avant).

### 5.6 UPLOAD — URL publique
Fallback dans l'ordre, essayer chacune jusqu'au succès :
1. **litterbox.catbox.moe** : `POST https://litterbox.catbox.moe/resources/internals/api.php`
   `-F reqtype=fileupload -F time=<1h|12h|24h|72h> -F fileToUpload=@<fichier>` → réponse texte = URL.
2. **file.io** : `POST https://file.io/` `-F file=@<fichier>` → JSON `{success, link}`.
3. **tmpfile.link** : `POST https://tmpfile.link/` (multipart `file`) → JSON `{url, ...}`.

Renvoie la première URL réussie ; `expiry` (défaut `24h`) utilisé sur litterbox.

### 5.7 VISION — adaptateur multimodal externe (providers OpenAI-compatibles)

`media.vision_check` envoie les médias à des providers vision externes
(`POST <base_url>/chat/completions`), gérés par l'agent via
`media.vision_provider_add/remove/list` et `vision_default_set`, persistés dans
`vision-config.json` (non committé). Paramètres :

- `name`, `base_url` (OpenAI-compatible, slash final rogné), `api_key`
  (`Authorization: Bearer`), `model`, `capabilities` (enum `image|audio|video`,
  défaut `image`), `max_images` (1-12, défaut 4), `is_default`.
- `video_format` / `audio_format` (enum `file|openai`, défaut `file`) : format
  de partie utilisé. `file` = partie universelle
  `{"type":"file","file":{"url":…,"mime_type":…,"filename":…}}` (runtime Qwen,
  voir `QWEN_RUNTIME_MULTIMODAL_CURL_GUIDE.md`) ; `openai` = `video_url`
  (vidéo) et `input_audio` wav (audio) — validé sur Gemini.

Comportement réel de l'adaptateur (v2.1.0+) :

1. **Image** → toujours partie `image_url` (universel).
2. **Vidéo** → partie native si le provider a la capacité `video`
   (`video_url` si `video_format:"openai"`, partie `file` sinon) ; sinon si le
   provider est image-capable → **dégradation en keyframes** extraites par
   ffmpeg (`fps=1, scale 1024, max 8`) avec un warning dans `meta.warnings` ;
   sinon erreur.
3. **Audio** → exige la capacité `audio` ; le flux est converti en **mp3** 128k
   (format `file`, Qwen) ou **wav** (format `openai`, Gemini) ; si l'audio fait
   moins de 45 s, un warning `meta.warnings` signale que « l'upload peut réussir
   sans perception » (fiabilité mesurée ≥ ~48 s) — ne jamais inventer de seuil
   dur bloquant.
4. **max_images est appliqué** : les parties `image_url` (images + keyframes)
   sont plafonnées par `max_images`, avec warning si élagage.
5. Routing : provider forcé via `provider:`, déterministe via
   `no_fallback:true`, circuit breaker par provider (`vision:<name>`), timeout
   10-180 s. Le texte de réponse est en `analysis.text` (+ `analysis.parsed`
   si JSON extractible). Les snippets `[Image 1]`/`[Video 1]` ne prouvent pas un
   file join : contraire à vérifier par la réponse réellement fondée.

Détails validés par test (août 2026) — voir la matrice dans `install.md`.

`media.vision_guide` (résumé via `summary:true`) expose le guide
`QWEN_RUNTIME_MULTIMODAL_CURL_GUIDE.md` par le canal MCP : indispensable pour
les clients sans accès fichiers (reasonix). Le guider affiche le format exact
des parties, les limites par message et les seuils audio.

## 7. Pipeline interne recommandé

- `loadEnv()` au démarrage (parse `.env`).
- `api()` helper fetch avec timeout (`AbortController`, 30 s par défaut,
  paramétrable), headers selon service, logging stderr.
- `saveFromUrl(url, dir)` : télécharge un média (fetch → Buffer → fs.writeFile) ;
  extension déduite du Content-Type/URL, fallback `.bin`.
- `downloadAndValidate(ok, ...)` : après chaque réponse backend, vérifier succès et
  présence de l'URL/fichier avant de retourner.
- Multipart : helper `buildForm(entries)` avec `FormData` natif, envoi sans `Content-Type`
  manuel (laisser Node poser la boundary).
- `poll(url, intervalMs=2000, timeoutS)` : boucle d'attente jusqu'à `status == "succeeded"`
  ou `"failed"` ; retourner l'URL de sortie.
- Upload : `uploadChain(file, expiry)` comme décrit en 5.6.

## 8. Tests (mcp-test.js)

Un script Node qui équivaut au client MCP minimal :
1. spawn `node server.js`, écrire `initialize`, lire la réponse → vérifier `serverInfo`.
2. `notifications/initialized`.
3. `tools/list` → vérifier ≥ 15 tools avec `inputSchema` valides.
4. Exécuter deux tools réels et vérifier le contrat de sortie :
   - `media.video_info` sur le fichier d'exemple embarqué (petit mp4 généré par ffmpeg
     en setup, ou un `.mp4` minimal placé dans `testdata/` si tu peux le générer
     : `ffmpeg -f lavfi -i color=c=red:s=320x240:d=1 -f lavfi -i sine=frequency=440:duration=1 testdata/sample.mp4`).
   - `media.upload_file` sur un petit fichier texte (vérifie une URL `http`).
5. Exit code : 0 si tout passe, 1 sinon ; chaque étape loggée clairement sur stderr.
   Ne PAS lancer de génération payante lourde dans le test.

## 9. Critères d'acceptation

- `node --check server.js` passe.
- `node mcp-test.js` se termine en 0 et valide protocole + les 2 tools testés.
- `tools/list` : ≥ 15 tools, schémas précis (aucun argument `any` sans description).
- Aucun secret en dur dans `server.js` (vérifier que toutes les clés passent par `.env`).
- Le serveur ne crashe pas sur un `tools/call` inconnu ou des arguments invalides
  (réponse JSON-RPC `error`, process vivant).
- stdout ne contient QUE du JSON-RPC (les logs passent par stderr).

## 10. Livrables finaux de la session

Terminer la tâche en :
1. S'assurer que tous les fichiers sont présents et les tests passent.
2. Donner un **résumé** : noms et nombre de tools, comment on les appelle dans
   Reasonix (`mcp__media__<tool>`), et le bloc `[[plugins]]` exact à ajouter dans
   `~/.reasonix/config.toml` (stdio, `command="node", args=["<abs>/server.js"]`,
   `call_timeout_seconds=600`) ainsi que l'entrée opencode.json équivalente
   (désactivée par défaut, `enabled:false`) — à reporter dans `install.md`.
3. NE PAS modifier `~/.reasonix/config.toml` ni `opencode.json` : l'utilisateur
   appliquera l'installation lui-même.

### 📄 `data/infra_snapshots/objects/ea/285e806fd4404f1a4bd5bc08839c43199f3cd7fd441a0e5afe9915c8749761`

```text
"""Proxy pass-through : transfert transparent avec streaming SSE."""
from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import json
from typing import AsyncGenerator, Optional

import httpx
from fastapi import Request, Response
from fastapi.responses import StreamingResponse

from .config import settings
from .key_manager import NIMKeyManager
from .models import NIMKey

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


# Headers à supprimer avant d'envoyer upstream (Hop-by-hop + sensibles)
_HOP_BY_HOP = {
    "host",
    "content-length",
    "connection",
    "keep-alive",
    "proxy-authenticate",
    "proxy-authorization",
    "te",
    "trailers",
    "transfer-encoding",
    "upgrade",
    "authorization",  # on injecte la clé NIM active
    "x-forwarded-for",
    "x-forwarded-proto",
}


def _clean_headers(headers) -> dict[str, str]:
    """Filtre les hop-by-hop headers + ceux qu'on remplace."""
    out = {}
    for k, v in headers.items():
        kl = k.lower()
        if kl in _HOP_BY_HOP:
            continue
        out[k] = v
    return out


class ProxyPassThrough:
    """Handler pass-through avec rotation NIM et gestion streaming."""

    def __init__(self, key_manager: NIMKeyManager):
        self.key_manager = key_manager
        self.client: Optional[httpx.AsyncClient] = None

    async def startup(self) -> None:
        """Initialise le client HTTP partagé."""
        self.client = httpx.AsyncClient(
            timeout=httpx.Timeout(settings.request_timeout, connect=30.0),
            follow_redirects=False,
        )

    async def shutdown(self) -> None:
        if self.client:
            await self.client.aclose()

    async def handle(self, request: Request, path: str) -> Response:
        """Route une requête vers NVIDIA via la prochaine clé NIM disponible.

        - Essaie toutes les clés actives en round-robin
        - Bascule sur une autre clé si 429 / 5xx / timeout
        - Si stream=True : SSE chunk-by-chunk
        - Si toutes les clés épuisées : 503 + Retry-After
        """
        target_url = f"{settings.nvidia_base_url.rstrip('/')}/{path.lstrip('/')}"
        # Préserve la query string
        if request.url.query:
            target_url = f"{target_url}?{request.url.query}"

        # Lecture du body (une seule fois)
        body = await request.body()
        headers = _clean_headers(request.headers)
        # À ce stade on autorise Content-Type, Accept, etc. (tout sauf HOP_BY_HOP)

        # Récupère le Content-Type du body si l'original l'avait
        method = request.method.upper()
        is_stream = self._is_streaming_request(body)
        max_retries = settings.max_retries + 1  # une tentative par clé dispo min

        tries = 0
        used_keys: set[str] = set()
        last_error: Optional[str] = None
        last_status: int = 0

        while tries < max_retries + 4:  # +4 pour permettre de tenter toutes les clés
            key = await self.key_manager.get_active_key()
            if not key or key.id in used_keys:
                # Toutes les clés ont été tentées sans succès → saturation
                break
            used_keys.add(key.id)
            tries += 1

            upstream_headers = {**headers, "Authorization": f"Bearer {key.api_key}"}

            try:
                if is_stream:
                    stream_response, stream_status, stream_error = await self._handle_streaming(
                        key, method, target_url, body, upstream_headers
                    )
                    if stream_response is None:
                        # L'erreur est survenue avant le premier chunk : on peut
                        # encore retenter proprement avec une autre clé.
                        last_status = stream_status
                        last_error = stream_error
                        continue
                    return stream_response

                # Mode non-streaming
                resp = await self.client.request(  # type: ignore[union-attr]
                    method=method,
                    url=target_url,
                    content=body,
                    headers=upstream_headers,
                )

                # Détection du quota journalier vs RPM
                if resp.status_code == 429:
                    retry_after = self._parse_retry_after(resp)
                    is_quota = retry_after > settings.rpm_cooldown_threshold or (
                        self._is_quota_message(resp)
                    )
                    await self.key_manager.mark_rate_limited(
                        key,
                        retry_after_seconds=retry_after,
                        is_quota_day=is_quota,
                        error_hint=f"429 (retry-after={retry_after}s, quota={is_quota})",
                    )
                    last_status = 429
                    last_error = f"429 from upstream (key={key.id})"
                    continue  # bascule sur la clé suivante

                if resp.status_code == 401 or resp.status_code == 403:
                    # Clé NIM rejetée → marquer morte si 403, sinon retry court
                    if resp.status_code == 403:
                        await self.key_manager.mark_rate_limited(
                            key,
                            retry_after_seconds=86400,  # long
                            is_quota_day=True,
                            error_hint="403 (clé révoquée/invalide)",
                        )
                    last_status = resp.status_code
                    last_error = f"{resp.status_code} from upstream (key={key.id})"
                    continue

                if 500 <= resp.status_code < 600:
                    await self.key_manager.mark_error(
                        key, f"5xx ({resp.status_code}) from upstream"
                    )
                    last_status = resp.status_code
                    last_error = f"{resp.status_code} from upstream (key={key.id})"
                    continue

                if resp.status_code >= 400:
                    # 4xx non-rate-limit → on renvoie tel quel sans pénaliser
                    return Response(
                        content=resp.content,
                        status_code=resp.status_code,
                        headers={k: v for k, v in resp.headers.items() if k.lower() not in _HOP_BY_HOP},
                    )

                # Succès
                await self.key_manager.mark_success(key)
                out_headers = {
                    k: v for k, v in resp.headers.items() if k.lower() not in _HOP_BY_HOP
                }
                return Response(
                    content=resp.content,
                    status_code=resp.status_code,
                    headers=out_headers,
                )

            except httpx.TimeoutException as e:
                await self.key_manager.mark_error(key, f"timeout: {str(e)[:120]}")
                last_status = 0
                last_error = f"timeout on key {key.id}"
                logger.warning("timeout on key %s: %s", key.id, e)
                continue

            except httpx.RequestError as e:
                await self.key_manager.mark_error(key, f"network error: {str(e)[:120]}")
                last_status = 0
                last_error = f"network error on key {key.id}: {e}"
                logger.warning("network error on key %s: %s", key.id, e)
                continue

        # Saturation totale
        wait = await self.key_manager.earliest_available_in()
        wait_int = int(wait)
        detail = (
            "All NVIDIA NIM keys are currently exhausted "
            f"(last attempt: key={used_keys}, status={last_status}, error={last_error}). "
            f"Try again in {wait_int}s."
        )
        logger.error("saturation: %s", detail)
        return Response(
            content='{"error":{"message":"%s","type":"saturation","retry_after":%d}}'
            % (detail.replace('"', '\\"'), wait_int),
            status_code=503,
            headers={"Retry-After": str(wait_int), "Content-Type": "application/json"},
        )

    async def _handle_streaming(
        self,
        key: NIMKey,
        method: str,
        target_url: str,
        body: bytes,
        upstream_headers: dict,
    ) -> tuple[Optional[Response], int, Optional[str]]:
        """Gère un stream SSE et retente les erreurs avant le premier chunk.

        Une réponse HTTP d'erreur est connue avant que le stream ne commence :
        on ferme alors la réponse et on laisse ``handle`` choisir une autre clé.
        En revanche, une coupure après l'envoi de chunks ne peut pas être
        rejouée sans risquer de dupliquer la sortie côté client.
        """
        req = self.client.build_request(  # type: ignore[union-attr]
            method=method,
            url=target_url,
            content=body,
            headers=upstream_headers,
        )
        upstream_resp = await self.client.send(req, stream=True)  # type: ignore[union-attr]

        if upstream_resp.status_code == 429:
            retry_after = self._parse_retry_after(upstream_resp)
            is_quota = retry_after > settings.rpm_cooldown_threshold
            await self.key_manager.mark_rate_limited(
                key,
                retry_after_seconds=retry_after,
                is_quota_day=is_quota,
                error_hint=f"429 during stream (retry-after={retry_after}s)",
            )
            await upstream_resp.aclose()
            return None, 429, f"429 from upstream during stream (key={key.id})"

        if upstream_resp.status_code in (401, 403):
            if upstream_resp.status_code == 403:
                await self.key_manager.mark_rate_limited(
                    key,
                    retry_after_seconds=86400,
                    is_quota_day=True,
                    error_hint="403 (clé révoquée/invalide)",
                )
            await upstream_resp.aclose()
            return (
                None,
                upstream_resp.status_code,
                f"{upstream_resp.status_code} from upstream during stream (key={key.id})",
            )

        if 500 <= upstream_resp.status_code < 600:
            await self.key_manager.mark_error(
                key, f"5xx during stream ({upstream_resp.status_code})"
            )
            await upstream_resp.aclose()
            return (
                None,
                upstream_resp.status_code,
                f"{upstream_resp.status_code} from upstream during stream (key={key.id})",
            )

        if upstream_resp.status_code >= 400:
            # Erreur client non liée à la clé : on la renvoie telle quelle.
            content = await upstream_resp.aread()
            await upstream_resp.aclose()
            return (
                Response(
                    content=content,
                    status_code=upstream_resp.status_code,
                    headers={
                        k: v
                        for k, v in upstream_resp.headers.items()
                        if k.lower() not in _HOP_BY_HOP
                    },
                ),
                upstream_resp.status_code,
                None,
            )

        async def stream_iter() -> AsyncGenerator[bytes, None]:
            try:
                async for chunk in upstream_resp.aiter_bytes():
                    if chunk:
                        yield chunk
            except Exception as exc:
                # Le flux a déjà pu commencer : on journalise, mais on ne
                # tente pas une seconde requête qui dupliquerait la sortie.
                await self.key_manager.mark_error(
                    key, f"stream interrupted: {str(exc)[:120]}"
                )
                logger.warning("stream interrupted on key %s: %s", key.id, exc)
                raise
            else:
                await self.key_manager.mark_success(key)
            finally:
                try:
                    await upstream_resp.aclose()
                except Exception:  # pragma: no cover
                    pass

        out_headers = {
            k: v
            for k, v in upstream_resp.headers.items()
            if k.lower() not in _HOP_BY_HOP
        }

        return (
            StreamingResponse(
                stream_iter(),
                status_code=upstream_resp.status_code,
                headers=out_headers,
            ),
            upstream_resp.status_code,
            None,
        )

    def _is_streaming_request(self, body: bytes) -> bool:
        """Détecte si la requête contient stream: true (JSON)."""
        if not body:
            return False
        try:
            import json

            data = json.loads(body)
            if isinstance(data, dict):
                return bool(data.get("stream")) is True
        except Exception:
            pass
        return False

    def _parse_retry_after(self, response) -> float:
        """Parse le header Retry-After (deltasec ou HTTP-date)."""
        h = response.headers.get("retry-after")
        if not h:
            return settings.rpm_cooldown_threshold  # default
        h = h.strip()
        if h.isdigit():
            return float(int(h))
        try:
            from email.utils import parsedate_to_datetime

            dt = parsedate_to_datetime(h)
            if dt:
                import datetime as _dt

                now = _dt.datetime.now(_dt.timezone.utc)
                diff = (dt - now).total_seconds()
                return max(1.0, diff)
        except Exception:
            pass
        return settings.rpm_cooldown_threshold

    def _is_quota_message(self, response) -> bool:
        """Détecte un message 'quota exceeded' dans le body 429."""
        h = response.headers.get("content-type", "").lower()
        if "json" not in h:
            return False
        try:
            data = response.json()
            text = json.dumps(data).lower()
            return any(
                kw in text
                for kw in ("quota", "requests per day", "rpd", "daily limit")
            )
        except Exception:
            return False

      if (r.status === 401) { document.getElementById('save-result').textContent = 'Session expirée.'; return; }
      const d = await r.json();
      document.getElementById('rotationMode').value = d.rotationMode || 'round_robin';
      const run = d.runtime || {};
      for (const key of ['FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS','RETRY_BACKOFF_MS','RETRY_TOTAL_BUDGET_MS','COOLDOWN_SECONDS','QUOTA_PAUSE_MS','QUOTA_COLD_THRESHOLD','COLD_WAKE_BACKOFF_HOURS','COLD_WAKE_MAX_BACKOFF_HOURS','FOCUS_MODEL','MODEL_CACHE_TTL','FREE_ONLY','IP_RPM','IP_RPD','MAX_CONCURRENT_PER_IP']) {
        const el = document.getElementById(key);
        if (el) el.value = run[key] !== undefined ? run[key] : (d.defaults[key] !== undefined ? d.defaults[key] : '');
      }
    }
    async function save() {
      const out = document.getElementById('save-result');
      out.textContent = '⏳ enregistrement…';
      out.className = '';
      const ids = ['FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS','RETRY_BACKOFF_MS','RETRY_TOTAL_BUDGET_MS','COOLDOWN_SECONDS','QUOTA_PAUSE_MS','QUOTA_COLD_THRESHOLD','COLD_WAKE_BACKOFF_HOURS','COLD_WAKE_MAX_BACKOFF_HOURS','FOCUS_MODEL','MODEL_CACHE_TTL','FREE_ONLY','IP_RPM','IP_RPD','MAX_CONCURRENT_PER_IP'];
      const runtime = {};
      for (const id of ids) {
        const v = document.getElementById(id).value;
        runtime[id] = (id === 'FREE_ONLY') ? (v === 'true') : v;
      }
      const body = { runtime, rotationMode: document.getElementById('rotationMode').value };
      const r = await fetch('/admin/api/config', {
        method: 'PATCH',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify(body),
      });
      const d = await r.json();
      if (r.ok && d.ok) { out.textContent = '✅ configuration appliquée à chaud'; out.className = 'ok'; }
      else { out.textContent = '❌ ' + (d.error || 'échec'); out.className = 'err'; }
    }
    setTimeout(load, 200);
  </script>
